`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/CleanRoom/Usability/CleanRoomLeakProbeTest.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Linq;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.CleanRoom.Info;
using Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak;
using Game.Context;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Usability
{
    public class CleanRoomLeakProbeTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void SingleMissingWallReportsThatCellTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            CleanRoomDetectionTest.BuildBox(new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0), new Vector3Int(4, 4, 4));
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.RemoveBlock(new Vector3Int(2, 2, 0), BlockRemoveReason.ManualRemove);

            // 西の壁から探しても、南の壁に空いた1マスだけが漏れとして返る
            // Probing from the west wall still returns only the single hole in the south wall
            var report = AsOpenings(CleanRoomLeakProbe.ProbeFromBoundary(ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore, new[] { new Vector3Int(0, 2, 2) }));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, report.TotalOpeningCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(new Vector3Int(2, 2, 0), report.OpeningCells[0]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void MissingTopFaceReportsTheWholeHoleTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            CleanRoomDetectionTest.BuildBox(new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0), new Vector3Int(6, 4, 6));
            for (var x = 1; x <= 5; x++)
            for (var z = 1; z <= 5; z++)
                ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.RemoveBlock(new Vector3Int(x, 4, z), BlockRemoveReason.ManualRemove);

            // 境界が上の段まで続くので箱を y=4 まで広げ、抜けた上面の25マスを漏れとして返す
            // The boundary continues upward, so the box grows to y=4 and the 25 missing top-face cells are returned
            var report = AsOpenings(CleanRoomLeakProbe.ProbeFromBoundary(ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore, new[] { new Vector3Int(0, 2, 3) }));
            Assert.AreEqual(25, report.TotalOpeningCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(25, report.OpeningCells.Count);
            Assert.IsTrue(report.OpeningCells.All(cell => cell.y == 4));
        }

        [Test]
        public void OversizedSealedBoxIsTooLargeTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();

            // 内寸17x15x17=4335 は部屋の上限4096を超える
            // An interior of 17x15x17=4335 exceeds the 4096-cell room cap
            CleanRoomDetectionTest.BuildBox(new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0), new Vector3Int(18, 16, 18));
            var report = CleanRoomLeakProbe.ProbeFromBoundary(ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore, new[] { new Vector3Int(0, 8, 9) });
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomTooLargeLeak>(report);
        }

        [Test]
        public void IsolatedWallHasNoEnclosureTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            CleanRoomDetectionTest.AddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.CleanRoomWallId, new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0));

            // 囲いが無い型は漏れセルを持たない（型にセルの欄が無い）
            // The no-enclosure type carries no opening cells (it has no field for them)
            var report = CleanRoomLeakProbe.ProbeFromBoundary(ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore, new[] { new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0) });
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeak>(report);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SealedButUndetectedBoxIsDetectionPendingTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();

            // tick を進めず検出前のまま探すと、穴が無いので検出待ちになる
            // Probing before any tick finds no hole, so the result is pending detection
            CleanRoomDetectionTest.BuildBox(new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0), new Vector3Int(4, 4, 4));
            var report = CleanRoomLeakProbe.ProbeFromBoundary(ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore, new[] { new Vector3Int(0, 2, 2) });
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeak>(report);
        }

        #region TestHelper

        private static CleanRoomOpeningsLeak AsOpenings(CleanRoomLeakReport report)
        {
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomOpeningsLeak>(report, $"expected openings but got {report.GetType().Name}");
            return (CleanRoomOpeningsLeak)report;
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Core.Master;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.CleanRoom.Info;
using Game.Context;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Usability
{
    public class CleanRoomInfoQueryTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void EnclosedRoomSummaryFromWallCornerAndFilterTest()
        {
            var datastore = CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            var world = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore;
            var query = new CleanRoomInfoQuery(datastore, world);

            // 壁から引くと、清浄機1台（座標・フィルター5個・残量満タン）を持つ内寸27-1=26の部屋が返る
            // Querying a wall returns the 27-1=26 room holding one purifier (position, 5 filters, full life)
            var fromWall = AsEnclosed(query.Query(world.GetBlock(new Vector3Int(0, 2, 2))));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, fromWall.Rooms.Count);
            var room = fromWall.Rooms[0];
            Assert.AreEqual(26, room.Volume);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, room.AirFilters.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1), room.AirFilters[0].Position);
            Assert.AreEqual(5, room.AirFilters[0].Status.FilterItemCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(1d, room.AirFilters[0].Status.CurrentFilterRemainingRatio, 1e-9);

            // 検出直後の部屋は Out から始まるので、クラスは Out の型になる
            // A freshly detected room starts at Out, so its class is the Out type
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomOutStanding>(room.Class);

            // 角の壁は6近傍に部屋セルを持たないが、26近傍で同じ部屋を見つける
            // A corner wall has no room cell among its six neighbors but finds the room via its 26 neighbors
            AsEnclosed(query.Query(world.GetBlock(new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0))));

            // 室内の清浄機自身からも同じ部屋を引ける
            // The purifier inside the room resolves the same room
            Assert.AreEqual(26, AsEnclosed(query.Query(filter)).Rooms[0].Volume);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ClassifiedRoomCarriesClassNameAndIndexTest()
        {
            var datastore = CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var query = new CleanRoomInfoQuery(datastore, ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore);

            // 清浄機を満電で回し、部屋がいずれかのクラスに入るまで進める
            // Run the purifier at full power until the room enters some class
            CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.EnsureFilterWiredPower(filter);
            CleanRoomClassStanding standing = CleanRoomOutStanding.Instance;
            for (var i = 0; i < 3000 && standing is CleanRoomOutStanding; i++)
            {
                GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
                standing = AsEnclosed(query.Query(filter)).Rooms[0].Class;
            }

            // 分類済みの型は、閾値行の添字とその行のクラス名を持つ
            // The classified type carries the threshold row index and that row's class name
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomClassifiedStanding>(standing, "room never reached a class within 3000 ticks");
            var classified = (CleanRoomClassifiedStanding)standing;
            Assert.AreEqual(MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.Thresholds[classified.ThresholdIndex].ClassName, classified.ClassName);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SharedWallReportsBothRoomsTest()
        {
            var datastore = CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            CleanRoomDetectionTest.BuildBox(new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0), new Vector3Int(4, 4, 4));
            CleanRoomDetectionTest.BuildBox(new Vector3Int(4, 0, 0), new Vector3Int(8, 4, 4));
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();

            // 2部屋が共有する壁は両方の部屋を返す
            // A wall shared by two rooms returns both
            var info = new CleanRoomInfoQuery(datastore, ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore).Query(ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(new Vector3Int(4, 2, 2)));
            Assert.AreEqual(2, AsEnclosed(info).Rooms.Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void BreachedRoomReportsOpeningsFromInsideBlockTest()
        {
            var datastore = CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.RemoveBlock(new Vector3Int(2, 2, 0), BlockRemoveReason.ManualRemove);
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();

            // 部屋が崩れた後、室内の清浄機から引くと未密閉の型になり、壊した壁の位置が漏れとして返る
            // After the room collapses, querying the purifier inside yields the not-enclosed type with the broken wall cell as the leak
            var info = new CleanRoomInfoQuery(datastore, ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore).Query(filter);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomNotEnclosedInfo>(info);
            var leak = ((CleanRoomNotEnclosedInfo)info).Leak;
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomOpeningsLeak>(leak);
            CollectionAssert.Contains(((CleanRoomOpeningsLeak)leak).OpeningCells, new Vector3Int(2, 2, 0));
        }

        #region TestHelper

        private static CleanRoomEnclosedInfo AsEnclosed(CleanRoomInfo info)
        {
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomEnclosedInfo>(info, $"expected an enclosed room but got {info.GetType().Name}");
            return (CleanRoomEnclosedInfo)info;
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
```

```csharp
        public CleanRoomAirFilterStatus GetStatus()
        {
            CheckDestroy(this);

            // 摩耗累計は装填中の1個に溜まる量なので、容量との比から残り寿命を出す
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.CleanRoom/Util/CleanRoomAirFilterCollector.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Util
{
    public readonly struct CleanRoomAirFilterEntry
    {
        public readonly IBlock Block;
        public readonly ICleanRoomAirFilter Filter;

        public CleanRoomAirFilterEntry(IBlock block, ICleanRoomAirFilter filter)
        {
            Block = block;
            Filter = filter;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋セルに重なる清浄機をブロック単位で重複なく集める（純度計算とUI照会で共有）
    ///     Collects air purifiers overlapping room cells once per block, shared by purity and UI queries
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomAirFilterCollector
    {
        public static List<CleanRoomAirFilterEntry> Collect(CleanRoom room, IWorldBlockDatastore world)
        {
            var entries = new List<CleanRoomAirFilterEntry>();
            var visited = new HashSet<BlockInstanceId>();
            foreach (var cell in room.Cells)
            {
                if (!world.TryGetBlock(cell, out var block)) continue;
                if (!visited.Add(block.BlockInstanceId)) continue;
                if (block.TryGetComponent<ICleanRoomAirFilter>(out var filter)) entries.Add(new CleanRoomAirFilterEntry(block, filter));
            }

            return entries;
        }

        // 純度計算と部屋の要約が共有する、清浄機の実効除去体積の合計
        // Sum of the purifiers' effective removal volumes, shared by the purity step and the room summary
        public static double SumRemovalVolume(IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomAirFilterEntry> entries)
        {
            var removalVolume = 0d;
            foreach (var entry in entries) removalVolume += entry.Filter.RemovalVolumePerSecond;
            return removalVolume;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.CleanRoom/Util/CleanRoomPurityLogic.cs` の `IntegrateTick` の直後に足す:

```csharp

        // 濃度 N/V。体積0の部屋（内部が全部機械）は0とする。クラス判定と表示の両方がここを呼ぶ
        // Concentration N/V; zero for a zero-volume room (fully filled by machines), shared by the class decision and the display
        public static double Concentration(double impurityCount, int volume)
        {
            return volume <= 0 ? 0 : impurityCount / volume;
        }

        // 換気回数 nq/V。体積0の部屋は0とする。クラス判定と表示の両方がここを呼ぶ
        // Air change rate nq/V; zero for a zero-volume room, shared by the class decision and the display
        public static double AirChangeRate(double removalVolumePerSecond, int volume)
        {
            return volume <= 0 ? 0 : removalVolumePerSecond / volume;
        }
```

```csharp
        // 閾値行がOutでなければその行を返す。「部屋がOutか」の判定はここだけに置く
        // Returns the threshold row unless the room is Out; the only place that decides whether a room is Out
        public bool TryGetClassRow(out ThresholdsElement row)
        {
            var master = MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster;
            if (master.OutThresholdIndex <= ThresholdIndex)
            {
                row = default;
                return false;
            }

            row = master.Thresholds[ThresholdIndex];
            return true;
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.CleanRoom/Info/CleanRoomInfo.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ブロック1つから見た部屋の状態。密閉・未密閉の種別ごとの型のどちらか1つだけになる
    ///     Room state seen from one block; always exactly one of the per-kind types, enclosed or not enclosed
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomInfo
    {
        // 種別はこのファイルの2つの型に閉じる
        // The kinds are closed to the two types in this file
        private protected CleanRoomInfo()
        {
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     密閉済み。ブロックに接する部屋の要約（1件以上、共有壁なら複数）
    ///     Enclosed: summaries of the rooms touching the block (one or more, several for a shared wall)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class CleanRoomEnclosedInfo : CleanRoomInfo
    {
        public IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomRoomSummary> Rooms { get; }

        public CleanRoomEnclosedInfo(IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomRoomSummary> rooms)
        {
            // 「1件以上」は照会の分岐だけに任せず、型の側で閉じる
            // Close "one or more" in the type itself instead of trusting only the query's branch
            if (rooms.Count == 0) throw new ArgumentException("密閉済みの照会結果は部屋を1件以上持つ / An enclosed result holds at least one room", nameof(rooms));
            Rooms = rooms;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     未密閉。密閉できていない理由と漏れ箇所
    ///     Not enclosed: why it is not sealed and where it leaks
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class CleanRoomNotEnclosedInfo : CleanRoomInfo
    {
        public CleanRoomLeakReport Leak { get; }

        public CleanRoomNotEnclosedInfo(CleanRoomLeakReport leak)
        {
            Leak = leak;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.CleanRoom/Info/CleanRoomClassStanding.cs`:

```csharp
namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋のクラスの立ち位置。Out か、閾値行に入った分類済みかのどちらか1つだけになる
    ///     A room's class standing; always exactly one of Out or classified into a threshold row
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomClassStanding
    {
        // 種別はこのファイルの2つの型に閉じる
        // The kinds are closed to the two types in this file
        private protected CleanRoomClassStanding()
        {
        }

        public static CleanRoomClassStanding Of(CleanRoom room)
        {
            // Out の判定は部屋の TryGetClassRow だけに任せる
            // Leave the Out decision solely to the room's TryGetClassRow
            if (!room.TryGetClassRow(out var row)) return CleanRoomOutStanding.Instance;
            return new CleanRoomClassifiedStanding(row.ClassName, room.ThresholdIndex);
        }
    }

    public sealed class CleanRoomOutStanding : CleanRoomClassStanding
    {
        public static readonly CleanRoomOutStanding Instance = new CleanRoomOutStanding();

        private CleanRoomOutStanding()
        {
        }
    }

    public sealed class CleanRoomClassifiedStanding : CleanRoomClassStanding
    {
        public string ClassName { get; }
        public int ThresholdIndex { get; }

        public CleanRoomClassifiedStanding(string className, int thresholdIndex)
        {
            ClassName = className;
            ThresholdIndex = thresholdIndex;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Game.CleanRoom.Util;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋1つのクラス・濃度・換気回数・清浄機の状況
    ///     Class, concentration, air change rate and purifier states of one room
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomRoomSummary
    {
        // Out か分類済みかは型で表し、クラス名を空文字で埋めない
        // Out versus classified is told by the type; the class name is never padded with an empty string
        public CleanRoomClassStanding Class { get; }
        public double Concentration { get; }
        public double AirChangeRate { get; }
        public int Volume { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomAirFilterSummary> AirFilters { get; }

        private CleanRoomRoomSummary(CleanRoomClassStanding standing, double concentration, double airChangeRate, int volume, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomAirFilterSummary> airFilters)
        {
            Class = standing;
            Concentration = concentration;
            AirChangeRate = airChangeRate;
            Volume = volume;
            AirFilters = airFilters;
        }

        public static CleanRoomRoomSummary Create(CleanRoom room, IWorldBlockDatastore world)
        {
            // 換気回数の分子は、純度計算と同じ収集・同じ合計関数で出す
            // The air-change numerator uses the same collection and sum function as the purity step
            var entries = CleanRoomAirFilterCollector.Collect(room, world);
            var removalVolume = CleanRoomAirFilterCollector.SumRemovalVolume(entries);
            var airFilters = entries.Select(entry => new CleanRoomAirFilterSummary(entry.Block.BlockPositionInfo.OriginalPos, entry.Filter.GetStatus())).ToList();

            // 濃度・換気回数はクラス判定と同じ関数で出す（体積0の部屋は0）
            // Concentration and air change rate come from the same functions as the class decision (zero for a zero-volume room)
            var concentration = CleanRoomPurityLogic.Concentration(room.ImpurityCount, room.Volume);
            var airChangeRate = CleanRoomPurityLogic.AirChangeRate(removalVolume, room.Volume);
            return new CleanRoomRoomSummary(CleanRoomClassStanding.Of(room), concentration, airChangeRate, room.Volume, airFilters);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     密閉できていない理由。種別ごとの型のどれか1つだけになり、漏れセルは Openings の型だけが持つ
    ///     Why the structure is not sealed; always exactly one per-kind type, and only the openings type carries leaking cells
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomLeakReport
    {
        public const int MaxReportedOpenings = 32;

        // 種別はこのファイルの4つの型に閉じる
        // The kinds are closed to the four types in this file
        private protected CleanRoomLeakReport()
        {
        }

        public static CleanRoomLeakReport Openings(IEnumerable<Vector3Int> cells)
        {
            // 表示とテストが毎回同じになるよう並べてから上限で切る
            // Sort before capping so display and tests see the same cells every time
            var sorted = cells.Distinct().OrderBy(cell => cell.y).ThenBy(cell => cell.x).ThenBy(cell => cell.z).ToList();
            if (sorted.Count == 0) throw new ArgumentException("漏れセルが無いなら Openings ではない / Openings needs at least one cell", nameof(cells));
            return new CleanRoomOpeningsLeak(sorted.Take(MaxReportedOpenings).ToList(), sorted.Count);
        }

        public static CleanRoomLeakReport NoEnclosure()
        {
            return CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeak.Instance;
        }

        public static CleanRoomLeakReport TooLarge()
        {
            return CleanRoomTooLargeLeak.Instance;
        }

        public static CleanRoomLeakReport DetectionPending()
        {
            return CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeak.Instance;
        }
    }

    public sealed class CleanRoomOpeningsLeak : CleanRoomLeakReport
    {
        // y→x→z の昇順、最大 MaxReportedOpenings 件
        // Ascending by y, x then z, at most MaxReportedOpenings cells
        public IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> OpeningCells { get; }
        public int TotalOpeningCount { get; }

        internal CleanRoomOpeningsLeak(IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> openingCells, int totalOpeningCount)
        {
            OpeningCells = openingCells;
            TotalOpeningCount = totalOpeningCount;
        }
    }

    // 種の候補のどれも境界に囲まれていない
    // None of the seed candidates is enclosed by boundaries
    public sealed class CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeak : CleanRoomLeakReport
    {
        public static readonly CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeak Instance = new CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeak();

        private CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeak()
        {
        }
    }

    // 塗りが部屋の上限体積を超えた
    // The fill exceeded the room volume cap
    public sealed class CleanRoomTooLargeLeak : CleanRoomLeakReport
    {
        public static readonly CleanRoomTooLargeLeak Instance = new CleanRoomTooLargeLeak();

        private CleanRoomTooLargeLeak()
        {
        }
    }

    // 穴は無いが、まだ部屋として検出されていない
    // No hole exists, but the room has not been detected yet
    public sealed class CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeak : CleanRoomLeakReport
    {
        public static readonly CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeak Instance = new CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeak();

        private CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeak()
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     漏れ探索の共通処理（6方向・境界判定・境界までの軸レイ）
    ///     Shared leak-probe helpers: six directions, boundary checks and axis rays to the nearest boundary
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomLeakRays
    {
        // 軸レイが境界を探す最大距離（部屋の上限4096の一辺の目安）
        // Max distance an axis ray searches for a boundary (a rough side of the 4096-cell cap)
        public const int MaxRayLength = 64;

        public static readonly Vector3Int[] Directions =
        {
            new(1, 0, 0), new(-1, 0, 0), new(0, 1, 0), new(0, -1, 0), new(0, 0, 1), new(0, 0, -1),
        };

        public static bool IsBoundary(IWorldBlockDatastore world, Vector3Int cell)
        {
            return world.TryGetBlock(cell, out var block) && block.ExistsComponent<ICleanRoomBoundaryComponent>();
        }

        // 始点の隣から direction へ進み、最初に当たった境界セルを返す
        // Walk from the origin's neighbor along direction and return the first boundary cell hit
        public static bool TryCastToBoundary(IWorldBlockDatastore world, Vector3Int origin, Vector3Int direction, out Vector3Int hit)
        {
            for (var step = 1; step <= MaxRayLength; step++)
            {
                var cell = origin + direction * step;
                if (!IsBoundary(world, cell)) continue;
                hit = cell;
                return true;
            }

            hit = origin;
            return false;
        }

        public static int AxisOf(Vector3Int direction)
        {
            return direction.x != 0 ? 0 : direction.y != 0 ? 1 : 2;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     漏れ探索で塗りを閉じ込める軸平行の箱。面ごとに1層ずつ広げられる
    ///     Axis-aligned box confining the leak-probe fill; each face can grow one layer at a time
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomLeakBox
    {
        public Vector3Int Min { get; private set; }
        public Vector3Int Max { get; private set; }

        public CleanRoomLeakBox(Vector3Int cell)
        {
            Min = cell;
            Max = cell;
        }

        public void Include(Vector3Int cell)
        {
            Min = Vector3Int.Min(Min, cell);
            Max = Vector3Int.Max(Max, cell);
        }

        public bool Contains(Vector3Int cell)
        {
            return Min.x <= cell.x && cell.x <= Max.x && Min.y <= cell.y && cell.y <= Max.y && Min.z <= cell.z && cell.z <= Max.z;
        }

        // direction 側の面上にあるセルか
        // Whether the cell lies on the face toward direction
        public bool IsOnFace(Vector3Int cell, Vector3Int direction)
        {
            var axis = CleanRoomLeakRays.AxisOf(direction);
            var face = 0 < direction[axis] ? Max[axis] : Min[axis];
            return cell[axis] == face;
        }

        // direction 以外の2軸で箱の最小・最大に並ぶ（側面の縁にある）か
        // Whether the cell sits on the min or max of either axis other than direction's (the side rim)
        public bool IsOnLateralEdge(Vector3Int cell, Vector3Int direction)
        {
            var normalAxis = CleanRoomLeakRays.AxisOf(direction);
            for (var axis = 0; axis < 3; axis++)
            {
                if (axis == normalAxis) continue;
                if (cell[axis] == Min[axis] || cell[axis] == Max[axis]) return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        public void GrowFace(Vector3Int direction)
        {
            if (0 < direction[CleanRoomLeakRays.AxisOf(direction)]) Max += direction;
            else Min += direction;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.CleanRoom.Util;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     箱の内側で種から6近傍の非境界セルを塗る。部屋の上限を1つ超えた時点で打ち切る
    ///     Fills non-boundary cells six-connected from the seeds inside the box, stopping one past the room cap
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomLeakFlood
    {
        public static HashSet<Vector3Int> FillInsideBox(IWorldBlockDatastore world, IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> seeds, CleanRoomLeakBox box)
        {
            var visited = new HashSet<Vector3Int>();
            var queue = new Queue<Vector3Int>();
            foreach (var seed in seeds)
            {
                if (visited.Add(seed)) queue.Enqueue(seed);
            }

            while (queue.Count > 0 && visited.Count <= CleanRoomCellSets.MaxRoomVolume)
            {
                var cell = queue.Dequeue();
                foreach (var direction in CleanRoomLeakRays.Directions)
                {
                    var next = cell + direction;
                    if (!box.Contains(next) || visited.Contains(next) || CleanRoomLeakRays.IsBoundary(world, next)) continue;
                    visited.Add(next);
                    queue.Enqueue(next);
                }
            }

            return visited;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     箱の面の外側1層が、まだ壁で囲われているかを調べる
    ///     Checks whether the layer just outside a box face is still enclosed by walls
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomLeakLayerTest
    {
        // 露出セルの外隣から層内4近傍に空きを塗り、箱の側面の縁へ届かなければ囲われている
        // Fill free cells in-layer from the exposed cells' outer neighbors; the layer is enclosed if none reaches the side rim
        public static bool IsLayerEnclosed(IWorldBlockDatastore world, CleanRoomLeakBox box, Vector3Int direction, IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> exposedFaceCells)
        {
            var normalAxis = CleanRoomLeakRays.AxisOf(direction);
            var visited = new HashSet<Vector3Int>();
            var queue = new Queue<Vector3Int>();
            foreach (var faceCell in exposedFaceCells)
            {
                var start = faceCell + direction;
                if (visited.Add(start)) queue.Enqueue(start);
            }

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                var cell = queue.Dequeue();

                // 縁に届いた空きは箱の外へ抜けているので、この層は囲われていない
                // A free cell on the rim escapes the box, so this layer is not enclosed
                if (box.IsOnLateralEdge(cell, direction)) return false;
                foreach (var inLayerDirection in CleanRoomLeakRays.Directions)
                {
                    if (CleanRoomLeakRays.AxisOf(inLayerDirection) == normalAxis) continue;
                    var next = cell + inLayerDirection;
                    if (visited.Contains(next) || CleanRoomLeakRays.IsBoundary(world, next)) continue;
                    visited.Add(next);
                    queue.Enqueue(next);
                }
            }

            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.CleanRoom.Util;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     密閉できていない構造の漏れ箇所を探す。
    ///     最も囲まれた種から軸レイで壁の箱を推定して中を塗り、箱の面に出た空きのうち外へ抜けるものを漏れとする。
    ///     面の外側1層がまだ境界で囲われていれば、箱をその面へ1層広げて探し直す（一面が抜けた部屋で残った境界の縁まで伸ばすため）。
    ///     Finds the openings of an unsealed structure.
    ///     It estimates the wall box with axis rays from the most enclosed seeds, fills it, and reports exposed face cells that escape outward.
    ///     If the layer beyond a face is still enclosed by boundaries, the box grows one layer on that face and the search repeats (so a room missing a whole face reaches the rim of the remaining boundary).
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomLeakProbe
    {
        // 6方向レイのうち境界に当たる本数がこれ未満の種は部屋の内側とみなさない
        // Seeds whose six rays hit fewer boundaries than this are not treated as a room interior
        private const int MinEnclosingRayHits = 4;

        // 面を広げる回数の上限（壁が延々続く構造で探索を打ち切る）
        // Cap on face growths, stopping endless wall structures
        private const int MaxFaceGrowths = 64;

        public static CleanRoomLeakReport ProbeFromBoundary(IWorldBlockDatastore world, IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> boundaryCells)
        {
            // 境界ブロックの両側（6近傍の空き）を種の候補にし、より囲まれた側を後で選ぶ
            // Both sides of the boundary block (free six-neighbors) become candidates; the more enclosed side wins later
            var candidates = new List<Vector3Int>();
            foreach (var cell in boundaryCells)
            foreach (var direction in CleanRoomLeakRays.Directions)
            {
                var neighbor = cell + direction;
                if (candidates.Contains(neighbor) || CleanRoomLeakRays.IsBoundary(world, neighbor)) continue;
                candidates.Add(neighbor);
            }

            return ProbeFromSeeds(world, candidates);
        }

        public static CleanRoomLeakReport ProbeFromSeeds(IWorldBlockDatastore world, IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> seedCandidates)
        {
            var seeds = new List<Vector3Int>();
            var rayHits = new List<Vector3Int>();
            SelectMostEnclosedSeeds(world, seedCandidates, seeds, rayHits);
            if (seeds.Count == 0) return CleanRoomLeakReport.NoEnclosure();

            var box = new CleanRoomLeakBox(seeds[0]);
            foreach (var cell in seeds) box.Include(cell);
            foreach (var cell in rayHits) box.Include(cell);

            for (var growth = 0; growth <= MaxFaceGrowths; growth++)
            {
                var visited = CleanRoomLeakFlood.FillInsideBox(world, seeds, box);
                if (CleanRoomCellSets.MaxRoomVolume < visited.Count) return CleanRoomLeakReport.TooLarge();

                // 面ごとに、壁が続いていれば箱を広げ、続いていなければ露出セルを漏れとして集める
                // Per face, grow the box if walls continue; otherwise collect the exposed cells as openings
                var openings = new List<Vector3Int>();
                var grown = false;
                foreach (var direction in CleanRoomLeakRays.Directions)
                {
                    var exposed = CollectExposedFaceCells(visited, direction);
                    if (exposed.Count == 0) continue;
                    if (CleanRoomLeakLayerTest.IsLayerEnclosed(world, box, direction, exposed))
                    {
                        box.GrowFace(direction);
                        grown = true;
                        continue;
                    }

                    openings.AddRange(exposed);
                }

                if (grown) continue;
                return openings.Count == 0 ? CleanRoomLeakReport.DetectionPending() : CleanRoomLeakReport.Openings(openings);
            }

            // 壁が延々続く構造は部屋の上限を超える大きさとして扱う
            // An endlessly walled structure is treated as larger than the room cap
            return CleanRoomLeakReport.TooLarge();

            #region Internal

            List<Vector3Int> CollectExposedFaceCells(HashSet<Vector3Int> visited, Vector3Int direction)
            {
                // 面上の塗りセルのうち、外側の隣が空いているもの
                // Filled cells on the face whose outer neighbor is free
                var exposed = new List<Vector3Int>();
                foreach (var cell in visited)
                {
                    if (!box.IsOnFace(cell, direction) || CleanRoomLeakRays.IsBoundary(world, cell + direction)) continue;
                    exposed.Add(cell);
                }

                return exposed;
            }

            #endregion
        }

        private static void SelectMostEnclosedSeeds(IWorldBlockDatastore world, IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> candidates, List<Vector3Int> seeds, List<Vector3Int> rayHits)
        {
            // 6方向レイが境界に当たる本数で採点し、最多（下限以上）の候補とその命中セルだけを残す
            // Score candidates by boundary hits of six rays and keep only the best ones (at or above the minimum) with their hits
            var bestHitCount = MinEnclosingRayHits;
            foreach (var candidate in candidates)
            {
                var hits = new List<Vector3Int>();
                foreach (var direction in CleanRoomLeakRays.Directions)
                {
                    if (CleanRoomLeakRays.TryCastToBoundary(world, candidate, direction, out var hit)) hits.Add(hit);
                }

                if (hits.Count < bestHitCount) continue;
                if (bestHitCount < hits.Count)
                {
                    bestHitCount = hits.Count;
                    seeds.Clear();
                    rayHits.Clear();
                }

                seeds.Add(candidate);
                rayHits.AddRange(hits);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ブロック1つから見た部屋の状態を組み立てる（UI・ツールチップ用の読み取り専用照会）
    ///     Builds the room state seen from one block, a read-only query for UI and tooltips
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomInfoQuery
    {
        private static readonly Vector3Int[] TwentySixOffsets = BuildTwentySixOffsets();

        private readonly CleanRoomDatastore _datastore;
        private readonly IWorldBlockDatastore _world;

        public CleanRoomInfoQuery(CleanRoomDatastore datastore, IWorldBlockDatastore world)
        {
            _datastore = datastore;
            _world = world;
        }

        public CleanRoomInfo Query(IBlock block)
        {
            var cells = block.BlockPositionInfo.EnumeratePositions().ToList();
            var isBoundary = block.ExistsComponent<ICleanRoomBoundaryComponent>();

            // 境界は隣接する部屋、室内のブロックは自分が属する部屋を引く
            // A boundary resolves its adjacent rooms; an interior block resolves the room it belongs to
            var rooms = isBoundary ? CollectAdjacentRooms() : CollectOwnRoom();
            if (rooms.Count > 0) return new CleanRoomEnclosedInfo(rooms.Select(room => CleanRoomRoomSummary.Create(room, _world)).ToList());

            // 部屋が無ければ漏れ箇所を探して返す
            // Without a room, probe for the openings
            var leak = isBoundary ? CleanRoomLeakProbe.ProbeFromBoundary(_world, cells) : CleanRoomLeakProbe.ProbeFromSeeds(_world, cells);
            return new CleanRoomNotEnclosedInfo(leak);

            #region Internal

            List<CleanRoom> CollectAdjacentRooms()
            {
                // 角の壁は6近傍に部屋セルを持たないため26近傍で探す
                // Corner walls have no room cell among six neighbors, so search the 26 neighbors
                var found = new List<CleanRoom>();
                foreach (var cell in cells)
                foreach (var offset in TwentySixOffsets)
                {
                    if (!_datastore.TryGetCleanRoomAt(cell + offset, out var room) || found.Contains(room)) continue;
                    found.Add(room);
                }

                return found;
            }

            List<CleanRoom> CollectOwnRoom()
            {
                return _datastore.TryGetCleanRoom(block, out var room) ? new List<CleanRoom> { room } : new List<CleanRoom>();
            }

            #endregion
        }

        private static Vector3Int[] BuildTwentySixOffsets()
        {
            var offsets = new List<Vector3Int>();
            for (var x = -1; x <= 1; x++)
            for (var y = -1; y <= 1; y++)
            for (var z = -1; z <= 1; z++)
            {
                if (x == 0 && y == 0 && z == 0) continue;
                offsets.Add(new Vector3Int(x, y, z));
            }

            return offsets.ToArray();
        }
    }
}
```

**Files:**

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: A5 の `CleanRoomInfoQuery`・`CleanRoomInfo`（`CleanRoomEnclosedInfo`／`CleanRoomNotEnclosedInfo`）・`CleanRoomClassStanding`・`CleanRoomLeakReport`（`CleanRoomOpeningsLeak`／`CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeak`／`CleanRoomTooLargeLeak`／`CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeak`）・`CleanRoomCellSets.MaxRoomVolume`
- Produces（A8・A10・B6 が使う。namespace は `Server.Protocol.PacketResponse`）:
  - `GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ProtocolTag = "va:getCleanRoomInfo"`
  - `GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(BlockInstanceId)`
  - `GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack`:
    - wire のキーは `CleanRoomInfoResponseKind Kind` [Key2]・`List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> Rooms` [Key3]・`CleanRoomLeakMessagePack Leak` [Key4]（MessagePack の境界なので平らな形のまま）
    - 組み立ては種別ごとの static factory だけ: `CreateEnclosed(List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> rooms)`・`CreateNotEnclosed(CleanRoomLeakMessagePack leak)`・`CreateBlockNotFound()`。引数つき ctor は private。本番で null を渡す呼び出しは無い（`TryGetView` の不整合の検査テストだけが null を渡す）
    - 読むのは `bool TryGetView(out CleanRoomInfoView view)` だけ。BlockNotFound なら false。`Kind` の読み分けはこの1か所に閉じる
    - wire から読んだ値なので、各 case で入れ子を確かめる。Enclosed で `Rooms` が null・0件・null 要素・`AirFilters` が null・分類済みなのに `ClassName` が null、NotEnclosed で `Leak` が null（または `Leak.TryGetView` が false）なら、`Debug.LogWarning` を出して false を返す。factory を通るサーバーの応答では起きない
  - `CleanRoomInfoView`（`abstract`、ctor は `private protected`）と種別ごとの型 `CleanRoomEnclosedView { IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> Rooms; }`（0件なら ctor が `ArgumentException`）・`CleanRoomNotEnclosedView { CleanRoomLeakView Leak; }`。どちらも `public` ctor を持つ（A8・A10 のテストが直接組む。種別ごとの型なので、種別と合わない値の組は作れない）。BlockNotFound はこの型に入らない
  - 漏れも種別ごとの読み口。`CleanRoomLeakView`（`abstract`、ctor は `private protected`）と `CleanRoomOpeningsLeakView { IReadOnlyList<Vector3IntMessagePack> OpeningCells; int TotalOpeningCount; }`・`CleanRoomTooLargeLeakView { int MaxRoomVolume; }`（この2つは `public` ctor）・`CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeakView.Instance`・`CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeakView.Instance`（中身なし）。漏れセルと総数は Openings、上限体積は TooLarge の型だけが持つ
  - `enum CleanRoomInfoResponseKind { Enclosed, NotEnclosed, BlockNotFound }`
  - `enum CleanRoomLeakResponseKind { Openings, NoEnclosure, TooLarge, DetectionPending }`
  - `enum CleanRoomClassResponseKind { Classified, Out }`
  - `CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack`:
    - wire のキーは `ClassKind`・`ClassName`・`ThresholdIndex`・`Concentration`・`AirChangeRate`・`Volume`・`AirFilters`
    - 組み立ては `CreateClassified(string className, int thresholdIndex, double concentration, double airChangeRate, int volume, List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> airFilters)` と `CreateOut(double concentration, double airChangeRate, int volume, List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> airFilters)` だけ
    - クラスは `bool TryGetClass(out string className, out int thresholdIndex)` で読む。Out なら false。ClassName を空文字で埋めない
  - `CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack(Vector3IntMessagePack position, double powerRatio, double removalVolumePerSecond, int filterItemCount, double filterRemainingRatio)`（種別を持たないので ctor のまま）
  - `CleanRoomLeakMessagePack`:
    - wire のキーは `Kind`・`OpeningCells`・`TotalOpeningCount`・`MaxRoomVolume`（平らな形のまま。`OpeningCells`・`TotalOpeningCount` は Openings、`MaxRoomVolume` は TooLarge のときだけ書かれる）
    - 判別子を持つので、外側・要約と同じく組み立ては種別ごとの static factory だけ: `CreateOpenings(List<Vector3IntMessagePack> openingCells, int totalOpeningCount)`・`CreateNoEnclosure()`・`CreateTooLarge(int maxRoomVolume)`・`CreateDetectionPending()`。引数つき ctor は private
    - 読むのは `bool TryGetView(out CleanRoomLeakView view)` だけ。Openings で `OpeningCells` が null なら `Debug.LogWarning` を出して false
  - `WorldQueryApi.GetCleanRoomInfo(BlockInstanceId, CancellationToken)` → `UniTask<GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack>`（通信失敗は null。既存の `GetGearNetworkInfo` と同じ）

列挙はサーバー側の型をそのまま載せず、プロトコル専用の型にする。MessagePack 型の公開シグネチャにはプリミティブとプロトコル専用の型しか出さない。こうすると、クライアント側のアセンブリは Game.CleanRoom を参照しなくてよい（前例: `GetElectricNetworkInfoProtocol.ElectricNetworkInfoSnapshot` がドメイン型を詰め替えている）。

wire（MessagePack のキー）は判別子と種別ごとのキーが並ぶ平らな形のままにする。MessagePack の `[Union]` はこのリポジトリに前例が無い。代わりに、組み立ては種別ごとの static factory、読み出しは `TryGetView`・`TryGetClass` の1か所に閉じ、呼び出し側は判別子と null を読まない。外側の応答・部屋の要約・内側の漏れの3つとも、この同じ形にする。

読み口（`CleanRoomInfoView`・`CleanRoomLeakView`）の中身は MessagePack 型（`CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack`・`Vector3IntMessagePack`）のままにし、Client.Game・Client.WebUiHost の公開シグネチャにもそれが出る。プロトコル外の読み取り型へもう一段詰め替えることはしない（前例: `BlockNetworkInfoCache.Electric` が `GetElectricNetworkInfoProtocol.ElectricNetworkInfoSnapshot` を直接公開し、webui ホストの DTO ビルダーがそれを読む）。判別子と入れ子の整合は `TryGetView` が確かめ、読み口の型は種別ごとに閉じているので、詰め替えを足しても閉じ方は変わらない。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Interface;

using MessagePack;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Server.Protocol;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;
using Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom;
using Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Server.PacketTest.CleanRoom
{
    public class GetCleanRoomInfoProtocolTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void EnclosedRoomIsReturnedWithAirFilterTest()
        {
            var packet = CreatePacket();
            CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();

            // 壁のIDで引くと、清浄機1台を持つ密閉済みの部屋の型が返る
            // Querying a wall ID returns the enclosed type holding one purifier
            var wall = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(new Vector3Int(0, 2, 2));
            Assert.IsTrue(Invoke(packet, wall.BlockInstanceId).TryGetView(out var view));
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomEnclosedView>(view);
            var rooms = ((CleanRoomEnclosedView)view).Rooms;
            Assert.AreEqual(1, rooms.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(26, rooms[0].Volume);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, rooms[0].AirFilters.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1), rooms[0].AirFilters[0].Position.Vector3Int);
            Assert.AreEqual(5, rooms[0].AirFilters[0].FilterItemCount);

            // 検出直後の部屋は Out なので、往復後もクラスは読めない
            // A freshly detected room is Out, so no class is readable after the round trip
            Assert.IsFalse(rooms[0].TryGetClass(out _, out _));
        }

        [Test]
        public void BreachedRoomReturnsOpeningCellsTest()
        {
            var packet = CreatePacket();
            var filter = CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.RemoveBlock(new Vector3Int(2, 2, 0), BlockRemoveReason.ManualRemove);
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();

            // 壁を1枚壊すと、清浄機から引いた応答は未密閉の型になり、壊した位置が漏れとして載る
            // Breaking one wall turns the purifier's response into the not-enclosed type carrying that cell as the leak
            Assert.IsTrue(Invoke(packet, filter.BlockInstanceId).TryGetView(out var view));
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomNotEnclosedView>(view);
            var leak = ((CleanRoomNotEnclosedView)view).Leak;
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomOpeningsLeakView>(leak);
            var openings = (CleanRoomOpeningsLeakView)leak;
            Assert.AreEqual(1, openings.TotalOpeningCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(new Vector3Int(2, 2, 0), openings.OpeningCells[0].Vector3Int);
        }

        [Test]
        public void UnknownBlockReturnsBlockNotFoundTest()
        {
            var packet = CreatePacket();

            // 存在しないブロックIDは BlockNotFound になり、部屋の型を返さない
            // A missing block ID becomes BlockNotFound and yields no room type
            var response = Invoke(packet, new BlockInstanceId(999999));
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.BlockNotFound, response.Kind);
            Assert.IsFalse(response.TryGetView(out _));
        }

        [Test]
        public void MalformedResponsesAreUnreadableWithWarningTest()
        {
            // 判別子と入れ子が合わない応答は、読み口を作らず警告して false を返す
            // A response whose discriminator and nested values disagree yields no view, logs a warning and returns false
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomInfo\] Enclosed response"));
            Assert.IsFalse(GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateEnclosed(new List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack>()).TryGetView(out _));

            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomInfo\] NotEnclosed response has no leak"));
            Assert.IsFalse(GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateNotEnclosed(null).TryGetView(out _));

            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomInfo\] Openings leak has no cells"));
            Assert.IsFalse(GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateNotEnclosed(CleanRoomLeakMessagePack.CreateOpenings(null, 3)).TryGetView(out _));
        }

        private static PacketResponseCreator CreatePacket()
        {
            var (packet, _) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            return packet;
        }

        private static GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack Invoke(PacketResponseCreator packet, BlockInstanceId id)
        {
            var request = new GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(id);
            var responseBytes = packet.GetPacketResponse(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(request), Tests.Util.PlayerIdentity.BoundPacketContext.Bind(1));
            return MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack>(responseBytes[0]);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using MessagePack;
using Server.Util.MessagePack;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    public enum CleanRoomInfoResponseKind
    {
        Enclosed,
        NotEnclosed,
        BlockNotFound,
    }

    public enum CleanRoomLeakResponseKind
    {
        Openings,
        NoEnclosure,
        TooLarge,
        DetectionPending,
    }

    public enum CleanRoomClassResponseKind
    {
        Classified,
        Out,
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     密閉できていない理由。組み立ては種別ごとの static factory、読み出しは TryGetView に閉じる
    ///     Why the structure is not sealed; built only through per-kind static factories and read only through TryGetView
    /// </summary>
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomLeakMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public CleanRoomLeakResponseKind Kind { get; set; }

        // OpeningCells（表示上限まで）と TotalOpeningCount は Openings、MaxRoomVolume は TooLarge のときだけ書かれる。読むのは TryGetView だけ
        // OpeningCells (capped for display) and TotalOpeningCount are written only for Openings, MaxRoomVolume only for TooLarge; only TryGetView reads them
        [Key(1)] public List<Vector3IntMessagePack> OpeningCells { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public int TotalOpeningCount { get; set; }
        [Key(3)] public int MaxRoomVolume { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomLeakMessagePack() { }

        private CleanRoomLeakMessagePack(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind kind)
        {
            Kind = kind;
        }

        public static CleanRoomLeakMessagePack CreateOpenings(List<Vector3IntMessagePack> openingCells, int totalOpeningCount)
        {
            return new CleanRoomLeakMessagePack(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.Openings) { OpeningCells = openingCells, TotalOpeningCount = totalOpeningCount };
        }

        public static CleanRoomLeakMessagePack CreateNoEnclosure()
        {
            return new CleanRoomLeakMessagePack(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.NoEnclosure);
        }

        public static CleanRoomLeakMessagePack CreateTooLarge(int maxRoomVolume)
        {
            return new CleanRoomLeakMessagePack(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.TooLarge) { MaxRoomVolume = maxRoomVolume };
        }

        public static CleanRoomLeakMessagePack CreateDetectionPending()
        {
            return new CleanRoomLeakMessagePack(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.DetectionPending);
        }

        // 判別子の読み分けはここだけ。wire から読んだ値なので、Openings のセル欠損は警告して false
        // The only place that branches on the discriminator; values come from the wire, so missing Openings cells warn and return false
        public bool TryGetView(out CleanRoomLeakView view)
        {
            switch (Kind)
            {
                case CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.Openings:
                    if (OpeningCells == null)
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"[GetCleanRoomInfo] Openings leak has no cells (total {TotalOpeningCount}); treating the response as unreadable");
                        view = default;
                        return false;
                    }

                    view = new CleanRoomOpeningsLeakView(OpeningCells, TotalOpeningCount);
                    return true;
                case CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.NoEnclosure:
                    view = CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeakView.Instance;
                    return true;
                case CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.TooLarge:
                    view = new CleanRoomTooLargeLeakView(MaxRoomVolume);
                    return true;
                case CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.DetectionPending:
                    view = CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeakView.Instance;
                    return true;
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(Kind), Kind, "未対応の漏れ種別 / Unsupported leak kind");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using MessagePack;
using Server.Util.MessagePack;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋1つの要約。組み立ては種別ごとの static factory、クラスの読み出しは TryGetClass に閉じる
    ///     Summary of one room; built only through per-kind static factories and read only through TryGetClass
    /// </summary>
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public CleanRoomClassResponseKind ClassKind { get; set; }

        // ClassName と ThresholdIndex は Classified のときだけ書かれる。読むのは TryGetClass だけ
        // ClassName and ThresholdIndex are written only when Classified; only TryGetClass reads them
        [Key(1)] public string ClassName { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public int ThresholdIndex { get; set; }
        [Key(3)] public double Concentration { get; set; }
        [Key(4)] public double AirChangeRate { get; set; }
        [Key(5)] public int Volume { get; set; }
        [Key(6)] public List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> AirFilters { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack() { }

        private CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack(CleanRoomClassResponseKind classKind, double concentration, double airChangeRate, int volume, List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> airFilters)
        {
            ClassKind = classKind;
            Concentration = concentration;
            AirChangeRate = airChangeRate;
            Volume = volume;
            AirFilters = airFilters;
        }

        public static CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack CreateClassified(string className, int thresholdIndex, double concentration, double airChangeRate, int volume, List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> airFilters)
        {
            return new CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack(CleanRoomClassResponseKind.Classified, concentration, airChangeRate, volume, airFilters) { ClassName = className, ThresholdIndex = thresholdIndex };
        }

        public static CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack CreateOut(double concentration, double airChangeRate, int volume, List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> airFilters)
        {
            return new CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack(CleanRoomClassResponseKind.Out, concentration, airChangeRate, volume, airFilters);
        }

        // Out なら false。判別子の読み分けはここだけで行う
        // False when Out; the only place that branches on the discriminator
        public bool TryGetClass(out string className, out int thresholdIndex)
        {
            switch (ClassKind)
            {
                case CleanRoomClassResponseKind.Classified:
                    className = ClassName;
                    thresholdIndex = ThresholdIndex;
                    return true;
                case CleanRoomClassResponseKind.Out:
                    className = default;
                    thresholdIndex = default;
                    return false;
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(ClassKind), ClassKind, "未対応のクラス種別 / Unsupported class kind");
            }
        }
    }

    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public Vector3IntMessagePack Position { get; set; }
        [Key(1)] public double PowerRatio { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public double RemovalVolumePerSecond { get; set; }
        [Key(3)] public int FilterItemCount { get; set; }
        [Key(4)] public double FilterRemainingRatio { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack() { }

        public CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack(Vector3IntMessagePack position, double powerRatio, double removalVolumePerSecond, int filterItemCount, double filterRemainingRatio)
        {
            Position = position;
            PowerRatio = powerRatio;
            RemovalVolumePerSecond = removalVolumePerSecond;
            FilterItemCount = filterItemCount;
            FilterRemainingRatio = filterRemainingRatio;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋照会の応答を種別ごとの型で読む口。BlockNotFound はこの型に入らず、取得側（ポーラー）が扱う
    ///     Per-kind read view of the room query response; BlockNotFound is not part of it and is handled by the fetcher (poller)
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomInfoView
    {
        // 種別はこのファイルの2つの型に閉じる
        // The kinds are closed to the two types in this file
        private protected CleanRoomInfoView()
        {
        }
    }

    public sealed class CleanRoomEnclosedView : CleanRoomInfoView
    {
        // 1件以上（共有壁なら複数）
        // One or more (several for a shared wall)
        public IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> Rooms { get; }

        public CleanRoomEnclosedView(IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> rooms)
        {
            if (rooms.Count == 0) throw new ArgumentException("密閉済みの読み口は部屋を1件以上持つ / An enclosed view holds at least one room", nameof(rooms));
            Rooms = rooms;
        }
    }

    public sealed class CleanRoomNotEnclosedView : CleanRoomInfoView
    {
        public CleanRoomLeakView Leak { get; }

        public CleanRoomNotEnclosedView(CleanRoomLeakView leak)
        {
            Leak = leak;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     漏れの応答を種別ごとの型で読む口。漏れセルと総数は Openings、上限体積は TooLarge の型だけが持つ
    ///     Per-kind read view of the leak response; only the openings type has cells and a total, only the too-large type has the volume cap
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomLeakView
    {
        // 種別はこのファイルの4つの型に閉じる
        // The kinds are closed to the four types in this file
        private protected CleanRoomLeakView()
        {
        }
    }

    public sealed class CleanRoomOpeningsLeakView : CleanRoomLeakView
    {
        // 表示上限まで。総数は TotalOpeningCount
        // Capped for display; the full count is TotalOpeningCount
        public IReadOnlyList<Vector3IntMessagePack> OpeningCells { get; }
        public int TotalOpeningCount { get; }

        public CleanRoomOpeningsLeakView(IReadOnlyList<Vector3IntMessagePack> openingCells, int totalOpeningCount)
        {
            OpeningCells = openingCells;
            TotalOpeningCount = totalOpeningCount;
        }
    }

    public sealed class CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeakView : CleanRoomLeakView
    {
        public static readonly CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeakView Instance = new CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeakView();

        private CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeakView()
        {
        }
    }

    public sealed class CleanRoomTooLargeLeakView : CleanRoomLeakView
    {
        // TooLarge の文言に出す部屋の上限体積
        // Room volume cap shown in the TooLarge message
        public int MaxRoomVolume { get; }

        public CleanRoomTooLargeLeakView(int maxRoomVolume)
        {
            MaxRoomVolume = maxRoomVolume;
        }
    }

    public sealed class CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeakView : CleanRoomLeakView
    {
        public static readonly CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeakView Instance = new CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeakView();

        private CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeakView()
        {
        }
    }
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Protocol/PacketResponse/CleanRoom/CleanRoomInfoMessagePackFactory.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Game.CleanRoom.Info;
using Game.CleanRoom.Util;
using Server.Util.MessagePack;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     サーバーの部屋照会結果をプロトコル専用の型へ詰め替える
    ///     Converts the server's room query result into protocol-only types
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomInfoMessagePackFactory
    {
        public static GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack CreateResponse(CleanRoomInfo info)
        {
            // 種別ごとの型をそのまま種別ごとの factory へ写す
            // Map each per-kind type onto its per-kind factory
            return info switch
            {
                CleanRoomEnclosedInfo enclosed => GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateEnclosed(enclosed.Rooms.Select(CreateSummary).ToList()),
                CleanRoomNotEnclosedInfo notEnclosed => GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateNotEnclosed(CreateLeak(notEnclosed.Leak)),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(info), info.GetType().Name, "未対応の部屋照会結果 / Unsupported room query result"),
            };
        }

        private static CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack CreateSummary(CleanRoomRoomSummary room)
        {
            var filters = room.AirFilters.Select(filter => new CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack(
                new Vector3IntMessagePack(filter.Position),
                filter.Status.PowerRatio,
                filter.Status.RemovalVolumePerSecond,
                filter.Status.FilterItemCount,
                filter.Status.CurrentFilterRemainingRatio)).ToList();
            return room.Class switch
            {
                CleanRoomClassifiedStanding classified => CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack.CreateClassified(classified.ClassName, classified.ThresholdIndex, room.Concentration, room.AirChangeRate, room.Volume, filters),
                CleanRoomOutStanding _ => CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack.CreateOut(room.Concentration, room.AirChangeRate, room.Volume, filters),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(room.Class), room.Class.GetType().Name, "未対応のクラス種別 / Unsupported class standing"),
            };
        }

        private static CleanRoomLeakMessagePack CreateLeak(CleanRoomLeakReport leak)
        {
            // 種別ごとの型を種別ごとの factory へ写す。上限体積は TooLarge のときだけ載せる
            // Map each per-kind type onto its per-kind factory; the volume cap goes only with TooLarge
            return leak switch
            {
                CleanRoomOpeningsLeak openings => CleanRoomLeakMessagePack.CreateOpenings(openings.OpeningCells.Select(cell => new Vector3IntMessagePack(cell)).ToList(), openings.TotalOpeningCount),
                CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeak _ => CleanRoomLeakMessagePack.CreateNoEnclosure(),
                CleanRoomTooLargeLeak _ => CleanRoomLeakMessagePack.CreateTooLarge(CleanRoomCellSets.MaxRoomVolume),
                CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeak _ => CleanRoomLeakMessagePack.CreateDetectionPending(),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(leak), leak.GetType().Name, "未対応の漏れ種別 / Unsupported leak kind"),
            };
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Protocol/PacketResponse/CleanRoom/GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.CleanRoom;
using Game.CleanRoom.Info;
using Game.Context;
using MessagePack;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    // 指定ブロックから見たクリーンルームの状態（部屋の要約または漏れ箇所）を取得するプロトコル
    // Protocol fetching the clean-room state seen from a block: room summaries or leak cells
    public class GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol : IPacketResponse
    {
        public const string ProtocolTag = "va:getCleanRoomInfo";

        private readonly CleanRoomInfoQuery _query;

        public GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol(ServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            _query = new CleanRoomInfoQuery(serviceProvider.GetService<CleanRoomDatastore>(), ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore);
        }

        public ProtocolMessagePackBase GetResponse(byte[] payload, int requesterPlayerId)
        {
            var request = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack>(payload);

            // 照会の間にブロックが壊れていれば BlockNotFound を返し、クライアントのポーラーが警告を出す
            // If the block was removed before the query, return BlockNotFound so the client's poller logs a warning
            var block = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(request.BlockInstanceId);
            if (block == null) return ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateBlockNotFound();

            return CleanRoomInfoMessagePackFactory.CreateResponse(_query.Query(block));
        }

        #region MessagePack

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack : ProtocolMessagePackBase
        {
            [Key(2)] public BlockInstanceId BlockInstanceId { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack() { }

            public RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId)
            {
                Tag = ProtocolTag;
                BlockInstanceId = blockInstanceId;
            }
        }

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack : ProtocolMessagePackBase
        {
            // wire は判別子と種別ごとのキーが並ぶ平らな形。組み立ては下の factory、読み出しは TryGetView だけ
            // The wire is flat with a discriminator and per-kind keys; build only via the factories below and read only via TryGetView
            [Key(2)] public CleanRoomInfoResponseKind Kind { get; set; }
            [Key(3)] public List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> Rooms { get; set; }
            [Key(4)] public CleanRoomLeakMessagePack Leak { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack() { }

            private ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind kind)
            {
                Tag = ProtocolTag;
                Kind = kind;
                Rooms = new List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack>();
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack CreateEnclosed(List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> rooms)
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.Enclosed) { Rooms = rooms };
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack CreateNotEnclosed(CleanRoomLeakMessagePack leak)
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.NotEnclosed) { Leak = leak };
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack CreateBlockNotFound()
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.BlockNotFound);
            }

            // BlockNotFound なら false。判別子の読み分けはここだけで行う
            // False for BlockNotFound; the only place that branches on the discriminator
            public bool TryGetView(out CleanRoomInfoView view)
            {
                view = default;
                switch (Kind)
                {
                    case CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.Enclosed:
                        // wire から読んだ部屋一覧が空・欠損なら、密閉済みの型を作らず警告して読めないことにする
                        // If the room list read from the wire is empty or broken, build no enclosed view, warn and report it unreadable
                        if (!AreReadableRooms())
                        {
                            Debug.LogWarning($"[GetCleanRoomInfo] Enclosed response has no or broken rooms (count {Rooms?.Count ?? 0}); treating it as unreadable");
                            return false;
                        }

                        view = new CleanRoomEnclosedView(Rooms);
                        return true;
                    case CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.NotEnclosed:
                        if (Leak == null)
                        {
                            Debug.LogWarning("[GetCleanRoomInfo] NotEnclosed response has no leak; treating it as unreadable");
                            return false;
                        }

                        // 漏れの中身の欠損は Leak.TryGetView が警告する
                        // Leak.TryGetView warns about missing leak contents
                        if (!Leak.TryGetView(out var leakView)) return false;
                        view = new CleanRoomNotEnclosedView(leakView);
                        return true;
                    case CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.BlockNotFound:
                        return false;
                    default:
                        throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(Kind), Kind, "未対応の部屋照会の種別 / Unsupported room query kind");
                }

                #region Internal

                bool AreReadableRooms()
                {
                    if (Rooms == null || Rooms.Count == 0) return false;
                    foreach (var room in Rooms)
                    {
                        if (room == null || room.AirFilters == null) return false;
                        if (room.ClassKind == CleanRoomClassResponseKind.Classified && room.ClassName == null) return false;
                    }

                    return true;
                }

                #endregion
            }
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using Game.Context;
using MessagePack;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    public class CleanRoomMachineOperabilityTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void MachineOutsideAnyRoomReportsNotEnclosedTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var machine = CleanRoomHatchTest.PlaceBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.CleanRoomMachineId, new Vector3Int(10, 0, 10));
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();

            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed, ReadOperability(machine));
        }

        [Test]
        public void OperabilityFollowsRoomClassAndBreachTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = CleanRoomHatchTest.PlaceBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.CleanRoomMachineId, new Vector3Int(2, 1, 1));
            var notifications = 0;
            machine.GetComponent<CleanRoomOperabilityStateComponent>().OnChangeBlockState.Subscribe(_ => notifications++);

            // 検出直後の部屋はOutから始まるので、クラス不足として止まる
            // A freshly detected room starts at Out, so the machine halts for an insufficient class
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomOperability.ClassOut, ReadOperability(machine));

            // 清浄機を回してクラスに届けば稼働可になる
            // Running the purifier until a class is reached makes the machine operable
            for (var i = 0; i < 3000 && ReadOperability(machine) != CleanRoomOperability.Operable; i++) TickRoom(filter, machine);
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomOperability.Operable, ReadOperability(machine));

            // 壁を壊すと未密閉に変わる
            // Breaking a wall turns it to not enclosed
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.RemoveBlock(new Vector3Int(2, 2, 0), BlockRemoveReason.ManualRemove);
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed, ReadOperability(machine));

            // 毎tick同じ値を押し込んでも、通知は変化した3回だけ
            // Although the same value is pushed every tick, only the three changes notify
            Assert.AreEqual(3, notifications);
        }

        private static CleanRoomOperability ReadOperability(IBlock machine)
        {
            var bytes = machine.GetBlockState().CurrentStateDetails[CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail.BlockStateDetailKey];
            return MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail>(bytes).Operability;
        }
    }
}
```

`CleanRoomEffect.cs` は次の全文にする:

```csharp
namespace Game.Block.Interface.Component
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     クリーンルームが内部の機械へ押し込む稼働可否と品質効果
    ///     Operate permission and quality effect a clean room pushes into interior machines
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct CleanRoomEffect
    {
        // 密閉部屋内かつ閾値行がOutでないときだけ Operable。止まる理由も区別して持つ
        // Operable only inside a sealed room whose row is not Out; the halt reason is kept distinct
        public readonly CleanRoomOperability Operability;
        public readonly int MaxChipLevel;
        public readonly double DownBinRate;

        public bool CanOperate => Operability == CleanRoomOperability.Operable;

        public CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability operability, int maxChipLevel, double downBinRate)
        {
            Operability = operability;
            MaxChipLevel = maxChipLevel;
            DownBinRate = downBinRate;
        }
    }
}
```

`CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent.cs:45` と `CleanRoomChipDrawDecorator.cs:21` の初期値は、それぞれ1行で置き換える:

```csharp

```

`CleanRoomMachineEffectService.PushEffects` のループ本体は、次のとおり3分岐にする。Out の判定は A5 の `room.TryGetClassRow` に任せ、`OutThresholdIndex` との比較をここに書かない。`MasterHolder` を使わなくなるので `using Core.Master;` を消す:

```csharp
            foreach (var entry in _machines.Values)
            {
                if (entry.Machine.IsDestroy) continue;

                // 部屋未検出なら未密閉として最悪効果を押し込み停止させる
                // Without a detected room, push the worst effect as not enclosed so the machine halts
                if (!tryGetRoom(entry.Block, out var room))
                {
                    entry.Machine.SetCleanRoomEffect(new CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed, 0, 0));
                    continue;
                }

                // 部屋はあるがOut行なら、クラス不足として停止させる
                // A room on the Out row halts the machine for an insufficient class
                if (!room.TryGetClassRow(out var row))
                {
                    entry.Machine.SetCleanRoomEffect(new CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability.ClassOut, 0, 0));
                    continue;
                }

                // 非Out行のマスタ効果だけを稼働許可として機械へ渡す
                // Only non-Out threshold master effects grant machine operation
                entry.Machine.SetCleanRoomEffect(new CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability.Operable, row.MaxChipLevel, row.DownBinRate));
            }
```

```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using MessagePack;

namespace Game.Block.Interface.State

    /// <summary>
    ///     クリーンルーム機械の稼働可否（停止理由の表示用）
    ///     Clean-room machine operability, used to show the halt reason
    /// </summary>
    [Serializable]
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail
    {
        public const string BlockStateDetailKey = "CleanRoomOperability";

        [Key(0)] public CleanRoomOperability Operability;

        public CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail(CleanRoomOperability operability)
        {
            Operability = operability;
        }

        public static BlockStateDetail CreateState(CleanRoomOperability operability)
        {
            return new BlockStateDetail(BlockStateDetailKey, MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(new CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail(operability)));
        }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail() { }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/CleanRoomOperabilityStateComponent.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using UniRx;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    // 部屋から押し込まれた稼働可否を保持し、変化したときだけブロック状態として通知する
    // Holds the operability pushed by the room and notifies a block state change only when it changes
    public class CleanRoomOperabilityStateComponent : IBlockStateObservable
    {
        public IObservable<Unit> OnChangeBlockState => _onChangeBlockState;
        private readonly Subject<Unit> _onChangeBlockState = new();

        // 部屋の効果が届く前は、効果の既定値と同じく未密閉として扱う
        // Before any room effect arrives, treat the machine as not enclosed like the effect default
        public CleanRoomOperability Operability { get; private set; } = CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed;

        public void SetOperability(CleanRoomOperability operability)
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);

            // 毎tick同じ値が届くため、変化したときだけ通知する
            // The same value arrives every tick, so notify only on change
            if (Operability == operability) return;
            Operability = operability;
            _onChangeBlockState.OnNext(Unit.Default);
        }

        public BlockStateDetail[] GetBlockStateDetails()
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);
            return new[] { CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail.CreateState(Operability) };
        }

        public bool IsDestroy { get; private set; }

        public void Destroy()
        {
            IsDestroy = true;
            _onChangeBlockState.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

`if (Operability == operability) return;` の早期 return は、同じ値の再設定を捨てる正常経路である。拒否や縮退ではないのでログは出さない。
