`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Game/InGame/CleanRoom/CleanRoomBoundaryHoverService.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using Client.Game.InGame.Block;
using Client.Game.InGame.BlockInfoPolling;
using Client.Game.InGame.Control;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.Tooltip;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;
using UniRx;
using static Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule.BlockMasterElement;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     壁・ドア・ハッチへの照準を追い、部屋の要約ツールチップと漏れマーカーを出す
    ///     Follows the aim on walls, doors and hatches, showing the room summary tooltip and leak markers
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomBoundaryHoverService
    {
        private readonly CleanRoomTooltipPresenter _tooltipPresenter;
        private readonly CleanRoomLeakMarkerVisualizer _markers = new();
        private readonly BlockInfoPoller<GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack, CleanRoomInfoView> _poller = CleanRoomInfoPollSource.CreatePoller();
        private BlockGameObject _trackingBlock;
        private TooltipLine[] _currentLines = Array.Empty<TooltipLine>();

        public CleanRoomBoundaryHoverService(IMouseCursorTooltip tooltip)
        {
            _tooltipPresenter = new CleanRoomTooltipPresenter(tooltip);

            // 取得済み・消失に変わったときだけ、行と印を作り直す
            // Rebuild the lines and markers only when the poll becomes fetched or vanished
            _poller.OnUpdated.Subscribe(_ => OnRoomInfoUpdated());
        }

        public void ManualUpdate()
        {
            // 照準中の境界ブロックが変わったときだけ照会を張り直す
            // Restart the query only when the aimed boundary block changes
            var hovered = TryGetHoveredBoundary(out var block) ? block : null;
            if (!ReferenceEquals(hovered, _trackingBlock))
            {
                StopTracking();
                if (hovered == null) return;
                _trackingBlock = hovered;
                _poller.Start(hovered.BlockInstanceId);
            }

            // 他の書き手が消えた後でも出し直せるよう、手元の最新行で毎フレーム判定する
            // Re-evaluate every frame with the latest lines so we reappear once another writer hides
            if (_currentLines.Length > 0) _tooltipPresenter.Present(_currentLines);
        }

        public void Disable()
        {
            StopTracking();
        }

        private void OnRoomInfoUpdated()
        {
            // 消失なら表示を消す。消失の警告はポーラーが出している
            // On vanishing, clear the display; the poller already logged the warning
            if (!_poller.TryGetSnapshot(out var view))
            {
                ClearDisplay();
                return;
            }

            _currentLines = CleanRoomTooltipLines.Build(view);
            _tooltipPresenter.Present(_currentLines);

            // 隙間があるときだけ、そのセルに印を出す
            // Mark the gap cells only when openings exist
            if (view is CleanRoomNotEnclosedView { Leak: CleanRoomOpeningsLeakView openings }) _markers.Show(openings.OpeningCells);
            else _markers.HideAll();
        }

        private void StopTracking()
        {
            _poller.Stop();
            _trackingBlock = null;
            ClearDisplay();
        }

        private void ClearDisplay()
        {
            _currentLines = Array.Empty<TooltipLine>();
            _tooltipPresenter.Hide();
            _markers.HideAll();
        }

        private static bool TryGetHoveredBoundary(out BlockGameObject block)
        {
            if (!BlockClickDetectUtil.TryGetCursorOnBlock(out block)) return false;
            var blockType = block.BlockMasterElement.BlockType;
            return blockType == BlockTypeConst.CleanRoomWall || blockType == BlockTypeConst.CleanRoomDoor ||
                   blockType == BlockTypeConst.CleanRoomItemHatch || blockType == BlockTypeConst.CleanRoomPipeHatch;
        }
    }
}
```

`BlockTypeConst` は blocks.yml から生成される型。クリーンルームパネル（A4）も `CleanRoomWall` 型なので、どの向きに置いてもこの判定で拾える。

### Task A11: unity プレイ録画テスト「パネルで部屋を建てて入る・フィルター投入・状態UI表示」

**Files:**
- Create: `.agents/skills/unity-playmode-recorded-playtest/scenarios/misc/cleanroom-room-usability.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: A1〜A10・A13・A14 のすべて（master は `$MW/server_v8`。A2〜A4・A14 のピンのうち最後のものが指すコミット）
- Produces: `result.json` の `Success: true` と録画（RA1・RA5・RA6・RA11〜RA15 の受け入れ）

**シナリオの配置**（座標はすべてセル。地面の上面は y=32）:
- 床: 「クリーンルームパネル」を北向き（水平）で x=-2..8, z=-6..8, y=32 に並べる。
  - 板はセルの上端にあるので、立つ高さは y=33.0。
  - 室外まで広げるのは、ドアの前まで同じ高さで歩けるようにするため。
- 壁（y=33..34 の x=0..6, z=0..6 の外周。ドアの2セル (3,33..34,0) は空ける）: 板が室内側の面に来る向きでパネルを縦に置く。
  - 西 x=0 は UpWest（板は x=0.95 の面）。A13 で直す向き。
  - 南 z=0 は UpSouth（板は z=0.95 の面）。A13 で直す向き。
  - 東 x=6 は DownEast（板は x=0.05 の面）。ただし (6,33,4) の1枚は、ビルドメニューで選んで Shift+R で縦にし、クリックで置く。
  - 北 z=6 は「クリーンルームブロック」。パネルと壁ブロックを混ぜても部屋になることを見せる。
- 天井: パネルを北向き（水平）で x=0..6, z=0..6, y=35 に並べる。
- 清浄機は (1,33,5)、EUV は (3,33,3)（3×2×3）、発電機は (-15,32,-15)。給電は cleanroom-v2 と同じ。

**向きを変えて置く操作の前例:**
- `scenarios/misc/sprint/sprint-toggle-mode.cs:88-91` は、`SemanticInput.KeyDown(Key.LeftShift)` → `p.PressKey(Key.R)` → `KeyUp` で設置中の向きを鉛直に回している。
- 通常ブロックの Shift+R は、水平回転の後に鉛直回転する（`PlacementDirectionKeyInput.cs:17-24`）。初期向き North なら UpEast になる。
- 置いた向きはサーバーのブロック（`IBlock.BlockPositionInfo.BlockDirection`）で確かめる。設置システムの内部状態は読まない。
- `PlaceBlockDirect` は向きを引数に取るので、縦向きの壁はそれで並べる。

- [ ] **Step 1: シナリオを書く**

`.agents/skills/unity-playmode-recorded-playtest/scenarios/misc/cleanroom-room-usability.cs`:

```csharp
// シナリオ: パネルを床・壁・天井に使いドアで部屋を建て、ドアを歩いて通り、清浄機のUIでフィルターを入れ、部屋欄とツールチップと漏れ表示を確かめる
// Scenario: build a room using panels as floor, walls and ceiling plus a door, walk through it, load filters via the purifier UI, then check the room section, tooltip and leak display
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Client.Game.InGame.CleanRoom;
using Client.Game.InGame.Context;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.Inventory.Main;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.Tooltip;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.UIState;
using Client.Playtest;
using Client.Playtest.Input;
using Client.Playtest.Operations;
using Core.Master;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using Game.Block.Blocks.PowerGenerator;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom;
using Game.EnergySystem;
using Game.Fluid;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse.Util.ElectricWire.Connection;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;

const string PanelName = "クリーンルームパネル";
var outsidePosition = new Vector3(3.5f, 33.5f, -3.5f); // ドア正面の室外（床の上）
var doorAimPoint = new Vector3(3.5f, 34f, 0.5f); // 1×2×1 ドアの中心
var breachCell = new Vector3Int(6, 33, 3); // 後で外す東の壁
var uiPanelCell = new Vector3Int(6, 33, 4); // Shift+R で縦にして UI で置く東の壁

var options = new PlaytestRunOptions { Record = true };
return PlaytestRunner.Run("cleanroom-room-usability", options, async p =>
{
    await p.SkipOpeningSkitIfPlaying();
    await p.Until(() => p.CurrentUiState == UIStateEnum.GameScreen, 15f, "GameScreenに到達");
    await p.SetupFlatGround();

    // 開始位置(0,33.5,0)は壁の角になるので、建てる前に室外へ退く。床は室外まで北向き(水平)のパネルで敷く
    // The spawn (0,33.5,0) becomes a wall corner, so step outside first; the floor is north-facing (flat) panels reaching outdoors
    p.WarpPlayer(outsidePosition);
    for (var x = -2; x <= 8; x++)
    for (var z = -6; z <= 8; z++)
        p.PlaceBlockDirect(PanelName, new Vector3Int(x, 32, z), BlockDirection.North);
    await p.WaitBlockGameObject(new Vector3Int(6, 32, 4));
    await p.WaitSeconds(1f);

    #region パネルを Shift+R で縦にして UI で置く / Stand a panel upright with Shift+R and place it via the UI
    p.WarpPlayer(new Vector3(4.5f, 33.5f, 1.5f));
    await p.PrepareBlockForUiPlacement(PanelName, 1);
    await p.OpenBuildMenuAndSelectBlock(PanelName);
    SemanticInput.KeyDown(Key.LeftShift);
    await p.WaitSeconds(0.5f);
    await p.PressKey(Key.R);
    SemanticInput.KeyUp(Key.LeftShift);
    await p.AimAt(new Vector3(6.5f, 33f, 4.5f));
    await p.ClickPlace();
    await p.Until(() => p.GetBlock(uiPanelCell) != null, 15f, "UIで置いたパネルがサーバーに載った");
    var uiPanelDirection = p.GetBlock(uiPanelCell).BlockPositionInfo.BlockDirection;
    p.Assert(IsUpright(uiPanelDirection), $"Shift+Rでパネルが縦向き(Up*/Down*)になった(向き={uiPanelDirection})");
    await p.ExitToGameScreen();
    #endregion

    // 東西南の壁は板が室内側に来る縦向きのパネル、北の壁は壁ブロック、天井は北向きのパネルにする
    // East/west/south walls are upright panels with the plate facing inside, the north wall is wall blocks, the ceiling is north-facing panels
    p.WarpPlayer(outsidePosition);
    for (var x = 0; x <= 6; x++)
    for (var z = 0; z <= 6; z++)
    {
        p.PlaceBlockDirect(PanelName, new Vector3Int(x, 35, z), BlockDirection.North);
        if (x != 0 && x != 6 && z != 0 && z != 6) continue;
        for (var y = 33; y <= 34; y++)
        {
            var cell = new Vector3Int(x, y, z);
            if ((x == 3 && z == 0) || cell == uiPanelCell) continue;
            if (x == 0) p.PlaceBlockDirect(PanelName, cell, BlockDirection.UpWest);
            else if (x == 6) p.PlaceBlockDirect(PanelName, cell, BlockDirection.DownEast);
            else if (z == 0) p.PlaceBlockDirect(PanelName, cell, BlockDirection.UpSouth);
            else p.PlaceBlockDirect("クリーンルームブロック", cell, BlockDirection.North);
        }
    }
    p.PlaceBlockDirect("クリーンルームドア", new Vector3Int(3, 33, 0), BlockDirection.North);
    var filterBlock = p.PlaceBlockDirect("クリーンルーム空気清浄機", new Vector3Int(1, 33, 5), BlockDirection.North);
    var machineBlock = p.PlaceBlockDirect("EUV露光式半導体製造装置", new Vector3Int(3, 33, 3), BlockDirection.North);
    WirePower(filterBlock, machineBlock);
    await p.WaitBlockGameObject(new Vector3Int(3, 33, 0));

    // 床(水平)・西(UpWest)・南(UpSouth)・UIで置いた東(縦)の板が、それぞれ自分のセルの中に描かれる
    // The floor (flat), west (UpWest), south (UpSouth) and UI-placed east (upright) plates each render inside their own cell
    foreach (var (plateCell, upright) in new[] { (new Vector3Int(2, 32, 2), false), (new Vector3Int(0, 33, 2), true), (new Vector3Int(1, 33, 0), true), (uiPanelCell, true) })
        await AssertPanelPlateInCell(plateCell, upright);

    // 密閉された部屋が検出されるのを待つ（クラスは問わない）
    // Wait for the sealed room to be detected, whatever its class
    var datastore = p.ServerService<CleanRoomDatastore>();
    await p.Until(() => datastore.TryGetCleanRoom(machineBlock, out _), 15f, "部屋が検出された");
    await p.Screenshot("01-room-built");

    #region ドアを歩いて通る / Walk through the door
    p.WarpPlayer(outsidePosition);
    await p.WaitSeconds(1f);
    p.Assert(0.7f < Camera.main.transform.forward.z, "カメラが北(+z)＝ドアを向いている");
    SemanticInput.KeyDown(Key.W);
    await p.Until(() => 1.2f < p.PlayerPosition.z, 10f, "Wで歩いてドアを抜け室内(z>1.2)に入った");
    SemanticInput.KeyUp(Key.W);
    p.Note($"室内の位置={p.PlayerPosition}");
    await p.Screenshot("02-inside-room");
    #endregion

    #region 清浄機のUIでフィルターを入れる / Load filters through the purifier UI
    p.GiveItemDirect("クリーンルームフィルター", 5);
    var filterItemId = PlaytestItemOps.ResolveItemId("クリーンルームフィルター");
    var localInventory = ClientDIContext.DIContainer.DIContainerResolver.Resolve<ILocalPlayerInventory>();
    await p.Until(() => FindMainSlot(localInventory, filterItemId) >= 0, 10f, "フィルターがクライアントのインベントリに届いた");
    var filterSlot = FindMainSlot(localInventory, filterItemId);

    await p.AimAt(new Vector3(1.5f, 34f, 5.5f));
    await p.PressInteract();
    await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.SubInventory, 10f);
    await p.UntilWebUiElement("clean-room-filter-grid-slot-0", 10f);
    await p.ClickWebUi($"main-slot-{filterSlot}");
    await p.ClickWebUi("clean-room-filter-grid-slot-0");
    Core.Inventory.IOpenableInventory filterInventory = filterBlock.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
    await p.Until(() => filterInventory.GetItem(0).Id == filterItemId && filterInventory.GetItem(0).Count == 5, 10f, "フィルター5個がスロットに入った");
    await p.UntilWebUiElement("clean-room-section", 10f);
    await p.Screenshot("03-filter-loaded");
    await p.PressKey(Key.Tab);
    await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.GameScreen, 10f);
    #endregion

    #region EUV の部屋欄 / Room section of the EUV
    await p.AimAt(new Vector3(4.5f, 34f, 4.5f));
    await p.PressInteract();
    await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.SubInventory, 10f);
    await p.UntilWebUiElement("clean-room-section", 10f);
    await p.UntilWebUiElement("clean-room-headline", 10f);
    await p.Screenshot("04-euv-room-section");
    await p.PressKey(Key.Tab);
    await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.GameScreen, 10f);
    #endregion

    #region ドアのツールチップと漏れ表示 / Door tooltip and leak display
    p.WarpPlayer(outsidePosition);
    await p.WaitSeconds(1f);
    await p.AimAt(doorAimPoint);
    await p.Until(() => FirstTooltipKey() == LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomClass.Key || FirstTooltipKey() == LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomClassOut.Key, 5f, "ドアのツールチップ先頭行が部屋クラス");
    await p.Screenshot("05-door-tooltip-sealed");

    p.RemoveBlock(breachCell);
    await p.AimAt(doorAimPoint);
    await p.Until(() => FirstTooltipKey() == LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomNotSealed.Key, 10f, "壁を外すとドアのツールチップが未密閉になる");
    var expectedMarker = breachCell + new Vector3(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f);
    await p.Until(() => ActiveMarkers().Any(marker => Vector3.Distance(marker.position, expectedMarker) < 0.01f), 5f, "外した壁の位置に漏れマーカーが出た");
    p.Assert(ActiveMarkers().Length == 1, "漏れマーカーは外した1セルだけ");
    await p.Screenshot("06-door-tooltip-leak");
    #endregion

    #region ローカル関数 / Local functions
    bool IsUpright(BlockDirection direction) => Mathf.Abs((direction.GetRotation() * Vector3.up).y) < 0.5f;
    async UniTask AssertPanelPlateInCell(Vector3Int cell, bool expectUpright)
    {
        // 板の描画範囲がセルの中に収まり、縦なら高さ1・厚さ0.1、横なら高さ0.1になる
        // The plate's rendered bounds stay inside the cell: height 1 and thickness 0.1 when upright, height 0.1 when flat
        var blockObject = await p.WaitBlockGameObject(cell);
        var bounds = blockObject.GetComponentsInChildren<MeshRenderer>(true).First(renderer => renderer.gameObject.name == "PanelPlate").bounds;
        var cellBounds = new Bounds(cell + Vector3.one * 0.5f, Vector3.one * 1.02f);
        var insideCell = cellBounds.Contains(bounds.min) && cellBounds.Contains(bounds.max);
        var isUpright = 0.9f < bounds.size.y && Mathf.Min(bounds.size.x, bounds.size.z) < 0.15f;
        p.Assert(insideCell && isUpright == expectUpright, $"{cell} のパネルの板がセル内に{(expectUpright ? "縦" : "横")}で描かれる(bounds={bounds})");
    }
    int FindMainSlot(ILocalPlayerInventory inventory, ItemId itemId) =>
        Enumerable.Range(0, inventory.MainSlotCount).Where(i => inventory[i].Id == itemId && 0 < inventory[i].Count).DefaultIfEmpty(-1).First();
    string FirstTooltipKey()
    {
        var presentation = ClientDIContext.DIContainer.DIContainerResolver.Resolve<IMouseCursorTooltip>().GetPresentation();
        return presentation.Visible ? presentation.Lines[0].Key.Key : string.Empty;
    }
    Transform[] ActiveMarkers() => UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<MeshRenderer>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)
        .Where(renderer => renderer.gameObject.activeInHierarchy && renderer.gameObject.name == CleanRoomLeakMarkerVisualizer.MarkerName)
        .Select(renderer => renderer.transform).ToArray();
    void WirePower(IBlock filter, IBlock machine)
    {
        // cleanroom-v2 と同じく室外の発電機へ燃料を直接入れ、電線で清浄機と機械へ給電する
        // As in cleanroom-v2, fuel an outdoor generator directly and wire it to the purifier and machine
        var generatorBlock = p.PlaceBlockDirect("ガソリンエンジン発電機", new Vector3Int(-15, 32, -15), BlockDirection.North);
        var gasolineId = MasterHolder.FluidMaster.GetFluidId(new Guid("019eded2-7454-76da-8943-84c4e7a59179"));
        generatorBlock.GetComponent<VanillaElectricGeneratorComponent>().AddLiquid(new FluidStack(400, gasolineId), FluidContainer.Empty);
        var generatorConnector = generatorBlock.GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>();
        var (filterConnector, machineConnector) = (filter.GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>(), machine.GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>());
        var freeCost = new ConnectionLineRecord(Guid.Parse("872372d5-2998-4fb7-826c-593ceeafcfb2"), Array.Empty<ConnectToolMaterialCost>());
        p.Assert(ElectricWireSystemUtil.TryConnectBothSides(generatorConnector, filterConnector, freeCost), "電線 発電機→清浄機");
        p.Assert(ElectricWireSystemUtil.TryConnectBothSides(generatorConnector, machineConnector, freeCost), "電線 発電機→EUV");
        p.ServerService<IElectricWireNetworkDatastore>().RebuildAround(generatorConnector, filterConnector, machineConnector);
    }
    #endregion
});
```

- 床の外周 (x=-2..8, z=-6..8) は、発電機の占有 (x=-15..-9, z=-15..-3) と重ならない。
- UI で置く間の立ち位置 (4.5,33.5,1.5) は、照準先 (6.5,33,4.5) の南西にあり、置く位置から 3.6 マス。設置カメラは北向きなので、照準先は画面内に入る。
- 壁を外したときの漏れ探索の結果は、手で追って確かめてある（部屋判定はセルだけを見るので、パネルの向きは結果に影響しない）。
  - ドアの室内側の種 (3,33,1) では、6方向のレイが下・上・東・西・南（ドア）・北の境界セルに当たる。
  - 推定される箱は x0..6・y32..35・z0..6。
  - +x 面の露出セル (6,33,3) の外側の層 x=7 は、y=35 で箱の縁に届く。よって (6,33,3) だけが漏れになる。

Expected:
- 1行目と2行目のハッシュが一致する。
- 最後に表示される `result.json` が `"Success": true` で、`Asserts` がすべて `Passed: true`。

失敗したら、`result.json` の `Error` と該当スクショを見て、どのタスクの不具合かを切り分ける。
- Shift+R で縦にならない（UI で置いたパネルの向きが水平）→ 回転キーの注入が効いていない。`PlacementDirectionKeyInput` が読む `InputManager.Playable.BlockPlaceRotation` と `HybridInput.GetKey(KeyCode.LeftShift)` に注入が届くかを input-injection.md の手順で調べる。
- UI 設置がサーバーに載らない → 照準先がプレビューの面に当たっていない。A13 の設置面の種類か、床パネルの設置面（セル上面 y=33）を調べる。
- 板がセルの外に描かれる（`AssertPanelPlateInCell` の失敗）→ A13 のモデル原点。メッセージの bounds でずれの向きを見る。
- 歩いて入れない → A3（ドアのトリガー）か、パネルの板の高さ（A4。北向きの板の上面が y=33.0 か）。
- スロットのクリックが効かない → A9 の testid。
- ツールチップが出ない → A10 の所有者の調停。

切り分けた原因は、該当タスクのコミットに修正として足す。

## Part C: 機械の汎用機構

### Task C1: 品質モジュールの効き先制限

品質モジュールは `allowQualityModule: true` の機械（クリーンルームの成膜・EUV・ダイシング）にだけ置けて、効く。速度・省エネ・生産性はスロットを持つ全機械（クリーンルーム機械を含む）で従来どおり。品質の効果合計を読むのはクリーンルームの役割レシピの書き換え器（Part B）だけで、一般機械の出力を昇格させる汎用の品質シフト経路は C3 で撤去する。

**Files:**
- Modify: `VanillaSchema/blocks.yml`（defineInterface `IMachineParam` と、ElectricMachine・GearMachine・CleanRoomMachine の blockParam に `allowQualityModule` を足す）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/_CompileRequester.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Inventory/MachineSlotPlacementCheck.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Inventory/VanillaMachineModuleInventory.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Module/MachineModuleEffectComponent.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Factory/BlockTemplate/BlockTemplateUtil.cs:70-72`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests.Module/TestMod/ForUnitTest/mods/forUnitTest/master/blocks.json`
- Modify: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/EditModeInPlayingTest/ServerData/mods/EditModeInPlayingTestMod/master/blocks.json`

- [ ] **Step 1: テストを書く**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/Upgrade/MachineModuleQualityRestrictionTest.cs`（新規ディレクトリ `Upgrade/` を作る。Part C のサーバーテストはここへまとめる）

```csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Game.PlayerInventory.Interface;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse.Util.InventoryService;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     品質モジュールが allowQualityModule の機械にだけ置けて効くことを検証する
    ///     Verifies quality modules are placeable and effective only on machines with allowQualityModule
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineModuleQualityRestrictionTest
    {
        // TestElectricMachine（許可）と TestGearMachine（不許可）はどちらも入力2・出力3・モジュール4
        // TestElectricMachine (allowed) and TestGearMachine (disallowed) both have 2 inputs, 3 outputs and 4 module slots
        private const int ModuleRangeStart = 5;
        private const int PlayerId = 1;

        [Test]
        public void QualityModulePlacementFollowsMachinePermissionTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var gearInventory = PlaceInventory(ForUnitTestModBlockId.GearMachine, new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            var electricInventory = PlaceInventory(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId, new Vector3Int(5, 1, 1));

            // 不許可機械は品質だけを拒否し、速度と非モジュールは従来どおり置ける
            // A disallowed machine refuses only quality; speed and non-module items stay placeable as before
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.ModuleNotAllowedOnMachine, gearInventory.CheckPlacement(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality)));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed, gearInventory.CheckPlacement(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed)));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed, gearInventory.CheckPlacement(ModuleRangeStart, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(ForUnitTestItemId.ItemId4, 1)));

            // 許可機械は品質を受け入れる
            // An allowed machine accepts quality
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed, electricInventory.CheckPlacement(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void QualityModuleMoveIntoDisallowedMachineIsRejectedTest()
        {
            var (_, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var mainInventory = serviceProvider.GetService<IPlayerInventoryDataStore>().GetInventoryData(PlayerId).MainOpenableInventory;
            var gearInventory = PlaceInventory(ForUnitTestModBlockId.GearMachine, new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            var qualityModule = CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality);
            mainInventory.SetItem(0, qualityModule);

            // 移動は拒否され、モジュールはプレイヤー側に残る
            // The move is refused and the module stays with the player
            var result = InventoryItemMoveService.Move(mainInventory, 0, gearInventory, ModuleRangeStart, 1);
            Assert.AreEqual(InventoryItemMoveResult.RejectedByDestination, result);
            Assert.AreEqual(qualityModule.Id, mainInventory.GetItem(0).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(ItemMaster.EmptyItemId, gearInventory.GetItem(ModuleRangeStart).Id);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DisallowedQualityModuleIsExcludedFromEffectTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.GearMachine, new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1), BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            var inventory = block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();

            // セーブ由来を模して判定を通さずに書き込んでも、効果にもトレードオフにも数えない
            // Even when written without the check (as a save would), it counts toward neither the effect nor its tradeoff
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality));
            var effect = block.GetComponent<MachineModuleEffectComponent>().AggregateCurrent();
            Assert.AreEqual(0f, effect.QualityShift, 0.0001f);
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, effect.ProcessingTimeMultiplier, 0.0001f);
        }

        private static VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent PlaceInventory(BlockId blockId, Vector3Int position)
        {
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(blockId, position, BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            return block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();
        }

        private static IItemStack CreateModule(string effectAxis)
        {
            var module = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules.First(m => m.EffectAxis == effectAxis);
            return ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(module.ItemGuid, 1);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     機械スロットへの配置判定結果。拒否時はログで原因を区別できるよう理由ごとに値を分ける
    ///     Result of a machine slot placement check; rejections carry distinct reasons so logs can tell them apart
    /// </summary>
    public enum MachineSlotPlacementCheck
    {
        Allowed,
        RecipeNotSelected,
        ItemNotBoundToSlot,
        SlotBeyondRecipeOutputs,
        ModuleNotAllowedOnMachine,
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: モジュールインベントリに効き先の判定を持たせる**

`VanillaMachineModuleInventory.cs` 全体:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Event;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Event;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     機械のモジュールスロット（統合スロットの第3レンジ）
    ///     The machine's module slots (third range in unified numbering)
    /// </summary>
    public class VanillaMachineModuleInventory : IVanillaMachineSubInventory
    {
        public IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> ModuleSlot => _itemDataStoreService.InventoryItems;
        IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> IVanillaMachineSubInventory.Items => ModuleSlot;

        private readonly OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService _itemDataStoreService;
        private readonly bool _allowQualityModule;

        public VanillaMachineModuleInventory(
            int moduleSlotCount,
            bool allowQualityModule,
            BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEvent blockInventoryUpdate,
            BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId,
            int inputSlotSize,
            int outputSlotSize)
        {
            _allowQualityModule = allowQualityModule;
            _itemDataStoreService = new OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService(InvokeEvent, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory, moduleSlotCount);

            #region Internal

            void InvokeEvent(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)
            {
                // 第3レンジのためオフセットを加算して通知
                // Offset by the first two ranges when notifying
                blockInventoryUpdate.OnInventoryUpdateInvoke(new BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEventProperties(
                    blockInstanceId, slot + inputSlotSize + outputSlotSize, itemStack));
            }

            #endregion
        }

        public void SetItem(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            _itemDataStoreService.SetItem(slot, itemStack);
        }

        // 不許可の品質モジュールだけを拒否する。非モジュールは従来どおり置ける（効果集計が無視する）
        // Refuse only a disallowed quality module; non-module items stay placeable as before (the aggregation ignores them)
        public MachineSlotPlacementCheck CheckPlacement(int localSlot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            if (itemStack.Id == ItemMaster.EmptyItemId) return MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed;
            var module = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetModuleByItemIdOrNull(itemStack.Id);
            if (module == null) return MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed;
            return IsModuleEffective(module) ? MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed : MachineSlotPlacementCheck.ModuleNotAllowedOnMachine;
        }

        // この機械で効くモジュールか。品質は許可された機械だけで効く
        // Whether the module works on this machine; quality works only where allowed
        public bool IsModuleEffective(ModuleMasterElement module)
        {
            return _allowQualityModule || module.EffectAxis != ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality;
        }

        public void SetItemWithoutEvent(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            _itemDataStoreService.SetItemWithoutEvent(slot, itemStack);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task C2: レベル継承レシピの宣言と検証

機械レシピの必須キー `levelInheritance` を足し、継承元・継承先を引く util と検証を用意する。テストマスタに継承の最小例（別ファミリー間の継承・上限つき継承）を入れる。実行時の挙動は C3。

**Files:**
- Modify: `VanillaSchema/machineRecipes.yml`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/_CompileRequester.cs`
- Create: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/MachineUpgrade/LevelInheritanceShape.cs`
- Create: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.cs`

- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Core/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceValidatorTest.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: なし（C1 の後に着手する。テストマスタの機械ブロックは C1 の必須キー `allowQualityModule` を持っている前提で、Step 6 の複製もそれを引き継ぐ）
- Produces（Part B・S2・統合タスク（旧 Part D） が使う宣言方法）:
  - スキーマ: 機械レシピの必須キー `"levelInheritance": "None" | "Inherit" | "InheritUpToUnlocked"`。生成定数は `MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.None` / `.Inherit` / `.InheritUpToUnlocked`、プロパティは `string MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritance`
  - 継承の規則（検証が強制する）: 継承レシピは「levelFamily の基準アイテムを指す入力」がちょうど1つ（継承元）、「levelFamily の基準アイテムを指す出力」がちょうど1つ（継承先）。継承元と継承先は別ファミリーでよい（ICチップ→モジュール・GPU）。継承先ファミリーの長さ ≥ 継承元ファミリーの長さ（等しくてよい）。同じ継承先ファミリーを指す継承レシピの間で `Inherit` と `InheritUpToUnlocked` を混ぜない。他の入力は levelFamily の基準であってはならない（固定素材はファミリーを持たないアイテムで書く）。他の出力は基準でなければ何でもよく、継承先と同じファミリーの非基準の変種やファミリー外のアイテムを並べてよい（ダイシングの出力「ダイ基準1つ＋ダイ Lv2..LvN＋失敗ダイ」はこの形で通る。`DicingShapedOutputsOnQualityMachinePassTest`）。機械の `allowQualityModule` は見ない（品質可の EUV・ダイシングにも継承レシピを置ける）
  - 実行時に継承レベルが移るのは継承先の出力1つだけ（C3）。他の出力は書いたアイテムのまま出て、Part B の書き換え器が必要なら差し替える
  - 使い分け: チップ製品（モジュール・GPU）は `InheritUpToUnlocked`（初期上限 Lv1、C7 の研究で上げる）。ダイ→チップのパッケージングは `Inherit`（上限なし）
  - 置き場: 実行時の解釈（サーバーの束縛・実現出力・返却・ゲートとクライアントの表示が使う）は `Game.Block.Interface/MachineUpgrade/`（namespace `Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade`。前例 `Game.Block.Interface/Extension/BeltConveyorPlaceFamilyUtil.cs`・`Game.PlayerInventory.Interface/PlayerInventorySlotLevelMasterUtil.cs`）。起動時の検証は Core.Master から Game.Block.Interface を参照できないので、生のマスタだけを読む `LevelInheritanceRecipeShape`（Core.Master）で判定する（前例 `Core.Master/Validator/BeltConveyorFamilyValidator.cs`）。「基準アイテムか」と「基準の入出力の探索」は `LevelInheritanceRecipeShape` の1か所に置き、実行時の `BuildShape` もそれに委ねる（Game.Block.Interface は Core.Master を参照できる）
  - `public readonly struct Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade.LevelInheritanceShape`（継承レシピにだけ作る。番兵の -1・0 は持たない。ctor は `internal` で、作れるのは `TryGetShape` だけ）:
    - `readonly int SourceInputIndex`・`readonly int TargetOutputIndex`
    - `readonly IReadOnlyList<ItemId> SourceVariants`・`readonly IReadOnlyList<ItemId> TargetVariants`（レベル順。添字0が Lv1）
    - `readonly Guid TargetBaseItemGuid`（継承先ファミリーの基準アイテムGUID。製作上限の鍵）
    - `readonly bool HasCraftCap`（`InheritUpToUnlocked` なら true）
    - `int MaxLevel`（継承元ファミリーの長さ）
    - `int? ResolveSourceLevel(ItemId itemId)`（1始まり。継承元の変種でなければ null）
    - `ItemId GetSourceVariant(int level)`・`ItemId GetTargetVariant(int level)`
  - `public static class Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade.MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil`:
    - `bool TryGetShape(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, out LevelInheritanceShape shape)`（`recipe.LevelInheritance` の網羅 switch。`None` は false）
    - `bool IsValidInheritedLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int? inheritedLevel)`（継承レシピは `1..MaxLevel` の値、継承しないレシピは null のときだけ true。ジョブの生成側〈C3 の解決・C4 の復元〉がこれで閉じる）
    - `ItemId ResolveInputItemId(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int inputIndex, int? inheritedLevel)`（入力 i が継承元なら継承レベルの変種、それ以外は書いたまま。継承元で null なら `InvalidOperationException`）
    - `ItemId ResolveOutputItemId(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int outputIndex, int? inheritedLevel)`（出力 j が継承先なら継承レベルの変種、それ以外は書いたまま。Part B の書き換え器もこれで継承先を写す）
    - C7 で `int GetMaxCraftableLevel(LevelInheritanceShape shape, ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup craftCapLookup)` を足す
  - `public static class Core.Master.Validator.MachineUpgrade.LevelInheritanceRecipeShape`（生のマスタだけで判定。起動時の検証・実行時の `MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.BuildShape`・Part B の `CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks` が使う）:
    - `bool IsLevelFamilyBase(Guid itemGuid)`
    - `int CountFamilyBaseInputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`・`int CountFamilyBaseOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`（検証のエラー文用）
    - `int? FindSingleSourceInputIndex(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`・`int? FindSingleTargetOutputIndex(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`（基準の入力・出力がちょうど1つならその番号、0個か2個以上なら null）
    - `int? FindSourceFamilyLength(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`（継承元ファミリーの長さ。基準の入力がちょうど1つでなければ null）
    - `Guid? FindTargetBaseGuid(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`（継承先の基準アイテムGUID。基準の出力がちょうど1つでなければ null）
    - `int GetFamilyLength(Guid baseItemGuid)`
    - 呼び出し側は `is not int x`／`is not Guid x` で受け、無条件の `.Value` を書かない

```csharp
using System;

namespace Tests.Module.TestMod
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     Part C のテストマスタ追加分（継承レシピ・研究・機械）の GUID と ID
    ///     GUIDs and IDs of Part C's test-master additions (inheritance recipes, research, machine)
    /// </summary>
    public static class ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds
    {
        public static readonly Guid SourceBaseGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-c0de-000000000011");
        public static readonly Guid TargetBaseGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-c0de-000000000021");
        public static readonly Guid CappedTargetBaseGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-c0de-000000000031");

        public static readonly Guid InheritRecipeGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000c0de0001");
        public static readonly Guid CappedInheritRecipeGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000c0de0002");

        public static readonly Guid CraftCapResearchGuid = Guid.Parse("c0de0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001");
        public static readonly Guid ModuleSlotStackResearchGuid = Guid.Parse("c0de0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002");

        public static BlockId MachineId => MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockId(Guid.Parse("ffffffff-0000-4000-8000-00000000c0de"));

        public static ItemId Source(int level) => Variant(SourceBaseGuid, level);
        public static ItemId Target(int level) => Variant(TargetBaseGuid, level);
        public static ItemId CappedTarget(int level) => Variant(CappedTargetBaseGuid, level);

        private static ItemId Variant(Guid baseGuid, int level)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariantItemId(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(baseGuid), level);
        }
    }
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Core/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceValidatorTest.cs`

```csharp
using System.IO;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Core.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承レシピの util と検証（継承元・継承先の数、ダイシング形の出力、上限モードの混在）を確かめる
    ///     Checks the inheritance util and validation (source/target counts, dicing-shaped outputs, mixed cap modes)
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceValidatorTest
    {
        private const string TestElectricMachineGuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001";

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
        }

        [Test]
        public void UtilResolvesSourceAndTargetTest()
        {
            var inherit = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid);
            var capped = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedInheritRecipeGuid);
            var plain = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.MachineRecipes.Data[0];

            // 継承元は入力0、継承先は出力0、レベルは変種の並び順で決まり、変種でなければ null
            // The source is input 0, the target is output 0, the level follows the variant order, and a non-variant is null
            Assert.IsTrue(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.TryGetShape(inherit, out var shape));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, shape.SourceInputIndex);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, shape.TargetOutputIndex);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, shape.ResolveSourceLevel(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)));
            Assert.IsNull(shape.ResolveSourceLevel(ForUnitTestItemId.ItemId1));
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(2), shape.GetTargetVariant(2));
            Assert.AreEqual(3, shape.MaxLevel);

            // 入力・出力の写しは継承元・継承先だけを変種にし、固定素材は書いたまま
            // Input/output mapping turns only the source and target into variants; the fixed input stays as written
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.ResolveInputItemId(inherit, 0, 3));
            Assert.AreEqual(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(inherit.InputItems[1].ItemGuid), MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.ResolveInputItemId(inherit, 1, 3));
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(2), MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.ResolveOutputItemId(inherit, 0, 2));

            // 上限の有無と鍵（継承先の基準GUID）
            // Cap presence and its key (the target's base GUID)
            Assert.IsFalse(shape.HasCraftCap);
            Assert.IsTrue(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.TryGetShape(capped, out var cappedShape));
            Assert.IsTrue(cappedShape.HasCraftCap);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTargetBaseGuid, cappedShape.TargetBaseItemGuid);

            // 継承しないレシピには形が無い
            // A non-inheritance recipe has no shape
            Assert.IsFalse(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.TryGetShape(plain, out _));
        }

        [Test]
        public void InheritedLevelValidityFollowsRecipeTest()
        {
            var inherit = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid);
            var plain = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.MachineRecipes.Data[0];

            // 継承レシピは 1..3 の値だけ、継承しないレシピは値なしだけを正とする（キー欠けの 0 や null を通さない）
            // An inheritance recipe accepts only 1..3 and a plain recipe only no value (a missing key's 0 or null never passes)
            Assert.IsTrue(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsValidInheritedLevel(inherit, 1));
            Assert.IsTrue(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsValidInheritedLevel(inherit, 3));
            Assert.IsFalse(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsValidInheritedLevel(inherit, null));
            Assert.IsFalse(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsValidInheritedLevel(inherit, 0));
            Assert.IsFalse(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsValidInheritedLevel(inherit, 4));
            Assert.IsTrue(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsValidInheritedLevel(plain, null));
            Assert.IsFalse(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsValidInheritedLevel(plain, 1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void TestMasterPassesValidationTest()
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(new MachineRecipesMaster(LoadJson()).Validate(out var logs), logs);
        }

        [Test]
        public void TwoFamilySourcesFailTest()
        {
            var json = LoadJson();
            var recipe = FindRecipe(json, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid.ToString());

            // 2つ目の入力も継承元ファミリーの基準にすると継承元が2つになる
            // Making the second input another family base yields two sources
            recipe["inputItems"][1]["itemGuid"] = ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SourceBaseGuid.ToString();

            Assert.IsFalse(new MachineRecipesMaster(json).Validate(out var logs));
            StringAssert.Contains("must have exactly one level-family source input", logs);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DicingShapedOutputsOnQualityMachinePassTest()
        {
            var json = LoadJson();
            var recipe = FindRecipe(json, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid.ToString());

            // 品質可の機械（出力3）へ移し、出力を「継承先の基準＋継承先の Lv2＋ファミリー外」にする（ダイシングと同じ形）
            // Move it to the quality-enabled machine (3 outputs) with outputs "target base + target Lv2 + out-of-family" (the dicing shape)
            recipe["blockGuid"] = TestElectricMachineGuid;
            recipe["outputItems"] = JArray.Parse("[" +
                "{\"percent\": 1, \"count\": 1, \"itemGuid\": \"00000000-0000-0000-c0de-000000000021\"}," +
                "{\"percent\": 1, \"count\": 1, \"itemGuid\": \"00000000-0000-0000-c0de-000000000022\"}," +
                "{\"percent\": 1, \"count\": 1, \"itemGuid\": \"00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000002\"}]");

            Assert.IsTrue(new MachineRecipesMaster(json).Validate(out var logs), logs);
        }

        [Test]
        public void MixedCapModeForSameTargetFailsTest()
        {
            var json = LoadJson();
            var capped = FindRecipe(json, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedInheritRecipeGuid.ToString());

            // 上限つきレシピの継承先を上限なしレシピと同じファミリーにすると混在になる
            // Pointing the capped recipe at the uncapped recipe's family mixes the modes
            capped["outputItems"][0]["itemGuid"] = ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.TargetBaseGuid.ToString();

            Assert.IsFalse(new MachineRecipesMaster(json).Validate(out var logs));
            StringAssert.Contains("mixes Inherit and InheritUpToUnlocked", logs);
        }

        private static JObject LoadJson()
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory, "mods", "forUnitTest", "master", "machineRecipes.json");
            return JObject.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));
        }

        private static JObject FindRecipe(JObject json, string recipeGuid)
        {
            foreach (var recipe in (JArray)json["data"])
            {
                if (recipe["machineRecipeGuid"].Value<string>() == recipeGuid) return (JObject)recipe;
            }
            Assert.Fail($"recipe not found: {recipeGuid}");
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 継承レシピの形と解釈 util を書く（Game.Block.Interface）**

継承の有無は `TryGetShape` の戻り値で、継承レベルの有無は `int?` で表す。-1 の添字や 0 のレベルといった番兵は作らない。

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/MachineUpgrade/LevelInheritanceShape.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master;

namespace Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     レベル継承レシピの形（継承元の入力番号・継承先の出力番号・両ファミリーの変種列・上限の有無）。継承しないレシピには作らない
    ///     Shape of a level-inheritance recipe: source input index, target output index, both families' variants and whether it is capped; never built for a non-inheritance recipe
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct LevelInheritanceShape
    {
        public readonly int SourceInputIndex;
        public readonly int TargetOutputIndex;

        // レベル順の変種列（添字0が Lv1）
        // Level-ordered variants (index 0 is Lv1)
        public readonly IReadOnlyList<ItemId> SourceVariants;
        public readonly IReadOnlyList<ItemId> TargetVariants;

        // 継承先ファミリーの基準アイテムGUID。製作上限の鍵にもなる
        // Base item GUID of the target family; also the craft cap key
        public readonly Guid TargetBaseItemGuid;

        // 研究で上げる製作上限を見るか（InheritUpToUnlocked）
        // Whether the research-raised craft cap applies (InheritUpToUnlocked)
        public readonly bool HasCraftCap;

        public int MaxLevel => SourceVariants.Count;

        // 継承レシピにだけ作るので、作れるのは同じアセンブリの MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.TryGetShape だけにする
        // Built only for inheritance recipes, so only MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.TryGetShape in this assembly may construct it
        internal LevelInheritanceShape(int sourceInputIndex, int targetOutputIndex, IReadOnlyList<ItemId> sourceVariants, IReadOnlyList<ItemId> targetVariants, Guid targetBaseItemGuid, bool hasCraftCap)
        {
            SourceInputIndex = sourceInputIndex;
            TargetOutputIndex = targetOutputIndex;
            SourceVariants = sourceVariants;
            TargetVariants = targetVariants;
            TargetBaseItemGuid = targetBaseItemGuid;
            HasCraftCap = hasCraftCap;
        }

        // 継承元ファミリーでのレベル（1始まり）。継承元の変種でなければ null
        // Level within the source family (1-based); null when the item is not a source variant
        public int? ResolveSourceLevel(ItemId itemId)
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < SourceVariants.Count; i++)
            {
                if (SourceVariants[i] == itemId) return i + 1;
            }
            return null;
        }

        public ItemId GetSourceVariant(int level)
        {
            return SourceVariants[level - 1];
        }

        public ItemId GetTargetVariant(int level)
        {
            return TargetVariants[level - 1];
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Master.Validator.MachineUpgrade;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     機械レシピの levelInheritance を解釈する。継承レシピの形と、入力・出力を継承レベルの変種へ写す処理を1か所に置く
    ///     Interprets a machine recipe's levelInheritance; keeps the inheritance shape and the mapping of inputs/outputs to the inherited level's variant in one place
    /// </summary>
    public static class MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil
    {
        // 継承レシピなら形を返す。継承しないレシピは false
        // Returns the shape for an inheritance recipe; false for a non-inheritance recipe
        public static bool TryGetShape(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, out LevelInheritanceShape shape)
        {
            switch (recipe.LevelInheritance)
            {
                case MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.None:
                    shape = default;
                    return false;
                case MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.Inherit:
                    shape = BuildShape(recipe, false);
                    return true;
                case MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.InheritUpToUnlocked:
                    shape = BuildShape(recipe, true);
                    return true;
                default:
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"未知の levelInheritance です recipe={recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} value={recipe.LevelInheritance}");
            }
        }

        // 加工ジョブの継承レベルがレシピと合うか。継承レシピは 1..最大レベル、継承しないレシピは値なし
        // Whether a job's inherited level fits the recipe: 1..max for an inheritance recipe, no value otherwise
        public static bool IsValidInheritedLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int? inheritedLevel)
        {
            if (!TryGetShape(recipe, out var shape)) return !inheritedLevel.HasValue;
            return inheritedLevel.HasValue && 1 <= inheritedLevel.Value && inheritedLevel.Value <= shape.MaxLevel;
        }

        // 入力 inputIndex のアイテム。継承元なら継承レベルの変種、それ以外は書いたまま
        // Item of input inputIndex: the inherited level's variant for the source, otherwise as written
        public static ItemId ResolveInputItemId(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int inputIndex, int? inheritedLevel)
        {
            if (TryGetShape(recipe, out var shape) && shape.SourceInputIndex == inputIndex) return shape.GetSourceVariant(RequireLevel(recipe, inheritedLevel));
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.InputItems[inputIndex].ItemGuid);
        }

        // 出力 outputIndex のアイテム。継承先なら継承レベルの変種、それ以外は書いたまま
        // Item of output outputIndex: the inherited level's variant for the target, otherwise as written
        public static ItemId ResolveOutputItemId(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int outputIndex, int? inheritedLevel)
        {
            if (TryGetShape(recipe, out var shape) && shape.TargetOutputIndex == outputIndex) return shape.GetTargetVariant(RequireLevel(recipe, inheritedLevel));
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.OutputItems[outputIndex].ItemGuid);
        }

        private static int RequireLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int? inheritedLevel)
        {
            // 継承レシピのジョブは生成時（入力からの解決・セーブからの復元）に必ず値を持つので、無ければ呼び出し側の誤り
            // An inheritance job always gets its level when created (resolved from input or restored from save), so a missing one is a caller bug
            if (!inheritedLevel.HasValue) throw new InvalidOperationException($"継承レシピのジョブに継承レベルがありません recipe={recipe.MachineRecipeGuid}");
            return inheritedLevel.Value;
        }

        private static LevelInheritanceShape BuildShape(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, bool hasCraftCap)
        {
            // 継承元・継承先の探索は検証と同じ LevelInheritanceRecipeShape に委ねる。ちょうど1つずつあることは起動時の検証が保証するので、無ければ検証漏れとして止める
            // Finding the source and target is delegated to the same LevelInheritanceRecipeShape as validation; boot validation guarantees exactly one of each, so a miss is a validation gap and stops here
            if (LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.FindSingleSourceInputIndex(recipe) is not int sourceIndex) throw new InvalidOperationException($"継承レシピの継承元の入力がちょうど1つではありません recipe={recipe.MachineRecipeGuid}");
            if (LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.FindSingleTargetOutputIndex(recipe) is not int targetIndex) throw new InvalidOperationException($"継承レシピの継承先の出力がちょうど1つではありません recipe={recipe.MachineRecipeGuid}");

            var sourceBaseItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.InputItems[sourceIndex].ItemGuid);
            var targetBaseGuid = recipe.OutputItems[targetIndex].ItemGuid;
            var targetBaseItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(targetBaseGuid);
            return new LevelInheritanceShape(sourceIndex, targetIndex,
                MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariants(sourceBaseItemId), MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariants(targetBaseItemId),
                targetBaseGuid, hasCraftCap);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/MachineUpgrade/LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.cs`（生のマスタだけで継承レシピの形を引く1か所。起動時の検証〈Core.Master〉と実行時の `MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.BuildShape`〈Game.Block.Interface。asmdef で Core.Master を参照済み〉の両方がこれを使い、「基準アイテムか」と「基準の入出力の探索」を2本に分けない。前例 `Core.Master/Validator/GenerationBiomeObjectConfigCatalog.cs`〈public。`GenerationMasterUtil` の検証と実行時の `Game.MapGeneration/Pipeline/Runtime/BiomeObjectConfigRuntimeApplier.cs` の両方が使う〉）

```csharp
using System;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Core.Master.Validator.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     生のマスタだけで継承レシピの形（levelFamily の基準を指す入力・出力とファミリー長）を引く。起動時の検証と実行時の MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil が共有する
    ///     Reads an inheritance recipe's shape (level-family base inputs/outputs and family lengths) from the raw master only; shared by boot validation and the runtime MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil
    /// </summary>
    public static class LevelInheritanceRecipeShape
    {
        // levelFamily の基準アイテムか（変種や存在しないGUIDは false）
        // Whether the item is a level-family base (variants and unknown GUIDs are false)
        public static bool IsLevelFamilyBase(Guid itemGuid)
        {
            var itemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemIdOrNull(itemGuid);
            return itemId.HasValue && MasterHolder.ItemMaster.HasLevelFamily(itemId.Value);
        }

        // 基準を指す入力・出力の数（検証のエラー文が使う）
        // Number of base inputs/outputs (used by validation error messages)
        public static int CountFamilyBaseInputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            var count = 0;
            foreach (var input in recipe.InputItems) if (IsLevelFamilyBase(input.ItemGuid)) count++;
            return count;
        }

        public static int CountFamilyBaseOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            var count = 0;
            foreach (var output in recipe.OutputItems) if (IsLevelFamilyBase(output.ItemGuid)) count++;
            return count;
        }

        // 基準を指す入力がちょうど1つならその番号。0個か2個以上なら null
        // Index of the base input when there is exactly one; null for none or several
        public static int? FindSingleSourceInputIndex(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            int? found = null;
            for (var i = 0; i < recipe.InputItems.Length; i++)
            {
                if (!IsLevelFamilyBase(recipe.InputItems[i].ItemGuid)) continue;
                if (found.HasValue) return null;
                found = i;
            }
            return found;
        }

        // 基準を指す出力がちょうど1つならその番号。0個か2個以上なら null
        // Index of the base output when there is exactly one; null for none or several
        public static int? FindSingleTargetOutputIndex(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            int? found = null;
            for (var i = 0; i < recipe.OutputItems.Length; i++)
            {
                if (!IsLevelFamilyBase(recipe.OutputItems[i].ItemGuid)) continue;
                if (found.HasValue) return null;
                found = i;
            }
            return found;
        }

        // 継承元ファミリーの長さ（グレード数）。基準の入力がちょうど1つでなければ null（Part B の役割表の検証も使う）
        // Length of the source family (grade count); null unless there is exactly one base input (Part B's role-table validation uses it too)
        public static int? FindSourceFamilyLength(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            if (FindSingleSourceInputIndex(recipe) is not int sourceIndex) return null;
            return GetFamilyLength(recipe.InputItems[sourceIndex].ItemGuid);
        }

        // 継承先の基準アイテムGUID（製作上限の鍵）。基準の出力がちょうど1つでなければ null
        // Base item GUID of the target (the craft cap key); null unless there is exactly one base output
        public static Guid? FindTargetBaseGuid(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            if (FindSingleTargetOutputIndex(recipe) is not int targetIndex) return null;
            return recipe.OutputItems[targetIndex].ItemGuid;
        }

        public static int GetFamilyLength(Guid baseItemGuid)
        {
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceValidator.cs`（実行時の util〈Game.Block.Interface〉は使わず、`LevelInheritanceRecipeShape` で生のマスタだけを読む。前例 `BeltConveyorFamilyValidator`）

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Core.Master.Validator.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承レシピの形（継承元1つ・継承先1つ・ファミリー長・上限モードの一貫性）を検証する。機械の品質可否は見ない
    ///     Validates an inheritance recipe's shape: one source, one target, family lengths and consistent cap modes; the machine's quality permission is not checked
    /// </summary>
    public static class MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceValidator
    {
        public static string Validate(MachineRecipes machineRecipes)
        {
            var logs = "";
            var modeByTargetGuid = new Dictionary<Guid, string>();
            foreach (var recipe in machineRecipes.Data)
            {
                if (recipe.LevelInheritance == MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.None) continue;
                logs += ValidateRecipe(recipe);
            }
            return logs;

            #region Internal

            string ValidateRecipe(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
            {
                var prefix = $"[MachineRecipesMaster] Recipe GUID:{recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} levelInheritance:{recipe.LevelInheritance}";

                // 継承元・継承先はちょうど1つずつ。ちょうど1つでなければ値が返らず、以降の判定ができない
                // Exactly one source and one target; otherwise no value comes back and later checks are meaningless
                if (LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.FindSourceFamilyLength(recipe) is not int sourceLength) return $"{prefix} must have exactly one level-family source input but has {LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.CountFamilyBaseInputs(recipe)}\n";
                if (LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.FindTargetBaseGuid(recipe) is not Guid targetBaseGuid) return $"{prefix} must have exactly one level-family target output but has {LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.CountFamilyBaseOutputs(recipe)}\n";

                var errors = "";
                var targetLength = LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.GetFamilyLength(targetBaseGuid);
                if (targetLength < sourceLength) errors += $"{prefix} target family has {targetLength} levels but the source family has {sourceLength}\n";

                // 同じ継承先ファミリーで上限ありと上限なしを混ぜると、研究の効き方が経路で変わる
                // Mixing capped and uncapped recipes for one target family would make research apply per path
                if (modeByTargetGuid.TryGetValue(targetBaseGuid, out var knownMode) && knownMode != recipe.LevelInheritance)
                {
                    errors += $"{prefix} mixes Inherit and InheritUpToUnlocked for target family base {targetBaseGuid}\n";
                }
                modeByTargetGuid[targetBaseGuid] = recipe.LevelInheritance;
                return errors;
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

`MachineRecipesMasterUtil.cs` の `Validate` に1行足す（8-13行を置き換え、using を1行追加）:

```csharp
            errorLogs += SlotCapacityValidation();

            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorLogs);
```

### Task C3: 継承レシピの実行（入力束縛・実現出力・返却・待機キャッシュ）

継承元スロットが継承元ファミリーのどの変種も受け、入っていた変種のレベルで継承先を出す。待機中のキャッシュと加工中ジョブの返却も継承レベルを持つ。あわせて一般機械の汎用の品質シフト（品質モジュールで出力を上位変種へ抽選する経路）を撤去する。品質を読むのは Part B のチップ抽選の書き換え器だけになり、品質モジュールは一般機械の出力を変えない。セーブ・ロードをまたぐ保持は C4。

**Files:**
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/RecipeSelection/MachineRecipeSlotBindingUtil.cs:13-19`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Inventory/Input/VanillaMachineInputInventory.cs`（`ResolveInheritedLevel` を追加）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/State/Util/MachineOutputFactoryUtil.cs`（全体を置き換え。`RollQualityLevel`・`CreateLevelAppliedOutputs`・`ApplyLevel` を削除）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/State/MachineProcessContext.cs:125-131`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/State/IdleMachineProcessState.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/State/ProcessingMachineProcessState.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: C2 の `MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil`・`ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds`
- Produces:
  - 継承レベルは `int?` で持つ。継承レシピのジョブは `1..継承元ファミリー長` の値、継承しないレシピのジョブは null（番兵の 0・1 は使わない。値の正しさは生成時〈待機からの開始は `SetProcessing`、セーブからの復元は `MachineProcessingJob` の ctor〉に `MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsValidInheritedLevel` で閉じる）。ジョブ無しは `MachineProcessingJob` が無いこと（null）で表し、ジョブ無しのために継承レベルやレシピを null で並べない（`ProcessingMachineProcessState.InheritedLevel` はジョブ無しの間も null を返す、保存のための読み口）
  - `internal static List<IItemStack> MachineOutputFactoryUtil.CreateRealizedOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, MachineModuleEffect effect, int? inheritedLevel)`（引数順は recipe, effect, inheritedLevel。作るのは「素の出力1セット」と「生産性の当選時に同じ1セット」だけ。各出力は `MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.ResolveOutputItemId` で決め、継承レシピだけ継承先の出力1つが継承レベルの変種になる。品質シフトは読まず、GameRandom を引くのは追加産出の1回だけ）
  - `MachineModuleEffect.QualityShift` は残す（Part B の書き換え器と C5 の API が読む）
  - クリーンルーム機械も同じ `VanillaMachineInputInventory`・待機/加工ステート・`MachineProcessContext.CreateRealizedOutputs` を通るので、束縛・継承レベル・品質シフト撤去の規則は同じに効く。Part B の `IRealizedOutputDecorator` はこの戻り値（品質の影響を受けていない出力）を受け取る
  - `internal List<IItemStack> MachineProcessContext.CreateRealizedOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int? inheritedLevel)`
  - `public int? VanillaMachineInputInventory.ResolveInheritedLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`（継承でなければ null。継承元スロットに継承元の変種が無ければ `InvalidOperationException`＝束縛の破れ）
  - `public sealed class Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State.MachineProcessingJob`（セーブから復元する加工中ジョブ。`readonly MachineRecipeMasterElement Recipe`・`readonly uint RemainingTicks`・`readonly List<IItemStack> PendingOutputs`〈旧セーブは null〉・`readonly int? InheritedLevel`〈継承しないレシピだけ null〉。ctor `MachineProcessingJob(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, uint remainingTicks, List<IItemStack> pendingOutputs, int? inheritedLevel)` は `IsValidInheritedLevel` が偽なら `InvalidOperationException`。`static MachineProcessingJob RestoreFromFlatSave(string recipeGuidStr, double remainingSeconds, List<ItemStackSaveJsonObject> pendingOutputs, int? inheritedLevel)` はセーブの平らなキーから組み、ジョブ無し〈null・`Guid.Empty`〉とレシピがマスタから消えたとき〈警告ログ。継承レベルも捨てる〉は null）
  - `ProcessingMachineProcessState(MachineProcessContext context, MachineProcessingJob restoredJob)`（ジョブの有無は `restoredJob` の有無だけ。ジョブ無しで意味の無い引数を null で並べない）
  - `VanillaMachineProcessorComponent(VanillaMachineInputInventory input, VanillaMachineOutputInventory output, ProcessState currentState, MachineProcessingJob processingJob, float requestPower, float idlePowerRate, MachineModuleEffectComponent effect, MachineRecipeMasterElement selectedRecipe)`（セーブからの復元用。新規用の ctor は変えない）
  - `CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveState.Restore(Dictionary<string, object> componentStates, string saveKey, VanillaMachineInputInventory input, VanillaMachineOutputInventory output, VanillaMachineModuleInventory module, out ProcessState state, out MachineProcessingJob processingJob, out uint cycleCount, out MachineRecipeMasterElement selectedRecipe)`
  - `public void ProcessingMachineProcessState.SetProcessing(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, List<IItemStack> pendingOutputs, int? inheritedLevel)`（`IsValidInheritedLevel` が偽なら `InvalidOperationException`。セーブからの復元も同じ口を通るので、継承レシピのジョブの「継承レベルは1以上」はここで閉じる）
  - `public int? ProcessingMachineProcessState.InheritedLevel { get; private set; }`（継承しないレシピとジョブ無しは null）
  - `public static List<IItemStack> MachineRecipeRefundUtil.CreateRefundStacks(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int? inheritedLevel)`（各入力は `MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.ResolveInputItemId`）
  - テスト補助 `Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade.LevelInheritanceTestHelper`（下記 Step 1）
  - **Part B へ**: クリーンルーム機械の processor は `CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveState.Restore(componentStates, SaveKey, input, output, module, out var restoredState, out var processingJob, out var cycleCount, out var selectedRecipe);` と `_processingState = new ProcessingMachineProcessState(_context, processingJob);` で作る（継承レベルはジョブ型が持ち、C4 でセーブの値になる）。実現出力の差し替え（`IRealizedOutputDecorator`）は継承レベル適用後の出力を受け取る

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承機械（入力2・出力2・モジュール4）を置いて回すための共通処理
    ///     Shared helpers to place and run the inheritance machine (2 inputs, 2 outputs, 4 module slots)
    /// </summary>
    public static class LevelInheritanceTestHelper
    {
        public const int InputSlotCount = 2;
        public const int OutputSlotCount = 2;
        public const int ModuleRangeStart = InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount;
        public static readonly Guid Test1ItemGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000001");

        public static (IBlock block, VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent inventory, VanillaMachineProcessorComponent processor) PlaceMachine(Vector3Int position)
        {
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.MachineId, position, BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            return (block, block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>(), block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineProcessorComponent>());
        }

        public static MachineRecipeMasterElement Recipe(Guid recipeGuid)
        {
            return MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(recipeGuid);
        }

        public static IItemStack Create(ItemId itemId, int count)
        {
            return ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(itemId, count);
        }

        public static IItemStack CreateTest1(int count)
        {
            return ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(Test1ItemGuid, count);
        }

        public static OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService CreateOverflow(int slotCount)
        {
            return new OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService((_, _) => { }, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory, slotCount);
        }

        // 毎tick有効要求電力ちょうどを供給して進める（電力比1.0で決定論化）
        // Advance supplying exactly the effective request power each tick (ratio 1.0 keeps it deterministic)
        public static void AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(int ticks, VanillaMachineProcessorComponent processor)
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < ticks; i++)
            {
                processor.SupplyExternalPower(processor.EffectiveRequestPower);
                GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            }
        }

        // レシピ1回分を開始から払い出しまで進めるtick数
        // Ticks to run one craft from start to payout
        public static int TicksToComplete(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            return (int)GameUpdater.SecondsToTicks(recipe.Time) + 5;
        }

        // 指定範囲の指定アイテムの合計数
        // Total count of the item within the slot range
        public static int CountItem(IOpenableInventory inventory, int start, int end, ItemId itemId)
        {
            var total = 0;
            for (var i = start; i < end; i++)
            {
                var stack = inventory.GetItem(i);
                if (stack.Id == itemId) total += stack.Count;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
    ///     継承レシピが入力のレベルを別ファミリーの出力へ移し、混ぜず、返却・待機キャッシュでもレベルを保つことを検証する
    ///     Verifies an inheritance recipe carries the input level into another family's output, never mixes, and keeps the level in refunds and the idle cache
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelInheritanceRecipeTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void InheritsSourceLevelAcrossFamiliesTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var recipe = Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid);
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);

            // Lv3 の継承元と固定素材を入れて1回分回す
            // Insert a Lv3 source plus the fixed input and run one craft
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));
            inventory.InsertItem(CreateTest1(1));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(TicksToComplete(recipe), processor);

            // 別ファミリーの Lv3 が出て、Lv1 は出ない
            // The other family's Lv3 comes out and no Lv1 does
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Idle, processor.CurrentState);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, CountItem(inventory, InputSlotCount, InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(3)));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountItem(inventory, InputSlotCount, InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(1)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void SourceLevelsNeverMixInSlotTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, _) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid));

            // Lv2 が入っている継承元スロットへ Lv3 は重ならず、全量が戻る
            // A Lv3 never stacks onto the Lv2 already in the source slot; the whole stack bounces back
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 1));
            var remainder = inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), remainder.Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, remainder.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), inventory.GetItem(0).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void RecipeChangeRefundsInheritedLevelTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid));
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));
            inventory.InsertItem(CreateTest1(1));

            // 加工開始（入力消費）まで進める
            // Advance until processing starts and the inputs are consumed
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(2, processor);
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Processing, processor.CurrentState);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);

            // 選択解除で返却され、継承元は Lv3 のまま戻る
            // Clearing the selection refunds the job and the source comes back as Lv3
            var overflow = CreateOverflow(10);
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineRecipeSelectionResult.Success, processor.ClearSelectedRecipe(overflow));
            Assert.AreEqual(2, CountItem(overflow, 0, 10, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountItem(overflow, 0, 10, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void IdleCacheFollowsSourceLevelChangeTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var recipe = Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid);
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);

            // 出力スロットを Lv1 で満杯にし、Lv2 の実現出力を待機中に確定させる
            // Fill the output slot with Lv1 so the Lv2 realized output is fixed while waiting
            var targetMax = ItemStackLevelDataStore.Instance.GetMaxStack(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(1));
            inventory.SetItem(InputSlotCount, Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(1), targetMax));
            inventory.SetItem(0, Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 2));
            inventory.SetItem(1, CreateTest1(1));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(3, processor);
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Idle, processor.CurrentState);

            // 待機中に継承元を Lv3 へ差し替えてから出力を空ける
            // Swap the source to Lv3 while waiting, then free the output
            inventory.SetItem(0, Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(1, processor);
            inventory.SetItem(InputSlotCount, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty());
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(TicksToComplete(recipe), processor);

            // 古い Lv2 の確定結果を使い回さず、Lv3 が出る
            // The stale Lv2 result is not reused; Lv3 comes out
            Assert.AreEqual(1, CountItem(inventory, InputSlotCount, InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(3)));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountItem(inventory, InputSlotCount, InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(2)));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        // スロットslotIndexが素材itemIdの束縛先か。継承元スロットは継承元ファミリーのどの変種も受ける
        // Whether slot slotIndex is bound to input itemId; the source slot accepts any variant of the source family
        public static bool IsInputBoundTo(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int slotIndex, ItemId itemId)
        {
            if (slotIndex < 0 || recipe.InputItems.Length <= slotIndex) return false;
            if (MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.TryGetShape(recipe, out var shape) && shape.SourceInputIndex == slotIndex) return shape.ResolveSourceLevel(itemId).HasValue;
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.InputItems[slotIndex].ItemGuid) == itemId;
        }
```

```csharp
        // 継承元スロットのアイテムから継承レベルを引く。継承レシピ以外は null
        // Resolve the inherited level from the source slot's item; null for non-inheritance recipes
        public int? ResolveInheritedLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            if (!MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.TryGetShape(recipe, out var shape)) return null;

            // IsAllowedToStartProcess を通った後に呼ぶので、継承元スロットには束縛どおり継承元の変種がある。無ければ束縛の破れなので止める
            // Called after IsAllowedToStartProcess, so the source slot holds a source variant by binding; a missing one is a broken binding, so stop
            var level = shape.ResolveSourceLevel(InputSlot[shape.SourceInputIndex].Id);
            if (!level.HasValue) throw new InvalidOperationException($"継承元スロットに継承元の変種がありません recipe={recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} item={InputSlot[shape.SourceInputIndex].Id}");
            return level;
        }
```

`MachineOutputFactoryUtil.cs` 全体を置き換える（`RollQualityLevel`・`CreateLevelAppliedOutputs`・`ApplyLevel` と `using System;` を削除）:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Fluid;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State.Util
{
    internal static class MachineOutputFactoryUtil
    {
        // 素の出力1セットと、生産性の当選時に同じ1セットを追加で作る。品質は一般機械の出力を変えない
        // Build one plain output set plus an identical extra set when productivity rolls; quality never changes general machine output
        public static List<IItemStack> CreateRealizedOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, MachineModuleEffect effect, int? inheritedLevel)
        {
            var outputs = CreatePlainOutputs(recipe, inheritedLevel);
            if (GameRandom.NextDouble() < effect.ExtraOutputChance) outputs.AddRange(CreatePlainOutputs(recipe, inheritedLevel));
            return outputs;
        }

        // レシピの液体出力1セットを生成
        // Build one set of the recipe's fluid outputs
        public static List<FluidStack> CreateFluidOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            var outputs = new List<FluidStack>(recipe.OutputFluids.Length);
            foreach (var outputFluid in recipe.OutputFluids)
            {
                var fluidId = MasterHolder.FluidMaster.GetFluidId(outputFluid.FluidGuid);
                outputs.Add(new FluidStack(outputFluid.Amount, fluidId));
            }
            return outputs;
        }

        // 出力1セットを書いたアイテムのまま作る。継承レシピは継承先の出力だけを継承レベルの変種にする
        // Build one output set as written; an inheritance recipe swaps only the target output to the inherited level's variant
        private static List<IItemStack> CreatePlainOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int? inheritedLevel)
        {
            var outputs = new List<IItemStack>(recipe.OutputItems.Length);
            for (var i = 0; i < recipe.OutputItems.Length; i++)
            {
                var itemId = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.ResolveOutputItemId(recipe, i, inheritedLevel);
                outputs.Add(ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(itemId, recipe.OutputItems[i].Count));
            }
            return outputs;
        }
    }
}
```
