- [ ] **Step 6: 待機キャッシュの鍵を (レシピ, 継承レベル) にする**

`IdleMachineProcessState.cs` 全体:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State.Util;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State
{
    // 待機ステート。レシピが揃えば加工ジョブを確定し加工へ遷移する
    // Idle state: fixes the processing job and transitions to processing once a recipe is ready
    internal class IdleMachineProcessState : IMachineProcessState
    {
        private readonly MachineProcessContext _context;
        private readonly ProcessingMachineProcessState _processingState;

        // 出力先が空くのを待つ間、確定済みの実現出力を保持する（レシピか継承レベルが変わるまで再抽選しない）
        // Holds the already-realized outputs while waiting for output space (never re-rolled until the recipe or inherited level changes)
        private MachineRecipeMasterElement _pendingRecipe;
        private int? _pendingInheritedLevel;
        private List<IItemStack> _pendingOutputs;

        public IdleMachineProcessState(MachineProcessContext context, ProcessingMachineProcessState processingState)
        {
            _context = context;
            _processingState = processingState;
        }

        public ProcessState State => ProcessState.Idle;
        public void OnEnter() { }
        public void OnExit() { }

        public ProcessState GetNextUpdate()
        {
            // 選択レシピが無ければ加工しない（レシピ選択必須）
            // Never process without a selected recipe (selection is mandatory)
            var recipe = _context.SelectedRecipe;
            if (recipe == null || !_context.InputInventory.IsAllowedToStartProcess(recipe))
            {
                ClearPendingOutputs();
                return ProcessState.Idle;
            }

            // レシピか継承レベルが変わったときだけ新規に確定する。同じ組で待機している間は既存の実現結果を使い回す
            // Realize anew only when the recipe or inherited level changed; while waiting on the same pair, reuse the result
            var inheritedLevel = _context.InputInventory.ResolveInheritedLevel(recipe);
            if (_pendingRecipe != recipe || _pendingInheritedLevel != inheritedLevel)
            {
                _pendingOutputs = _context.CreateRealizedOutputs(recipe, inheritedLevel);
                _pendingRecipe = recipe;
                _pendingInheritedLevel = inheritedLevel;
            }

            if (!_context.OutputInventory.CanStoreOutputs(_pendingOutputs, MachineOutputFactoryUtil.CreateFluidOutputs(recipe)))
            {
                return ProcessState.Idle;
            }

            // ProcessingStateへ遷移
            // Hand the job to ProcessingState and transition
            _processingState.SetProcessing(recipe, _pendingOutputs, inheritedLevel);
            ClearPendingOutputs();
            return ProcessState.Processing;

            #region Internal

            void ClearPendingOutputs()
            {
                _pendingRecipe = null;
                _pendingInheritedLevel = null;
                _pendingOutputs = null;
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 加工中ジョブに継承レベルを持たせる**

`ProcessingMachineProcessState.cs` 全体:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State.Util;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Util;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State
{
    // 加工ステート。電力に応じて進行し、完了で待機へ戻る
    // Processing state: advances with power and returns to idle on completion
    internal class ProcessingMachineProcessState : IMachineProcessState
    {
        // 進行中レシピ(返却用)。無ければnull
        // Recipe of the running job (for refund calculation); null when no job exists
        public MachineRecipeMasterElement CurrentRecipe { get; private set; }

        // 進行中ジョブの継承レベル。継承レシピ以外とジョブ無しは null（返却とセーブが使う）
        // Inherited level of the running job; null for non-inheritance recipes or no job (used by refunds and saves)
        public int? InheritedLevel { get; private set; }

        public ProcessState State => ProcessState.Processing;
        private readonly MachineProcessContext _context;
        public Guid RecipeGuid => CurrentRecipe?.MachineRecipeGuid ?? Guid.Empty;

        public uint TotalTicks { get; private set; }
        public uint RemainingTicks  { get; private set; }

        public IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> PendingOutputs => _pendingOutputs;
        private List<IItemStack> _pendingOutputs;

        // 完了直前に産出リストを差し替えるフック（清浄室のチップ抽選など、OnExit挿入前の置き換え用）
        // Hook to replace the pending output list just before completion (e.g. clean-room chip draw swaps items before OnExit inserts them)
        public void ReplacePendingOutputs(List<IItemStack> outputs)
        {
            _pendingOutputs = outputs;
        }

        // 出力を払い出さずジョブを破棄(返却用)
        // Discard the job without paying outputs (used by the recipe-change refund flow)
        public void CancelProcessing()
        {
            ClearJob();
        }

        // ジョブの有無は MachineProcessingJob の有無だけで受ける（ジョブ無しは null で、空のまま待つ）
        // Whether a job exists comes only from the presence of a MachineProcessingJob (null means no job, so stay empty)
        public ProcessingMachineProcessState(MachineProcessContext context, MachineProcessingJob restoredJob)
        {
            _context = context;
            if (restoredJob == null) return;

            // セーブの残りtickごと加工を復元する。産出予定nullの旧セーブは完了時に再抽選する
            // Restore processing with the saved remaining ticks; old saves with null pending outputs re-roll on completion
            SetProcessing(restoredJob.Recipe, restoredJob.PendingOutputs, restoredJob.InheritedLevel);
            RemainingTicks = restoredJob.RemainingTicks;
        }

        // 加工するジョブをIdle、ロードから設定
        // Set the processing job from Idle or on load
        public void SetProcessing(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, List<IItemStack> pendingOutputs, int? inheritedLevel)
        {
            // 待機からの開始もここを通る。継承レベルがレシピと合わなければ束縛の破れなので、黙って補わずに止める（復元の値は MachineProcessingJob が先に閉じている）
            // Starting from idle also passes here; a level that does not fit the recipe means a broken binding, so stop instead of filling it in (restored values are already closed by MachineProcessingJob)
            if (!MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsValidInheritedLevel(recipe, inheritedLevel)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"加工ジョブの継承レベルが不正です recipe={recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} inheritedLevel={inheritedLevel}");

            CurrentRecipe = recipe;
            InheritedLevel = inheritedLevel;
            _pendingOutputs = pendingOutputs;

            var effect = _context.EffectComponent.AggregateCurrent();
            var baseTicks = GameUpdater.SecondsToTicks(recipe.Time);
            var totalTicks = (uint)Math.Max(1, (long)Math.Round(baseTicks * effect.ProcessingTimeMultiplier));
            TotalTicks = totalTicks;
        }

        // 開始時に入力を消費し残りtickを設定する
        // Consume inputs and set remaining ticks on start
        public void OnEnter()
        {
            _context.InputInventory.ReduceInputSlot(CurrentRecipe);
            RemainingTicks = TotalTicks;
        }

        public ProcessState GetNextUpdate()
        {
            // 電力、モジュールに基づいてこのティックで引くティック数を計算
            // Calculate the number of ticks to consume this tick based on power and modules
            var effectiveRequestPower = _context.EffectiveRequestPower(ProcessState.Processing);
            var subTicks = MachineCurrentPowerToSubSecond.GetSubTicks(_context.CurrentPower, effectiveRequestPower);

            if (0 < RemainingTicks)
            {
                // 残りtickが尽きるまでは加工継続
                // Keep processing until remaining ticks run out
                if (subTicks < RemainingTicks)
                {
                    RemainingTicks -= subTicks;
                    return ProcessState.Processing;
                }
                RemainingTicks = 0;
            }

            // 旧セーブで産出予定が無い場合はここで一度だけ確定させる（以後の保留tickで再抽選しないため）
            // Old saves lacking pending outputs get rolled once here (so held ticks afterward never re-roll)
            _pendingOutputs ??= _context.CreateRealizedOutputs(CurrentRecipe, InheritedLevel);

            // tickは尽きたが産出物が収まらない間は、加工ではなく出力詰まりとして待つ（要求電力を待機率へ落とす）
            // Once ticks are exhausted but the outputs do not fit, wait as output-blocked rather than processing (drops the request to the idle rate)
            if (!CanStoreRealizedOutputs()) return ProcessState.OutputBlocked;

            return ProcessState.Idle;
        }

        // 確定済み産出物が出力先へ収まるか。出力詰まりステートの復帰判定と共有する
        // Whether the fixed outputs fit; shared with the output-blocked state's resume decision
        public bool CanStoreRealizedOutputs()
        {
            if (CurrentRecipe == null) return true;
            return _context.OutputInventory.CanStoreOutputs(_pendingOutputs, MachineOutputFactoryUtil.CreateFluidOutputs(CurrentRecipe));
        }

        // 完了時に産出物を払い出す。詰まっている間は保持したまま出力詰まりステートへ引き継ぐ
        // Pay the outputs on completion; while blocked the job stays held and is handed to the output-blocked state
        public void OnExit()
        {
            if (!CanStoreRealizedOutputs()) return;
            PayoutAndClear();
        }

        // 産出物を払い出してジョブを空にする（旧セーブは産出予定が無いため再抽選）
        // Pay the outputs and empty the job (re-roll for old saves that lack pending outputs)
        public void PayoutAndClear()
        {
            if (CurrentRecipe == null) return;

            var outputs = _pendingOutputs ?? _context.CreateRealizedOutputs(CurrentRecipe, InheritedLevel);
            _context.OutputInventory.InsertOutputSlot(outputs, MachineOutputFactoryUtil.CreateFluidOutputs(CurrentRecipe));

            // 加工情報をクリアしてIdleが古いレシピ/進捗を報告・保存しないようにする
            // Clear the processing snapshot so idle does not report or serialize stale recipe/progress
            ClearJob();
        }

        private void ClearJob()
        {
            _pendingOutputs = null;
            CurrentRecipe = null;
            InheritedLevel = null;
            TotalTicks = 0;
            RemainingTicks = 0;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/State/MachineProcessingJob.cs`（加工中ジョブの値型。ジョブの有無はこの型の有無〈null〉だけで表し、ジョブ無しで意味の無い引数を null で並べない。セーブ JSON は平らなまま〈判断記録〉で、平らなキーからの組み立てはこの型の `RestoreFromFlatSave` 1か所に置き、`BlockTemplateUtil` と `CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveState.Restore` が呼ぶ。保存時は各プロセッサが `ProcessingMachineProcessState` の値を平らなキーへ書き戻す）

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     セーブから復元する加工中ジョブ（レシピ・残りtick・保留出力・継承レベル）。ジョブが無いことはこの型が無いこと（null）で表すので、継承レベルの null は「継承しないレシピのジョブ」だけを意味する
    ///     A running job restored from a save (recipe, remaining ticks, pending outputs, inherited level); no job is the absence of this type (null), so a null inherited level only means a job of a non-inheritance recipe
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class MachineProcessingJob
    {
        public readonly MachineRecipeMasterElement Recipe;
        public readonly uint RemainingTicks;

        // 保留出力。保留出力を持たない旧セーブは null で、完了時に一度だけ確定する
        // Pending outputs; null for old saves without them, realized once on completion
        public readonly List<IItemStack> PendingOutputs;

        // 継承レシピは 1..最大レベル、継承しないレシピは null
        // 1..max for an inheritance recipe, null for a non-inheritance recipe
        public readonly int? InheritedLevel;

        public MachineProcessingJob(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, uint remainingTicks, List<IItemStack> pendingOutputs, int? inheritedLevel)
        {
            // レシピと合わない継承レベルはセーブ破損かマイグレーション漏れなので、Lv1 などで黙って補わずに止める
            // An inherited level that does not fit the recipe means a corrupt save or a missed migration, so stop instead of silently filling in Lv1
            if (!MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsValidInheritedLevel(recipe, inheritedLevel)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"加工中ジョブの継承レベルが不正です recipe={recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} inheritedLevel={inheritedLevel}");

            Recipe = recipe;
            RemainingTicks = remainingTicks;
            PendingOutputs = pendingOutputs;
            InheritedLevel = inheritedLevel;
        }

        // セーブの平らなキーからジョブを組む。ジョブが無いか、レシピがマスタから消えていれば null
        // Builds the job from a save's flat keys; null when there is no job or its recipe has left the master
        public static MachineProcessingJob RestoreFromFlatSave(string recipeGuidStr, double remainingSeconds, List<ItemStackSaveJsonObject> pendingOutputs, int? inheritedLevel)
        {
            // ジョブ無しは Guid.Empty で保存される（清浄室機械の旧セーブはキー自体が無く null）
            // No job is saved as Guid.Empty (old clean-room saves lack the key, so it is null)
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(recipeGuidStr)) return null;
            var recipeGuid = Guid.Parse(recipeGuidStr);
            if (recipeGuid == Guid.Empty) return null;

            // レシピがマスタから消えていれば、継承レベルごとジョブを捨てる（加工中の状態は呼び出し側が Idle へ戻す。既存の縮退と同じ）
            // When the recipe has left the master, drop the job together with its inherited level (the caller returns a mid-job state to Idle, as the existing fallback does)
            var recipe = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(recipeGuid);
            if (recipe == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[MachineProcessingJob] 加工中レシピがマスタにないため、ジョブを捨てて待機へ戻します recipe={recipeGuid} inheritedLevel={inheritedLevel}");
                return null;
            }

            var restoredOutputs = pendingOutputs?.Select(item => item.ToItemStack()).ToList();
            return new MachineProcessingJob(recipe, GameUpdater.SecondsToTicks(remainingSeconds), restoredOutputs, inheritedLevel);
        }
    }
}
```

`CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveState.cs` の `Restore` の宣言から `#region Internal` の直前の空行まで（`RestoreSlots` のローカル関数はそのまま）を次に置き換え、using に `using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State;` があることを確かめる（既存）:

```csharp
        public static void Restore(Dictionary<string, object> componentStates, string saveKey, VanillaMachineInputInventory input, VanillaMachineOutputInventory output, VanillaMachineModuleInventory module, out ProcessState state, out MachineProcessingJob processingJob, out uint cycleCount, out MachineRecipeMasterElement selectedRecipe)
        {
            state = ProcessState.Idle;
            processingJob = null;
            cycleCount = 0;
            selectedRecipe = null;
            // 旧セーブではサイクル数以外が欠けるため、各値は個別に復元する
            // Older saves lack fields other than cycle count, so restore each value independently
            if (!BlockComponentStateReader.TryRead<CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveJsonObject>(componentStates, saveKey, out var saveData)) return;
            cycleCount = saveData.CycleCount;
            RestoreSlots(saveData);

            // 加工中ジョブは平らなキーから組む（レシピがマスタから消えていれば null）
            // Build the running job from the flat keys (null when its recipe left the master)
            processingJob = MachineProcessingJob.RestoreFromFlatSave(saveData.RecipeGuidStr, saveData.RemainingSeconds, saveData.PendingOutputs, null);

            // 選択レシピを復元。GUIDがマスタから消えていれば未選択に戻す（機械は停止するが壊れない）
            // Restore the selected recipe; a GUID missing from the master falls back to unselected
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(saveData.SelectedRecipeGuidStr) && Guid.TryParse(saveData.SelectedRecipeGuidStr, out var selectedGuid))
            {
                selectedRecipe = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(selectedGuid);
            }
            state = (ProcessState)saveData.State;

            // 加工中（出力詰まり含む）でジョブか選択レシピを復元できない場合は破損扱いでIdleへ戻す
            // A mid-job state (output blockage included) that cannot restore its job or selected recipe is corrupt and falls back to Idle
            var isMidJob = state == ProcessState.Processing || state == ProcessState.OutputBlocked;
            if (isMidJob && (processingJob == null || selectedRecipe == null)) state = ProcessState.Idle;

```

```csharp
        // 返却対象のアイテム材料を生成する（isRemainは消費されていないため対象外）。継承元は投入時のレベルで返す
        // Build the item stacks to refund (isRemain inputs are not consumed, so excluded); the source returns at its input level
        public static List<IItemStack> CreateRefundStacks(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int? inheritedLevel)
        {
            var stacks = new List<IItemStack>();
            for (var i = 0; i < recipe.InputItems.Length; i++)
            {
                var input = recipe.InputItems[i];
                if (input.IsRemain.HasValue && input.IsRemain.Value) continue;
                var itemId = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.ResolveInputItemId(recipe, i, inheritedLevel);
                stacks.Add(ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(itemId, input.Count));
            }
            return stacks;
        }
```

`QualityModuleOutputTest.cs` を消し（`git rm` で `.meta` も）、`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/LevelVariantOutputTest.cs` を作る:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     品質モジュールが一般機械の出力を変えないことと、レベル変種の出力がセーブをまたいで残ることを確かめる
    ///     Verifies quality modules leave general machine output unchanged and level-variant outputs survive a save
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelVariantOutputTest
    {
        // テスト用機械のスロット構成（blocks.jsonのTestElectricMachineに対応）
        // Slot layout of the test machine (matches TestElectricMachine in blocks.json)
        private const int InputSlotCount = 2;
        private const int OutputSlotCount = 3;
        private const int ModuleRangeStart = InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount;

        [Test]
        public void QualityModuleLeavesGeneralOutputAtBaseLevelTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));

            var recipe = GetMachineRecipe();
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            var quality = GetModuleOfAxis(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality);
            var productivity = GetModuleOfAxis(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Productivity);
            Assert.GreaterOrEqual(productivity.EffectValue, 1f, "生産性の追加産出が確定でない（前提が崩れている）");

            // 品質と生産性を付けて1サイクル回す（時間は両トレードオフの合算で延びる）
            // Run one cycle with quality and productivity (time stretches by both tradeoffs)
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModuleItem(quality));
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart + 1, CreateModuleItem(productivity));
            InsertRecipeInputs(block, inventory, recipe);
            var ticks = (int)Math.Round(GameUpdater.SecondsToTicks(recipe.Time) * (1f + quality.TradeoffValue + productivity.TradeoffValue));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(1 + ticks + 3, processor);

            // 出力は基準アイテム2セットで、上位変種は1つも無い
            // The output is two sets of the base item with no higher variant at all
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Idle, processor.CurrentState);
            var (baseItemId, lv2ItemId) = GetBaseAndLv2ItemIds(recipe);
            Assert.AreEqual(recipe.OutputItems[0].Count * 2, CountOutputItem(inventory, baseItemId));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountOutputItem(inventory, lv2ItemId));
        }

        [Test]
        public void VariantOutputSaveLoadTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));

            var recipe = GetMachineRecipe();
            var (block, inventory, _) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            var (_, lv2ItemId) = GetBaseAndLv2ItemIds(recipe);

            // 束縛(ADR 0042)のため、出力スロットへ置く前にレシピを選択してから変種を置いてセーブする
            // Binding (ADR 0042) needs the recipe selected first; then place the variant and save
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);
            inventory.SetItem(InputSlotCount, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(lv2ItemId, 7));
            var saveState = block.GetSaveState();

            // ロード後も変種ItemIdと数量が残る
            // The variant ItemId and count survive the load
            var blockGuid = MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId).BlockGuid;
            var loadedBlock = ServerContext.BlockFactory.Load(blockGuid, new BlockInstanceId(301), saveState, block.BlockPositionInfo);
            var loadedInventory = loadedBlock.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();
            Assert.AreEqual(lv2ItemId, loadedInventory.GetItem(InputSlotCount).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(7, loadedInventory.GetItem(InputSlotCount).Count);
        }

        private static (IBlock block, VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent inventory, VanillaMachineProcessorComponent processor) PlaceMachine(Vector3Int position)
        {
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId, position, BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            return (block, block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>(), block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineProcessorComponent>());
        }

        private static MachineRecipeMasterElement GetMachineRecipe()
        {
            var machineBlockGuid = MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId).BlockGuid;
            return MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.MachineRecipes.Data.First(r => r.BlockGuid == machineBlockGuid);
        }

        // 出力の基準ItemIdとLv2変種ItemId（ファミリーがある前提も確かめる）
        // The output's base and Lv2 variant ItemIds (also asserts the family exists)
        private static (ItemId baseItemId, ItemId lv2ItemId) GetBaseAndLv2ItemIds(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            var baseItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.OutputItems[0].ItemGuid);
            Assert.IsTrue(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.HasLevelFamily(baseItemId));
            var lv2ItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariantItemId(baseItemId, 2);
            Assert.AreNotEqual(baseItemId, lv2ItemId);
            return (baseItemId, lv2ItemId);
        }

        private static void InsertRecipeInputs(IBlock block, VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent inventory, MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);
            foreach (var inputItem in recipe.InputItems)
            {
                inventory.InsertItem(ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(inputItem.ItemGuid, inputItem.Count));
            }
        }

        // 毎tick有効要求電力ちょうどを供給して進める（電力比1.0で確率的丸めを排除する）
        // Advance ticks supplying exactly the effective request power (ratio 1.0 removes probabilistic rounding)
        private static void AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(int ticks, VanillaMachineProcessorComponent processor)
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < ticks; i++)
            {
                processor.SupplyExternalPower(processor.EffectiveRequestPower);
                GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            }
        }

        private static ModuleMasterElement GetModuleOfAxis(string effectAxis)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules.First(m => m.EffectAxis == effectAxis);
        }

        private static IItemStack CreateModuleItem(ModuleMasterElement moduleElement)
        {
            return ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(moduleElement.ItemGuid), 1);
        }

        private static int CountOutputItem(VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent inventory, ItemId itemId)
        {
            var total = 0;
            for (var i = InputSlotCount; i < InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount; i++)
            {
                var stack = inventory.GetItem(i);
                if (stack.Id == itemId) total += stack.Count;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }
}
```

---

### Task C4: 継承レベルの保存と V6→V7 マイグレーション

加工中ジョブの継承レベルを両プロセッサのセーブへ載せ、旧セーブには `inheritedLevel: null`（継承しない）を明示で足すマイグレーションを入れる（セーブ形式の変更。AGENTS.md の3点セット）。版6には継承レシピが無いので null が正しい。継承レシピのジョブで値が欠けたセーブは、C3 の `MachineProcessingJob` の ctor が `IsValidInheritedLevel` で拒んでロードを止める（Lv1 で補わない）。継承レシピのジョブを持つセーブをそのレシピが消えたマスタで開いたときは、`RestoreFromFlatSave` が継承レベルごとジョブを捨てて警告を出し、加工中の状態は Idle へ戻る（既存の「レシピが消えたら Idle」の縮退と同じ）。

セーブの形は既存の平らな形（`VanillaMachineProcessorSaveJsonObject` の並列フィールド。前例 `VanillaMachineSaveComponent`）に1キー足すだけにし、ジョブを1つの入れ子オブジェクトへ畳み直すことはしない（裁定済みの据え置き）。メモリ上は C3 の `MachineProcessingJob` で受け、平らなキーからの組み立ては `MachineProcessingJob.RestoreFromFlatSave` の1か所、平らなキーへの書き戻しは各プロセッサの保存（`GetSaveJsonObject`・`CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveState.Build`）に閉じる。本タスクはそこへ継承レベルのキーを通すだけで、ctor の形は変えない。

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Game/SaveLoad/SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7Test.cs`

```csharp
using Game.SaveLoad.Migration.Steps;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.SaveLoad
{
    public class SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7Test
    {
        private const string VanillaKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.VanillaMachineSaveComponent";
        private const string CleanRoomKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent";

        [Test]
        public void 通常機械とクリーンルーム機械に継承レベルnullが入り他のキーは残るTest()
        {
            var vanilla = JObject.Parse("{\"inputSlot\":[],\"processor\":{\"state\":1,\"remainingSeconds\":0.5,\"recipeGuid\":\"r\"}}");
            var cleanRoom = JObject.Parse("{\"cycleCount\":3,\"state\":0}");
            var save = Save(
                new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [VanillaKey] = vanilla } },
                new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [CleanRoomKey] = cleanRoom } });

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsTrue(result.IsConverted, result.FailureReason);
            var migratedVanilla = (JObject)result.Save["world"][0]["state"][VanillaKey];
            Assert.AreEqual(JTokenType.Null, migratedVanilla["processor"]["inheritedLevel"].Type);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, migratedVanilla["processor"]["state"].Value<int>());
            Assert.AreEqual("r", migratedVanilla["processor"]["recipeGuid"].Value<string>());
            var migratedCleanRoom = (JObject)result.Save["world"][1]["state"][CleanRoomKey];
            Assert.AreEqual(JTokenType.Null, migratedCleanRoom["inheritedLevel"].Type);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, migratedCleanRoom["cycleCount"].Value<int>());
        }

        [Test]
        public void 既に継承レベルを持つものと機械以外は素通しされるTest()
        {
            var save = Save(
                JObject.Parse($"{{\"state\":{{\"{VanillaKey}\":{{\"processor\":{{\"inheritedLevel\":3}}}}}}}}"),
                JObject.Parse("{\"state\":{\"ChestComponent\":{\"items\":[]}}}"),
                JObject.Parse("{\"blockGuid\":\"z\"}"),
                JObject.Parse("{\"state\":null}"));

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsTrue(result.IsConverted, result.FailureReason);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, result.Save["world"][0]["state"][VanillaKey]["processor"]["inheritedLevel"].Value<int>());
            Assert.IsNull(result.Save["world"][1]["state"]["ChestComponent"]["inheritedLevel"]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void processorがオブジェクトでなければ失敗するTest()
        {
            var save = Save(JObject.Parse($"{{\"state\":{{\"{VanillaKey}\":{{\"processor\":5}}}}}}"));

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsFalse(result.IsConverted);
            StringAssert.Contains("processor", result.FailureReason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 変換元の版は6Test()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(6, new SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7().FromVersion);
        }

        private static JObject Save(params JObject[] blocks)
        {
            return new JObject { ["worldVersion"] = 6, ["world"] = new JArray(blocks) };
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/Upgrade/LevelInheritanceSaveLoadTest.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Paths;
using Game.SaveLoad.Interface;
using Game.SaveLoad.Json;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.CombinedTest.Game;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade.LevelInheritanceTestHelper;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     加工中ジョブの継承レベルがセーブ・ロードで保たれ、欠けたセーブは読まずに止まり、レシピが消えたジョブは継承レベルごと捨てて待機へ戻り、版6の通常機械は継承レベル無しで読めることを検証する
    ///     Verifies the running job's inherited level survives save/load, a save missing it stops loading, a job whose recipe vanished is dropped with its level and falls back to idle, and a version-6 plain machine loads with no inherited level
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelInheritanceSaveLoadTest
    {
        private static readonly Vector3Int MachinePosition = new(1, 1, 1);
        private const string VanillaKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.VanillaMachineSaveComponent";
        private string _archiveRoot;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            _archiveRoot = SaveLoadPreparerTestFixture.ArchiveRootForThisRun();
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(_archiveRoot)) Directory.Delete(_archiveRoot, true);
        }

        [Test]
        public void InheritedLevelSurvivesSaveLoadTest()
        {
            var saveJson = BuildInheritanceProcessingSave().ToString();

            // 別コンテナへロードし、選択解除の返却が Lv3 であることを見る
            // Load into a fresh container and check the clear-selection refund is Lv3
            var (_, loadProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            (loadProvider.GetService<IWorldSaveDataLoader>() as WorldLoaderFromJson).Load(saveJson);
            var overflow = CreateOverflow(10);
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineRecipeSelectionResult.Success, GetProcessor().ClearSelectedRecipe(overflow));
            Assert.AreEqual(2, CountItem(overflow, 0, 10, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void InheritanceJobWithoutLevelStopsLoadingTest()
        {
            // 継承レシピの加工中ジョブから継承レベルを消すと、Lv1 で補わずロードが止まる
            // Stripping the level from an inheritance job stops loading instead of filling in Lv1
            var save = BuildInheritanceProcessingSave();
            Assert.IsTrue(ProcessorJson(save).Remove("inheritedLevel"));
            var (_, loadProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var loader = loadProvider.GetService<IWorldSaveDataLoader>() as WorldLoaderFromJson;
            var exception = Assert.Catch<Exception>(() => loader.Load(save.ToString()));
            StringAssert.Contains("継承レベル", exception.ToString());
        }

        [Test]
        public void InheritanceJobWithMissingRecipeFallsBackToIdleTest()
        {
            // 継承レベルつきのジョブのレシピGUIDをマスタに無い値へ替えると、例外で止めずにジョブを捨てて待機へ戻る
            // Swapping the job's recipe GUID for one the master lacks drops the job instead of throwing and falls back to idle
            var save = BuildInheritanceProcessingSave();
            ProcessorJson(save)["recipeGuid"] = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000deadbeef";
            var (_, loadProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex("加工中レシピがマスタにない"));
            (loadProvider.GetService<IWorldSaveDataLoader>() as WorldLoaderFromJson).Load(save.ToString());

            // 待機に戻り、保存し直すと継承レベルも残らない
            // It is idle, and re-saving keeps no inherited level either
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Idle, GetProcessor().CurrentState);
            var resaved = JObject.Parse(loadProvider.GetService<AssembleSaveJsonText>().AssembleSaveJson());
            Assert.AreEqual(JTokenType.Null, ProcessorJson(resaved)["inheritedLevel"].Type);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Version6PlainMachineLoadsWithoutInheritedLevelTest()
        {
            // 通常レシピで加工中の機械から継承レベルを消して版6と名乗らせ、ファイル経由でマイグレーション連鎖を通す
            // Strip the level from a plain-recipe job, label it version 6 and load from a file so the migration chain runs
            var save = BuildPlainProcessingSave();
            Assert.IsTrue(ProcessorJson(save).Remove("inheritedLevel"));
            save["worldVersion"] = 6;
            Directory.CreateDirectory(_archiveRoot);
            var sourcePath = WorldDataDirectory.FromWorldRoot(_archiveRoot).SaveJsonFilePath;
            File.WriteAllText(sourcePath, save.ToString());
            var options = new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory)
            {
                worldDataDirectory = WorldDataDirectory.FromServerDataMap(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory, sourcePath),
            };
            var (_, loadProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(options);
            loadProvider.GetRequiredService<IWorldSaveDataLoader>().LoadOrInitialize();

            // 加工中のまま読め、保存し直すと継承レベルは null（版6に継承レシピは無かった）
            // It loads still processing and re-saves with a null level (version 6 had no inheritance recipes)
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Processing, GetProcessor().CurrentState);
            var resaved = JObject.Parse(loadProvider.GetService<AssembleSaveJsonText>().AssembleSaveJson());
            Assert.AreEqual(JTokenType.Null, ProcessorJson(resaved)["inheritedLevel"].Type);
        }

        // Lv3 で加工中の継承機械を持つ現行セーブを作る
        // Build a current save holding the inheritance machine mid-job at Lv3
        private static JObject BuildInheritanceProcessingSave()
        {
            var (_, provider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(MachinePosition);
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid));
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));
            inventory.InsertItem(CreateTest1(1));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(2, processor);
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Processing, processor.CurrentState);

            var save = JObject.Parse(provider.GetService<AssembleSaveJsonText>().AssembleSaveJson());
            Assert.AreEqual(3, ProcessorJson(save)["inheritedLevel"].Value<int>());
            return save;
        }

        // 通常レシピ（テストマスタの先頭）で加工中の通常機械を持つ現行セーブを作る
        // Build a current save holding a plain machine mid-job on the plain recipe (the first test recipe)
        private static JObject BuildPlainProcessingSave()
        {
            var (_, provider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var recipe = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.MachineRecipes.Data[0];
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId, MachinePosition, BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);
            var inventory = block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();
            foreach (var input in recipe.InputItems) inventory.InsertItem(ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(input.ItemGuid, input.Count));
            var processor = block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineProcessorComponent>();
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(2, processor);
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Processing, processor.CurrentState);

            var save = JObject.Parse(provider.GetService<AssembleSaveJsonText>().AssembleSaveJson());
            Assert.AreEqual(JTokenType.Null, ProcessorJson(save)["inheritedLevel"].Type);
            return save;
        }

        private static VanillaMachineProcessorComponent GetProcessor()
        {
            return ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(MachinePosition).GetComponent<VanillaMachineProcessorComponent>();
        }

        private static JObject ProcessorJson(JObject save)
        {
            foreach (var block in (JArray)save["world"])
            {
                if (block["X"].Value<int>() == MachinePosition.x && block["Y"].Value<int>() == MachinePosition.y && block["Z"].Value<int>() == MachinePosition.z) return (JObject)block["state"][VanillaKey]["processor"];
            }
            Assert.Fail($"セーブに {MachinePosition} のブロックがありません");
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: マイグレーションを書いて登録する**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.SaveLoad/Migration/Steps/SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7.cs`

```csharp
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.SaveLoad.Migration.Steps
{
    // V6→V7移行: 通常機械とクリーンルーム機械の加工状態に継承レベル null を明示で足す（版6に継承レシピは無いため「継承しない」が正しい）
    // V6→V7 migration: add an explicit null inherited level to normal and clean-room machine processing state (version 6 had no inheritance recipes, so "no inheritance" is exact)
    public sealed class SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7 : ISaveMigrationStep
    {
        // コンポーネントのSaveKey(typeof FullName)。ステップは現行の型を参照しないので文字列で持つ
        // Component SaveKeys (typeof FullName); the step never references live types, so they are kept as strings
        private const string VanillaMachineSaveKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.VanillaMachineSaveComponent";
        private const string CleanRoomMachineSaveKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent";
        private const string InheritedLevelKey = "inheritedLevel";

        public int FromVersion => 6;

        public SaveMigrationStepResult Migrate(JObject save)
        {
            if (!(save["world"] is JArray world)) return Fail($"セーブのworldが配列ではないため変換できません。 type={save["world"]?.Type}");

            var vanillaCount = 0;
            var cleanRoomCount = 0;
            foreach (var blockToken in world)
            {
                if (!(blockToken is JObject block)) return Fail($"world要素がオブジェクトではないため変換できません。 type={blockToken.Type}");

                // stateが無いブロックは機械ではないので対象外
                // A block without state is not a machine, so it is out of scope
                var stateToken = block["state"];
                if (stateToken == null || stateToken.Type == JTokenType.Null) continue;
                if (!(stateToken is JObject state)) return Fail($"world要素のstateがオブジェクトではありません。 type={stateToken.Type}");

                // 通常機械はprocessorサブオブジェクトへ足す
                // A normal machine gets the key inside its processor sub-object
                var vanillaToken = state[VanillaMachineSaveKey];
                if (vanillaToken != null && vanillaToken.Type != JTokenType.Null)
                {
                    if (!(vanillaToken is JObject vanilla) || !(vanilla["processor"] is JObject processor)) return Fail($"{VanillaMachineSaveKey} の processor がオブジェクトではありません。 type={vanillaToken["processor"]?.Type}");
                    if (!processor.ContainsKey(InheritedLevelKey))
                    {
                        processor[InheritedLevelKey] = JValue.CreateNull();
                        vanillaCount++;
                    }
                }

                // クリーンルーム機械は直下へ足す
                // A clean-room machine gets the key at its top level
                var cleanRoomToken = state[CleanRoomMachineSaveKey];
                if (cleanRoomToken != null && cleanRoomToken.Type != JTokenType.Null)
                {
                    if (!(cleanRoomToken is JObject cleanRoom)) return Fail($"{CleanRoomMachineSaveKey} がオブジェクトではありません。 type={cleanRoomToken.Type}");
                    if (!cleanRoom.ContainsKey(InheritedLevelKey))
                    {
                        cleanRoom[InheritedLevelKey] = JValue.CreateNull();
                        cleanRoomCount++;
                    }
                }
            }

            Debug.Log($"セーブを版6から版7へ変換しました。継承レベルを足した通常機械={vanillaCount}台 クリーンルーム機械={cleanRoomCount}台");
            return SaveMigrationStepResult.Converted(save);

            #region Internal

            SaveMigrationStepResult Fail(string failureReason)
            {
                // 直接実行した場合も拒否理由を残す
                // Preserve the refusal reason even when the step is called directly
                Debug.LogWarning($"セーブを版6から版7へ変換できません: {failureReason}");
                return SaveMigrationStepResult.Failed(failureReason);
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

### Task C5: Part B 向けの品質モジュール API（最高 tier と効果合計）

Part B の成膜（グレード上限＝最高 tier＋1）・EUV・ダイシング（品質効果による低減）が、機械から「装着中の品質モジュールの最高 tier」と「品質効果の合計」を取り出せるようにする。

**Files:**
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Module/MachineModuleEffect.cs`
- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/Upgrade/MachineModuleQualityTierTest.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: C1 の効果集計（不許可モジュールの除外）
- Produces（Part B が使う）:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     品質モジュールの最高 tier と効果合計が機械から取り出せることを検証する
    ///     Verifies the highest quality-module tier and the summed quality effect are readable from a machine
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineModuleQualityTierTest
    {
        // TestElectricMachine は品質可・入力2・出力3・モジュール4
        // TestElectricMachine allows quality and has 2 inputs, 3 outputs and 4 module slots
        private const int ModuleRangeStart = 5;

        [Test]
        public void AggregateReportsHighestQualityTierTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var tier1 = QualityModuleOfTier(1);
            var tier2 = QualityModuleOfTier(2);
            var speed = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules.First(m => m.EffectAxis == ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed);

            // tier1×1 と tier2×2 なら最高は2、合計は個数加重
            // tier1 x1 plus tier2 x2 gives highest 2 and a count-weighted sum
            var effect = MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate(new List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> { new(tier1, 1), new(tier2, 2) });
            Assert.AreEqual(2, effect.HighestQualityModuleTier);
            Assert.AreEqual(tier1.EffectValue + tier2.EffectValue * 2, effect.QualityShift, 0.0001f);

            // 品質モジュールが無ければ0
            // Zero without any quality module
            var speedOnly = MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate(new List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> { new(speed, 1) });
            Assert.AreEqual(0, speedOnly.HighestQualityModuleTier);
        }

        [Test]
        public void MachineComponentExposesHighestQualityTierTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId, new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1), BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            var inventory = block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(QualityModuleOfTier(1).ItemGuid, 1));
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart + 1, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(QualityModuleOfTier(2).ItemGuid, 1));

            var effect = block.GetComponent<MachineModuleEffectComponent>().AggregateCurrent();
            Assert.AreEqual(2, effect.HighestQualityModuleTier);
        }

        private static ModuleMasterElement QualityModuleOfTier(int tier)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules.First(m => m.EffectAxis == ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality && m.Tier == tier);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task C6: モジュールスロットのスタック上限（サーバー）

モジュールスロット1つに置けるモジュールの数を、items.json の段階表と研究 `unlockModuleSlotStackLevel` で決める。上限は全機械で共通。移動は上限まで入れて余りを戻し、上限を超える入れ替えは拒否し、超えて入っている分は効果に数えない。状態は保存せず、研究・チャレンジの clearedActions のロード時再実行で戻す。

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/Upgrade/ModuleSlotStackLimitTest.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Game.Context;
using Game.PlayerIdentity;
using Game.PlayerInventory.Interface;
using Game.Research;
using Game.SaveLoad.Interface;
using Game.SaveLoad.Json;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse.Util.InventoryService;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util.PlayerIdentity;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     モジュールスロットのスタック上限（移動の頭打ち・入れ替えの拒否・効果の頭打ち・研究での引き上げと復元）を検証する
    ///     Verifies the module-slot stack limit: capped moves, refused swaps, capped effects, and research raising and restoring it
    /// </summary>
    public class ModuleSlotStackLimitTest
    {
        // TestElectricMachine は入力2・出力3・モジュール4
        // TestElectricMachine has 2 inputs, 3 outputs and 4 module slots
        private const int ModuleRangeStart = 5;

        [Test]
        public void MoveIntoModuleSlotStopsAtStackLimitTest()
        {
            var (serviceProvider, _, mainInventory, block) = Setup();
            var machineInventory = block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();
            Assert.AreEqual(3, serviceProvider.GetService<IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup>().CurrentStackLimit);
            mainInventory.SetItem(0, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed, 5));

            // 上限3なので3個だけ入り、2個はプレイヤー側に戻る
            // With a limit of 3 only 3 go in and 2 return to the player
            Assert.AreEqual(InventoryItemMoveResult.Moved, InventoryItemMoveService.Move(mainInventory, 0, machineInventory, ModuleRangeStart, 5));
            Assert.AreEqual(3, machineInventory.GetItem(ModuleRangeStart).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, mainInventory.GetItem(0).Count);

            // 満杯のスロットへは1個も入らず、全部戻る
            // A full slot takes none and everything returns
            InventoryItemMoveService.Move(mainInventory, 0, machineInventory, ModuleRangeStart, 2);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, machineInventory.GetItem(ModuleRangeStart).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, mainInventory.GetItem(0).Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ResearchRaisesStackLimitTest()
        {
            var (serviceProvider, playerId, mainInventory, block) = Setup();
            var machineInventory = block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();

            // 研究でレベル1（上限6）になる
            // The research raises it to level 1 (limit 6)
            Assert.IsTrue(serviceProvider.GetService<IResearchDataStore>().CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.ModuleSlotStackResearchGuid, playerId));
            Assert.AreEqual(6, serviceProvider.GetService<IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup>().CurrentStackLimit);

            mainInventory.SetItem(0, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed, 5));
            InventoryItemMoveService.Move(mainInventory, 0, machineInventory, ModuleRangeStart, 5);
            Assert.AreEqual(5, machineInventory.GetItem(ModuleRangeStart).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(ItemMaster.EmptyItemId, mainInventory.GetItem(0).Id);

            // 段階表の外のレベル（テストマスタは 0..1）は丸めずに止める
            // A level outside the table (0..1 in the test master) stops instead of clamping
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => serviceProvider.GetService<IModuleSlotStackLimitUnlocker>().UnlockLevel(2));
        }

        [Test]
        public void SwapAboveStackLimitIsRejectedTest()
        {
            var (_, _, mainInventory, block) = Setup();
            var machineInventory = block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();
            var efficiency = CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Efficiency, 1);
            machineInventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart, efficiency);

            // 入れ替えは丸ごと置くため、上限を超える5個は拒否される
            // A swap writes the whole stack, so 5 above the limit is refused
            mainInventory.SetItem(0, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed, 5));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.ExceedsModuleSlotStackLimit, machineInventory.CheckPlacement(ModuleRangeStart, mainInventory.GetItem(0)));
            Assert.AreEqual(InventoryItemMoveResult.RejectedByDestination, InventoryItemMoveService.Move(mainInventory, 0, machineInventory, ModuleRangeStart, 5));
            Assert.AreEqual(efficiency.Id, machineInventory.GetItem(ModuleRangeStart).Id);

            // 上限以内なら入れ替わる
            // Within the limit the swap goes through
            var speed = CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed, 3);
            mainInventory.SetItem(0, speed);
            Assert.AreEqual(InventoryItemMoveResult.Moved, InventoryItemMoveService.Move(mainInventory, 0, machineInventory, ModuleRangeStart, 3));
            Assert.AreEqual(speed.Id, machineInventory.GetItem(ModuleRangeStart).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(efficiency.Id, mainInventory.GetItem(0).Id);
        }

        [Test]
        public void EffectCountsOnlyUpToStackLimitTest()
        {
            var (_, _, _, block) = Setup();

            // 判定を通さずに5個書いても、効果は上限の3個分
            // Even with 5 written past the check, the effect counts only the limit of 3
            block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>().SetItem(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed, 5));
            var speed = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules.First(m => m.EffectAxis == ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed);
            var expected = MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate(new List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> { new(speed, 3) });

            var actual = block.GetComponent<MachineModuleEffectComponent>().AggregateCurrent();
            Assert.AreEqual(expected.ProcessingTimeMultiplier, actual.ProcessingTimeMultiplier, 0.0001f);
            Assert.AreEqual(expected.PowerMultiplier, actual.PowerMultiplier, 0.0001f);
        }

        [Test]
        public void StackLimitIsRestoredFromResearchOnLoadTest()
        {
            var (serviceProvider, playerId, _, block) = Setup();
            serviceProvider.GetService<IResearchDataStore>().CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.ModuleSlotStackResearchGuid, playerId);
            block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>().SetItem(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed, 5));
            var saveJson = serviceProvider.GetService<AssembleSaveJsonText>().AssembleSaveJson();

            // 新しいコンテナでロードすると、研究の再実行で上限6が戻り、5個がそのまま残る
            // Loading into a fresh container replays the research, restoring limit 6 and keeping the 5 modules
            var (_, loadServiceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            (loadServiceProvider.GetService<IWorldSaveDataLoader>() as WorldLoaderFromJson).Load(saveJson);
            Assert.AreEqual(6, loadServiceProvider.GetService<IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup>().CurrentStackLimit);
            var loadedInventory = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(5, loadedInventory.GetItem(ModuleRangeStart).Count);
        }

        private static (ServiceProvider serviceProvider, int playerId, IOpenableInventory mainInventory, IBlock block) Setup()
        {
            var (_, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var playerId = PlayerIdentityTestHelper.Register(serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<PlayerIdentityRegistry>(), "steam:1").PlayerId;
            var mainInventory = serviceProvider.GetService<IPlayerInventoryDataStore>().GetInventoryData(playerId).MainOpenableInventory;
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId, new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1), BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            return (serviceProvider, playerId, mainInventory, block);
        }

        private static IItemStack CreateModule(string effectAxis, int count)
        {
            var module = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules.First(m => m.EffectAxis == effectAxis);
            return ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(module.ItemGuid, count);
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 段階表の util と検証を書く**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/MachineUpgrade/ModuleSlotStackLimitMasterUtil.cs`

```csharp
using Core.Master;

namespace Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     モジュールスロットのスタック上限の段階表を引く。表の形はマスタ検証が保証する
    ///     Looks up the module-slot stack limit table; master validation guarantees its shape
    /// </summary>
    public static class ModuleSlotStackLimitMasterUtil
    {
        // level は 0..GetMaxLevel()。範囲は起動時の検証が保証し、DataStore の UnlockLevel は範囲外を例外で止めるので、ここでは丸めない
        // level is 0..GetMaxLevel(); boot validation guarantees the range and the DataStore's UnlockLevel throws on anything outside, so no clamping here
        public static int GetStackLimit(int level)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.ModuleSlotStackLimitLevels[level].StackLimit;
        }

        public static int GetMaxLevel()
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.ModuleSlotStackLimitLevels.Length - 1;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;

namespace Core.Master.Validator.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     モジュールスロットのスタック上限表（1段以上・各1以上・単調非減少）を検証する
    ///     Validates the module-slot stack limit table: at least one level, each at least 1, never decreasing
    /// </summary>
    public static class ModuleSlotStackLimitLevelsValidator
    {
        public static string Validate(Items items)
        {
            var levels = items.ModuleSlotStackLimitLevels;
            if (levels.Length == 0) return "[ItemMaster] moduleSlotStackLimitLevels must have at least one level\n";

            var logs = "";
            for (var i = 0; i < levels.Length; i++)
            {
                if (levels[i].StackLimit < 1) logs += $"[ItemMaster] moduleSlotStackLimitLevels[{i}].stackLimit ({levels[i].StackLimit}) must be at least 1\n";
                if (0 < i && levels[i].StackLimit < levels[i - 1].StackLimit) logs += $"[ItemMaster] moduleSlotStackLimitLevels[{i}].stackLimit ({levels[i].StackLimit}) must not be below level {i - 1} ({levels[i - 1].StackLimit})\n";
            }
            return logs;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/MachineUpgrade/MachineUpgradeGameActionValidator.cs`

```csharp
using Mooresmaster.Model.GameActionModule;

namespace Core.Master.Validator.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     機械の強化系アクション（スロット上限・製作上限）の引数を検証する。研究とチャレンジの両方から呼ぶ
    ///     Validates machine-upgrade action params (slot limit, craft cap); called from both research and challenges
    /// </summary>
    public static class MachineUpgradeGameActionValidator
    {
        public static string Validate(GameActionElement[] actions, string ownerLabel)
        {
            // 既存の検証と同じく、アクション配列の欠落は空として扱う
            // Like the existing validators, a missing action array counts as empty
            if (actions == null) return "";

            var logs = "";
            foreach (var action in actions)
            {
                switch (action.GameActionParam)
                {
                    case UnlockModuleSlotStackLevelGameActionParam slotLevel:
                        logs += ValidateModuleSlotStackLevel(slotLevel);
                        break;
                }
            }
            return logs;

            #region Internal

            string ValidateModuleSlotStackLevel(UnlockModuleSlotStackLevelGameActionParam param)
            {
                // 実行時の util（Game.Block.Interface）は使わず、生のマスタの段階表を読む
                // Read the raw master table instead of the runtime util (Game.Block.Interface)
                var maxLevel = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.ModuleSlotStackLimitLevels.Length - 1;
                if (0 <= param.Level && param.Level <= maxLevel) return "";
                return $"[MachineUpgrade] {ownerLabel} unlockModuleSlotStackLevel level {param.Level} is outside 0..{maxLevel}\n";
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Mooresmaster.Model.GameActionModule;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     研究で段階解放するモジュールスロットのスタック上限。保存せず、研究・チャレンジのロード時再実行で戻す
    ///     Module-slot stack limit unlocked in stages by research; not saved, restored by the load-time replay of research and challenges
    /// </summary>
    public class ModuleSlotStackLimitDataStore : IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup, IModuleSlotStackLimitUnlocker
    {
        public int CurrentLevel { get; private set; }
        public int CurrentStackLimit => ModuleSlotStackLimitMasterUtil.GetStackLimit(CurrentLevel);
        public IObservable<int> OnStackLimitChanged => _onStackLimitChanged;

        private readonly Subject<int> _onStackLimitChanged = new();

        public void UnlockLevel(int level)
        {
            // レベルは下がらない冪等操作。範囲 0..最大 は MachineUpgradeGameActionValidator が起動時に保証するので丸めず、範囲外は呼び出し側の誤りとして止める（製作上限と同じ扱い）
            // Idempotent and never decreasing; MachineUpgradeGameActionValidator guarantees 0..max at boot, so no clamping and an out-of-range level stops as a caller bug (same as the craft cap)
            if (level < 0 || ModuleSlotStackLimitMasterUtil.GetMaxLevel() < level) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(level), level, $"モジュールスロットのスタックレベルが段階表の範囲 0..{ModuleSlotStackLimitMasterUtil.GetMaxLevel()} の外です");
            // silent-ok: 同じか下のレベルは研究のロード時再実行・チャレンジとの重なりで正常に来る / 現在の上限は機械UIのモジュール欄（C9）に出る
            if (level <= CurrentLevel) return;

            // 上限が実際に変わったときだけ通知する
            // Notify only when the limit actually changes
            var beforeLimit = CurrentStackLimit;
            CurrentLevel = level;
            if (CurrentStackLimit != beforeLimit) _onStackLimitChanged.OnNext(CurrentStackLimit);
        }

        public void ApplyUnlockModuleSlotStackLevelAction(GameActionElement action)
        {
            if (action.GameActionType != GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockModuleSlotStackLevel)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"[ModuleSlotStackLimitDataStore] Unexpected action type: {action.GameActionType}");
                return;
            }
            UnlockLevel(((UnlockModuleSlotStackLevelGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam).Level);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Event;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Event;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     機械のモジュールスロット（統合スロットの第3レンジ）
    ///     The machine's module slots (third range in unified numbering)
    /// </summary>
    public class VanillaMachineModuleInventory : IVanillaMachineSubInventory
    {
        public IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> ModuleSlot => _itemDataStoreService.InventoryItems;
        IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> IVanillaMachineSubInventory.Items => ModuleSlot;

        private readonly OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService _itemDataStoreService;
        private readonly bool _allowQualityModule;
        private readonly IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup _stackLimitLookup;

        public VanillaMachineModuleInventory(
            int moduleSlotCount,
            bool allowQualityModule,
            IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup stackLimitLookup,
            BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEvent blockInventoryUpdate,
            BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId,
            int inputSlotSize,
            int outputSlotSize)
        {
            _allowQualityModule = allowQualityModule;
            _stackLimitLookup = stackLimitLookup;
            _itemDataStoreService = new OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService(InvokeEvent, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory, moduleSlotCount);

            #region Internal

            void InvokeEvent(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)
            {
                // 第3レンジのためオフセットを加算して通知
                // Offset by the first two ranges when notifying
                blockInventoryUpdate.OnInventoryUpdateInvoke(new BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEventProperties(
                    blockInstanceId, slot + inputSlotSize + outputSlotSize, itemStack));
            }

            #endregion
        }

        public void SetItem(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            _itemDataStoreService.SetItem(slot, itemStack);
        }

        // 不許可の品質モジュールと、上限を超える入れ替えだけを拒否する。非モジュールは従来どおり置ける（効果集計が無視する）
        // Refuse only a disallowed quality module and a swap above the limit; non-module items stay placeable as before (the aggregation ignores them)
        public MachineSlotPlacementCheck CheckPlacement(int localSlot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            if (itemStack.Id == ItemMaster.EmptyItemId) return MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed;

            // 別アイテムとの入れ替えは丸ごと置くので上限超えを拒否する。空き・同じIDへは ReplaceItem が上限で切る
            // A swap with a different item writes the whole stack, so refuse it above the limit; ReplaceItem clips empty or same-ID targets
            var isSwap = MachineSubInventoryReplaceUtil.IsSwap(ModuleSlot[localSlot], itemStack);
            if (isSwap && GetSlotStackLimit() < itemStack.Count) return MachineSlotPlacementCheck.ExceedsModuleSlotStackLimit;

            var module = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetModuleByItemIdOrNull(itemStack.Id);
            if (module == null) return MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed;
            return IsModuleEffective(module) ? MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed : MachineSlotPlacementCheck.ModuleNotAllowedOnMachine;
        }

        // 研究で上がる全機械共通の上限
        // The limit shared by every machine, raised by research
        public int GetSlotStackLimit() => _stackLimitLookup.CurrentStackLimit;

        // この機械で効くモジュールか。品質は許可された機械だけで効く
        // Whether the module works on this machine; quality works only where allowed
        public bool IsModuleEffective(ModuleMasterElement module)
        {
            return _allowQualityModule || module.EffectAxis != ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality;
        }

        public void SetItemWithoutEvent(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            _itemDataStoreService.SetItemWithoutEvent(slot, itemStack);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Inventory/MachineSubInventoryReplaceUtil.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     統合インベントリの ReplaceItem 本体。空きか同じIDならスロット上限の空きまで足して残りを返し、別IDなら入れ替える
    ///     Body of the unified inventory's ReplaceItem: fill an empty or same-ID slot up to its limit and return the rest, or swap a different ID
    /// </summary>
    internal static class MachineSubInventoryReplaceUtil
    {
        // 空きでも同じIDでもなければ入れ替え（モジュールの CheckPlacement と Replace が共有する判定）
        // A swap when the slot is neither empty nor the same ID (shared by the module CheckPlacement and Replace)
        public static bool IsSwap(IItemStack current, IItemStack incoming)
        {
            return current.Id != ItemMaster.EmptyItemId && current.Id != incoming.Id;
        }

        public static IItemStack Replace(IVanillaMachineSubInventory subInventory, int localSlot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            var current = subInventory.Items[localSlot];

            // 別IDは入れ替える（上限超えの入れ替えは CheckPlacement が先に拒否している）
            // Swap a different ID (CheckPlacement has already refused a swap above the limit)
            if (IsSwap(current, itemStack))
            {
                subInventory.SetItem(localSlot, itemStack);
                return current;
            }

            // スロット上限の空きまでだけ足し、入らなかった分とアイテム最大スタックのあふれを合わせて返す
            // Add only up to the slot limit's room and return what did not fit together with any max-stack overflow
            var room = Math.Max(0, subInventory.GetSlotStackLimit() - current.Count);
            var overflowCount = Math.Max(0, itemStack.Count - room);
            var accepted = itemStack.SubItem(overflowCount);
            var overflow = itemStack.SubItem(itemStack.Count - overflowCount);
            var result = current.AddItem(accepted);
            subInventory.SetItem(localSlot, result.ProcessResultItemStack);
            return result.RemainderItemStack.AddItem(overflow).ProcessResultItemStack;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        /// <summary>
        ///     アイテムの置き換え。同じアイテムIDか空きならスロット上限まで足して余りを返し、違うIDなら入れ替える
        /// </summary>
        public IItemStack ReplaceItem(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)

            return MachineSubInventoryReplaceUtil.Replace(subInventory, localSlot, itemStack);
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Mooresmaster.Model.GameActionModule;

namespace Game.Action
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ロード時・チャレンジ再開時に再実行する解放系アクションの種別。付与とスキットは一度きりなので入れない。全種別がこの集合か一度きりのどちらか一方に入ることは UnlockReplayGameActionTypesCoverageTest が固定する
    ///     Unlock action kinds re-run on load and challenge resume; grants and skits happen once, so they are excluded; UnlockReplayGameActionTypesCoverageTest pins that every kind is in exactly one of this set or the run-once ledger
    /// </summary>
    public static class UnlockReplayGameActionTypes
    {
        // 外へは読み取り専用で出す（書き換えでロード後の解放が黙って消えないように）
        // Exposed read-only so no caller can edit it and silently lose unlocks after loading
        public static IReadOnlyCollection<string> Types => ReplayedTypes;

        private static readonly HashSet<string> ReplayedTypes = new()
        {
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockCraftRecipe,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockItemRecipeView,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockChallengeCategory,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockMachineRecipe,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockItemStackLevel,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockBlock,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockTrainCar,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockConnectTool,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockPlayerInventorySlotLevel,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockBlueprint,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockModuleSlotStackLevel,
        };
    }
}
```
