`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Game/GameAction/UnlockReplayGameActionTypesCoverageTest.cs`（前例 `Client.Tests/WebUi/Research/ResearchUnlockGameActionCoverageTest.cs` の「全種別を台帳へ突き合わせる」形。`Tests/UnitTest/Game` 直下は 10 本を超えているので新しいサブディレクトリ）

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Game.Action;
using Mooresmaster.Model.GameActionModule;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.GameAction
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     全 GameActionType を「ロード時に再実行する」「一度きり」のちょうど一方へ分ける網羅テスト
    ///     Exhaustively sorts every GameActionType into exactly one of "replayed on load" or "run once"
    /// </summary>
    public class UnlockReplayGameActionTypesCoverageTest
    {
        // 一度きりで、ロード時・チャレンジ再開時に再実行しない種別（付与とスキット）
        // Kinds that run once and are never replayed on load or challenge resume (grants and skits)
        private static readonly string[] RunOnceGameActionTypes =
        {
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.giveItem,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.playSkit,
            GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.playBackgroundSkit,
        };

        [Test]
        public void EveryGameActionTypeIsReplayedOrRunOnceTest()
        {
            // 種別が増えた日はここが赤くなり、再実行するか一度きりかの判断を強制する（switch にだけ足すとロード後にその解放が黙って消えるため）
            // A new kind turns this red and forces the replay-or-once decision (adding it only to the switch would silently lose that unlock after loading)
            var ledger = UnlockReplayGameActionTypes.Types.Concat(RunOnceGameActionTypes).ToList();
            CollectionAssert.AreEquivalent(DeclaredGameActionTypes(), ledger);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ReplayedAndRunOnceDoNotOverlapTest()
        {
            CollectionAssert.IsEmpty(UnlockReplayGameActionTypes.Types.Intersect(RunOnceGameActionTypes));
        }

        // 自動生成の GameActionTypeConst から宣言済みの種別を全部取り出す
        // Pull every declared kind out of the generated GameActionTypeConst
        private static List<string> DeclaredGameActionTypes()
        {
            return typeof(GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst)
                .GetFields(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)
                .Where(field => field.IsLiteral && field.FieldType == typeof(string))
                .Select(field => (string)field.GetRawConstantValue())
                .ToList();
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Action/GiveItemGameActionExecutor.cs`（`GameActionExecutor.cs` 188-227行の移設。ログの接頭辞は変えない）

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.Context;
using Game.PlayerInventory.Interface;
using Mooresmaster.Model.GameActionModule;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.Action
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     giveItem アクションの付与先を解決し、アイテムを渡す
    ///     Resolves the giveItem targets and grants the items
    /// </summary>
    internal class GiveItemGameActionExecutor
    {
        private readonly IPlayerInventoryDataStore _playerInventoryDataStore;

        public GiveItemGameActionExecutor(IPlayerInventoryDataStore playerInventoryDataStore)
        {
            _playerInventoryDataStore = playerInventoryDataStore;
        }

        public void Execute(GameActionElement action, ActionExecutionContext context)
        {
            // アイテムを付与するプレイヤーIDのリスト取得
            // Get the list of player IDs to whom items will be granted
            var param = (GiveItemGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam;
            var targetPlayerIds = ResolveTargetPlayers(param.DeliveryTarget);
            if (targetPlayerIds.Count == 0) return;

            // アイテム付与処理
            // Item granting process
            foreach (var playerId in targetPlayerIds)
            {
                var inventoryData = _playerInventoryDataStore.GetInventoryData(playerId);
                foreach (var reward in param.RewardItems)
                {
                    var itemStack = ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(reward.ItemGuid, reward.ItemCount);
                    inventoryData.MainOpenableInventory.InsertItem(itemStack);
                }
            }

            #region Internal

            List<int> ResolveTargetPlayers(string deliveryTarget)
            {
                switch (deliveryTarget)
                {
                    case GiveItemGameActionParam.DeliveryTargetConst.allPlayers:
                        return _playerInventoryDataStore.GetAllPlayerId();
                    case GiveItemGameActionParam.DeliveryTargetConst.actionInvoker:
                        if (context.HasActionInvoker)
                        {
                            return new List<int> { context.ActionInvokerPlayerId!.Value };
                        }

                        Debug.LogError("[GameActionExecutor] giveItem actionInvoker deliveryTarget requires ActionInvokerPlayerId.");
                        return new List<int>();
                    default:
                        Debug.LogError($"[GameActionExecutor] Unknown deliveryTarget: {deliveryTarget}");
                        return new List<int>();
                }
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

`GameActionExecutor.cs` 全体（232 行 → 約 185 行）:

```csharp
using System.Linq;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Game.PlayerInventory.Interface;
using Game.UnlockState;
using Mooresmaster.Model.GameActionModule;

namespace Game.Action
{
    public class GameActionExecutor : IGameActionExecutor
    {
        private readonly IGameUnlockStateDataController _gameUnlockStateDataController;
        private readonly GiveItemGameActionExecutor _giveItemGameActionExecutor;
        private readonly IItemStackLevelUnlocker _itemStackLevelUnlocker;
        private readonly IPlayerInventorySlotLevelDataStore _playerInventorySlotLevelDataStore;
        private readonly IModuleSlotStackLimitUnlocker _moduleSlotStackLimitUnlocker;

        public GameActionExecutor(
            IGameUnlockStateDataController gameUnlockStateDataController,
            IPlayerInventoryDataStore playerInventoryDataStore,
            IItemStackLevelUnlocker itemStackLevelUnlocker,
            IPlayerInventorySlotLevelDataStore playerInventorySlotLevelDataStore,
            IModuleSlotStackLimitUnlocker moduleSlotStackLimitUnlocker)
        {
            _gameUnlockStateDataController = gameUnlockStateDataController;
            _giveItemGameActionExecutor = new GiveItemGameActionExecutor(playerInventoryDataStore);
            _itemStackLevelUnlocker = itemStackLevelUnlocker;
            _playerInventorySlotLevelDataStore = playerInventorySlotLevelDataStore;
            _moduleSlotStackLimitUnlocker = moduleSlotStackLimitUnlocker;
        }

        public void ExecuteUnlockActions(GameActionElement[] actions, ActionExecutionContext context = default)
        {
            if (actions == null || actions.Length == 0) return;

            // 解放系だけを再実行する（付与・スキットは一度きり。集合は読み取り専用なので Enumerable.Contains で引く）
            // Re-run unlock kinds only; grants and skits happen once (the set is read-only, so look it up with Enumerable.Contains)
            foreach (var action in actions)
            {
                if (UnlockReplayGameActionTypes.Types.Contains(action.GameActionType)) ExecuteAction(action, context);
            }
        }

        public void ExecuteActions(GameActionElement[] actions, ActionExecutionContext context = default)
        {
            if (actions == null || actions.Length == 0) return;
            
            foreach (var action in actions)
            {
                ExecuteAction(action, context);
            }
        }
        
        private void ExecuteAction(GameActionElement action, ActionExecutionContext context)
        {
            if (action == null) return;
            switch (action.GameActionType)
            {
                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockCraftRecipe:
                    UnlockCraftRecipe();
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockItemRecipeView:
                    UnlockItemRecipeView();
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockChallengeCategory:
                    UnlockChallengeCategory();
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockMachineRecipe:
                    UnlockMachineRecipe();
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockBlock:
                    UnlockBlock();
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockTrainCar:
                    UnlockTrainCar();
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockConnectTool:
                    UnlockConnectTool();
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.giveItem:
                    _giveItemGameActionExecutor.Execute(action, context);
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockItemStackLevel:
                    _itemStackLevelUnlocker.ApplyUnlockItemStackLevelAction(action);
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockPlayerInventorySlotLevel:
                    UnlockPlayerInventorySlotLevel();
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockBlueprint:
                    _gameUnlockStateDataController.UnlockBlueprint();
                    break;

                case GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockModuleSlotStackLevel:
                    _moduleSlotStackLimitUnlocker.ApplyUnlockModuleSlotStackLevelAction(action);
                    break;
            }
            
            #region Internal
            
            void UnlockCraftRecipe()
            {
                var unlockRecipeGuids = ((UnlockCraftRecipeGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam).UnlockRecipeGuids;
                foreach (var guid in unlockRecipeGuids)
                {
                    _gameUnlockStateDataController.UnlockCraftRecipe(guid);
                }
            }
            
            void UnlockItemRecipeView()
            {
                var itemGuids = ((UnlockItemRecipeViewGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam).UnlockItemGuids;
                foreach (var itemGuid in itemGuids)
                {
                    var itemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(itemGuid);
                    _gameUnlockStateDataController.UnlockItem(itemId);
                }
            }
            
            void UnlockChallengeCategory()
            {
                var challenges = ((UnlockChallengeCategoryGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam).UnlockChallengeCategoryGuids;
                foreach (var guid in challenges)
                {
                    _gameUnlockStateDataController.UnlockChallenge(guid);
                }
            }

            void UnlockMachineRecipe()
            {
                var machineRecipeGuids = ((UnlockMachineRecipeGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam).UnlockMachineRecipeGuids;
                foreach (var guid in machineRecipeGuids)
                {
                    _gameUnlockStateDataController.UnlockMachineRecipe(guid);
                }
            }

            void UnlockBlock()
            {
                var blockGuids = ((UnlockBlockGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam).UnlockBlockGuids;
                foreach (var guid in blockGuids)
                {
                    _gameUnlockStateDataController.UnlockBlock(guid);
                }
            }

            void UnlockTrainCar()
            {
                var trainCarGuids = ((UnlockTrainCarGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam).UnlockTrainCarGuids;
                foreach (var guid in trainCarGuids)
                {
                    _gameUnlockStateDataController.UnlockTrainCar(guid);
                }
            }

            void UnlockConnectTool()
            {
                var connectToolGuids = ((UnlockConnectToolGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam).UnlockConnectToolGuids;
                foreach (var guid in connectToolGuids)
                {
                    _gameUnlockStateDataController.UnlockConnectTool(guid);
                }
            }

            void UnlockPlayerInventorySlotLevel()
            {
                var level = ((UnlockPlayerInventorySlotLevelGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam).Level;
                _playerInventorySlotLevelDataStore.UnlockLevel(level);
            }
            
            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
    /// <summary>
```

### Task C7: 継承レシピの製作上限（サーバー）

`InheritUpToUnlocked` のレシピは、継承先ファミリーごとの製作上限（未解放は Lv1）より上のレベルの継承元を受け入れない。上限は研究 `unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel` で上がる。判定は入力スロットの束縛（プレイヤーの移動・自動搬入・レシピ変更時の返却）に1箇所で入れる。状態は C6 と同じく保存せず、研究・チャレンジの再実行で戻す。

上限を超えるレベルの継承元は機械に入れず、上限レベルの品への格下げもしない。プレイヤーの手元に残し、研究で上限が上がってからそのレベルの製品を作る（裁定 [[2026-10-23-製作上限を超えるチップは製品に入れず解放まで取っておく]]。棄却案の格下げは、解放までに上位の素材を使い切って残らないため採らない）。上限が効くのはレベル継承の製品レシピだけで、研究と通常レシピの代用（C11）には効かない。

**Files:**
- Modify: `VanillaSchema/ref/gameAction.yml`（`unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel`）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/_CompileRequester.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.cs`（`GetMaxCraftableLevel`）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/MachineUpgrade/MachineUpgradeGameActionValidator.cs`
- Create: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/MachineUpgrade/ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup.cs`・`ILevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlocker.cs`
- Create: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Upgrade/LevelInheritanceCraftCapTable.cs`・`LevelInheritanceCraftCapDataStore.cs`（表は辞書を持つ可変の実装なので公開契約の Game.Block.Interface には置かず、DataStore の隣に置く）
- Create: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Inventory/Input/MachineInputCraftCapGate.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Inventory/Input/MachineInputSlotBinding.cs`・`VanillaMachineInputInventory.cs`・`Inventory/MachineSlotPlacementCheck.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Factory/BlockTemplate/BlockTemplateUtil.cs:54-62`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Action/GameActionExecutor.cs`・`UnlockReplayGameActionTypes.cs`

- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Core/MachineUpgrade/MachineUpgradeGameActionValidatorTest.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: C2 の `MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil`、C6 の `MachineUpgradeGameActionValidator`・`UnlockReplayGameActionTypes`・`MachineUpgradeServiceRegistration`・`GameActionExecutor`
- Produces:
  - **単位と初期値**: 製作上限は「継承先ファミリーの基準アイテムGUID」ごとのレベル（1始まり）。未解放は `LevelInheritanceCraftCapTable.InitialCraftCap = 1`（前例 `ItemStackLevelDataStore` の「未登録はレベル1」）。上限は `InheritUpToUnlocked` のレシピの継承元スロットだけに効き、`Inherit` と通常レシピには効かない。同じ継承先ファミリーを作るレシピは全部同じ上限を共有する（品質モジュールの上限は、品質モジュールを作る継承レシピ全部に効く）
  - gameAction: `"gameActionType": "unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel", "gameActionParam": {"targetItemGuids": [継承先ファミリーの基準アイテムGUID…], "level": int}`。検証: 各 GUID が levelFamily の基準で、それを継承先に持つ `InheritUpToUnlocked` レシピが1つ以上あり、`1 <= level <= ファミリー長`。生成型 `UnlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevelGameActionParam.TargetItemGuids` / `.Level`。ロード時に再実行される解放系に入る
  - **S2・統合タスク（旧 Part D） へ**: GPU の上限は `{"targetItemGuids": ["01a167ed-2700-7371-9f95-168966ff60bc" の基準アイテムGUID], "level": N}`。family GUID ではなく **基準アイテム（Lv1）の itemGuid** を書く（GPU は `01a167ed-2703-7014-98e4-11bd15f38571`）。GPU衛星は S2 の裁定で GPU LvN→GPU衛星 LvN の通常レシピ5本にするため継承レシピを使わない。モジュール4種も各ファミリーの Lv1 の itemGuid
  - `public interface Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade.ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup { IReadOnlyDictionary<Guid, int> UnlockedCaps { get; } IObservable<(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)> OnCraftCapUnlocked { get; } int GetCraftCap(Guid familyBaseItemGuid); }`（`UnlockedCaps` は初期値 Lv1 を含まない）
  - `public interface Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade.ILevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlocker { void UnlockCraftCap(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level); void ApplyUnlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevelAction(GameActionElement action); }`（冪等。上がる方向だけ。レベルの範囲 1..ファミリー長 は `MachineUpgradeGameActionValidator` が起動時に保証するので丸めない）
  - `public class Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Upgrade.LevelInheritanceCraftCapTable { const int InitialCraftCap = 1; IReadOnlyDictionary<Guid, int> UnlockedCaps { get; } int GetCraftCap(Guid familyBaseItemGuid); bool TryRaise(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level); }`（「未登録は初期値・上がるだけ」の表。辞書を持つ可変の実装なので Game.Block.Interface〈公開契約。実装クラスと可変状態は置かない〉ではなく `LevelInheritanceCraftCapDataStore` の隣に置く。サーバーの DataStore と C8 のクライアントの写しが共有する。Client.Game は Game.Block を参照済み）
  - `public static int MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetMaxCraftableLevel(LevelInheritanceShape shape, ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup craftCapLookup)`（継承元として今入れてよい最高レベル。上限なしは `shape.MaxLevel`、上限つきは製作上限との小さい方。C7 のゲートと C9 の DTO が使う）
  - `MachineSlotPlacementCheck.LevelAboveCraftCap`
  - `VanillaMachineInputInventory(BlockId blockId, int inputSlot, int innerTankCount, float innerTankCapacity, BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEvent blockInventoryUpdate, BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, IGameUnlockStateData gameUnlockStateData, ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup craftCapLookup)`
  - `GameActionExecutor` のコンストラクタ: `(IGameUnlockStateDataController, IPlayerInventoryDataStore, IItemStackLevelUnlocker, IPlayerInventorySlotLevelDataStore, IModuleSlotStackLimitUnlocker, ILevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlocker)`

- [ ] **Step 1: テストを書く**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/Upgrade/LevelInheritanceCraftCapTest.cs`

```csharp
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Game.PlayerIdentity;
using Game.Research;
using Game.SaveLoad.Interface;
using Game.SaveLoad.Json;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using Tests.Util.PlayerIdentity;
using UnityEngine;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade.LevelInheritanceTestHelper;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     上限つき継承レシピが製作上限より上の継承元を受け入れず、研究で上限が上がり、ロードで戻ることを検証する
    ///     Verifies a capped inheritance recipe refuses sources above the craft cap, research raises the cap, and loading restores it
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelInheritanceCraftCapTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void CappedRecipeRefusesSourceAboveCapTest()
        {
            var (_, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, _) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedInheritRecipeGuid));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, serviceProvider.GetService<ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup>().GetCraftCap(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTargetBaseGuid));

            // 上限1では Lv1 だけが置け、Lv2 はプレイヤー操作でも自動搬入でも入らない
            // With cap 1 only Lv1 fits; Lv2 enters neither by player placement nor by automated insertion
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed, inventory.CheckPlacement(0, Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), 1)));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.LevelAboveCraftCap, inventory.CheckPlacement(0, Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 1)));
            var remainder = inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 2));
            Assert.AreEqual(2, remainder.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void UncappedInheritIgnoresCraftCapTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, _) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid));

            // Inherit（上限なし）は研究前でも Lv3 を受け入れる
            // Inherit (uncapped) accepts Lv3 even before any research
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed, inventory.CheckPlacement(0, Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 1)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ResearchRaisesCraftCapTest()
        {
            var (_, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var playerId = PlayerIdentityTestHelper.Register(serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<PlayerIdentityRegistry>(), "steam:1").PlayerId;
            var recipe = Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedInheritRecipeGuid);
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);

            // 研究で上限2になり、Lv2 は入るが Lv3 はまだ入らない
            // The research raises the cap to 2; Lv2 fits but Lv3 still does not
            Assert.IsTrue(serviceProvider.GetService<IResearchDataStore>().CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CraftCapResearchGuid, playerId));
            Assert.AreEqual(2, serviceProvider.GetService<ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup>().GetCraftCap(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTargetBaseGuid));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.LevelAboveCraftCap, inventory.CheckPlacement(0, Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 1)));

            // Lv2 を回すと継承先の Lv2 が出る
            // Running Lv2 yields the target's Lv2
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 2));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(TicksToComplete(recipe), processor);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, CountItem(inventory, InputSlotCount, InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTarget(2)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RecipeChangeRefundsSourceAboveCapTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid));
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));

            // 上限なしで入れた Lv3 は、上限つきレシピへ切り替えると返却される
            // A Lv3 inserted under the uncapped recipe is refunded when switching to the capped one
            var overflow = CreateOverflow(10);
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineRecipeSelectionResult.Success, processor.SetSelectedRecipe(Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedInheritRecipeGuid), overflow));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, CountItem(overflow, 0, 10, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void CraftCapIsRestoredFromResearchOnLoadTest()
        {
            var (_, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var playerId = PlayerIdentityTestHelper.Register(serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<PlayerIdentityRegistry>(), "steam:1").PlayerId;
            serviceProvider.GetService<IResearchDataStore>().CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CraftCapResearchGuid, playerId);
            var saveJson = serviceProvider.GetService<AssembleSaveJsonText>().AssembleSaveJson();

            // 研究の再実行で上限2が戻り、二重適用もしない
            // Replaying the research restores cap 2 without double-applying
            var (_, loadServiceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            (loadServiceProvider.GetService<IWorldSaveDataLoader>() as WorldLoaderFromJson).Load(saveJson);
            var lookup = loadServiceProvider.GetService<ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup>();
            Assert.AreEqual(2, lookup.GetCraftCap(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTargetBaseGuid));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, lookup.UnlockedCaps.Count);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.IO;
using Core.Master;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Core.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     強化系アクション（製作上限・スロット上限）の引数検証を確かめる
    ///     Checks the param validation of machine-upgrade actions (craft cap, slot limit)
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineUpgradeGameActionValidatorTest
    {
        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
        }

        [Test]
        public void TestMasterResearchPassesTest()
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(new ResearchMaster(LoadResearchJson()).Validate(out var logs), logs);
        }

        [Test]
        public void CraftCapOnUncappedTargetFailsTest()
        {
            // 上限なし（Inherit）の継承先に上限を付けても効かないので拒否する
            // A cap on an uncapped (Inherit) target would have no effect, so it is refused
            var json = LoadResearchJson();
            CraftCapParam(json)["targetItemGuids"][0] = ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.TargetBaseGuid.ToString();

            Assert.IsFalse(new ResearchMaster(json).Validate(out var logs));
            StringAssert.Contains("is not the target of any InheritUpToUnlocked recipe", logs);
        }

        [Test]
        public void CraftCapLevelBeyondFamilyFailsTest()
        {
            // ファミリー長3を超えるレベルは拒否する
            // A level beyond the family length of 3 is refused
            var json = LoadResearchJson();
            CraftCapParam(json)["level"] = 4;

            Assert.IsFalse(new ResearchMaster(json).Validate(out var logs));
            StringAssert.Contains("is outside 1..3", logs);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ModuleSlotStackLevelBeyondTableFailsTest()
        {
            // 段階表 [3, 6] の最大レベルは1
            // The max level of the [3, 6] table is 1
            var json = LoadResearchJson();
            FindNode(json, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.ModuleSlotStackResearchGuid.ToString())["clearedActions"][0]["gameActionParam"]["level"] = 2;

            Assert.IsFalse(new ResearchMaster(json).Validate(out var logs));
            StringAssert.Contains("unlockModuleSlotStackLevel level 2 is outside 0..1", logs);
        }

        private static JToken CraftCapParam(JObject json)
        {
            return FindNode(json, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CraftCapResearchGuid.ToString())["clearedActions"][0]["gameActionParam"];
        }

        private static JObject LoadResearchJson()
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory, "mods", "forUnitTest", "master", "research.json");
            return JObject.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));
        }

        private static JObject FindNode(JObject json, string researchGuid)
        {
            foreach (var node in (JArray)json["data"])
            {
                if (node["researchNodeGuid"].Value<string>() == researchGuid) return (JObject)node;
            }
            Assert.Fail($"research node not found: {researchGuid}");
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        // 継承元として今入れてよい最高レベル。上限なしは最大レベル、上限つきは製作上限との小さい方
        // Highest source level allowed now: the max level when uncapped, otherwise the smaller of it and the craft cap
        public static int GetMaxCraftableLevel(LevelInheritanceShape shape, ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup craftCapLookup)
        {
            if (!shape.HasCraftCap) return shape.MaxLevel;
            return Math.Min(shape.MaxLevel, craftCapLookup.GetCraftCap(shape.TargetBaseItemGuid));
        }
```

```csharp

            string ValidateLevelInheritanceCraftLevel(UnlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevelGameActionParam param)
            {
                // 実行側が無ガードで走査するため、配列の欠落は検証で止める
                // The executor iterates without a guard, so a missing array stops here
                if (param.TargetItemGuids == null) return $"[MachineUpgrade] {ownerLabel} unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel has null targetItemGuids\n";

                var errors = "";
                foreach (var targetGuid in param.TargetItemGuids)
                {
                    if (!LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.IsLevelFamilyBase(targetGuid))
                    {
                        errors += $"[MachineUpgrade] {ownerLabel} unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel target {targetGuid} is not a level-family base item\n";
                        continue;
                    }

                    // 上限つきレシピの継承先でなければ上限は誰にも効かない
                    // Unless a capped recipe targets it, the cap would affect nothing
                    if (!HasCappedRecipeFor(targetGuid)) errors += $"[MachineUpgrade] {ownerLabel} unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel target {targetGuid} is not the target of any InheritUpToUnlocked recipe\n";

                    var familyLength = LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.GetFamilyLength(targetGuid);
                    if (param.Level < MinCraftCapLevel || familyLength < param.Level) errors += $"[MachineUpgrade] {ownerLabel} unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel level {param.Level} is outside 1..{familyLength} for {targetGuid}\n";
                }
                return errors;
            }

            bool HasCappedRecipeFor(Guid targetGuid)
            {
                foreach (var recipe in MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.MachineRecipes.Data)
                {
                    if (recipe.LevelInheritance == MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.InheritUpToUnlocked && LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.FindTargetBaseGuid(recipe) == targetGuid) return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Upgrade/LevelInheritanceCraftCapTable.cs`（辞書を持つ可変の実装なので Game.Block.Interface には置かない。前例 `Core.Item/ItemStackLevelDataStore.cs` も表を実装側の private 辞書で持つ）

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承先ファミリーごとの製作上限の表。未登録は初期値、値は上がるだけ（サーバーの DataStore とクライアントの写しが共有する）
    ///     Craft cap table per target family: absent means the initial cap and values only rise (shared by the server DataStore and the client mirror)
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelInheritanceCraftCapTable
    {
        // 研究で解放されていない継承先は Lv1 まで作れる
        // A target family without research can be made up to Lv1
        public const int InitialCraftCap = 1;

        // 継承先ファミリーの基準アイテムGUID → 解放済みの上限（初期値は含まない）
        // Target family base item GUID → unlocked cap (the initial value is excluded)
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<Guid, int> UnlockedCaps => _unlockedCaps;
        private readonly Dictionary<Guid, int> _unlockedCaps = new();

        public int GetCraftCap(Guid familyBaseItemGuid)
        {
            return _unlockedCaps.GetValueOrDefault(familyBaseItemGuid, InitialCraftCap);
        }

        // 上がったときだけ true
        // True only when the cap rose
        public bool TryRaise(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)
        {
            // silent-ok: 同じか下のレベルは研究のロード時再実行・初期データとイベントの重なりで正常に来る / 現在の上限は機械UIの継承表示（C9）に出る
            if (level <= GetCraftCap(familyBaseItemGuid)) return false;
            _unlockedCaps[familyBaseItemGuid] = level;
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Upgrade/LevelInheritanceCraftCapDataStore.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Mooresmaster.Model.GameActionModule;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承先ファミリーごとの製作上限。保存せず、研究・チャレンジのロード時再実行で戻す
    ///     Craft cap per target family; not saved, restored by the load-time replay of research and challenges
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelInheritanceCraftCapDataStore : ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup, ILevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlocker
    {
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<Guid, int> UnlockedCaps => _capTable.UnlockedCaps;
        public IObservable<(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)> OnCraftCapUnlocked => _onCraftCapUnlocked;

        private readonly Subject<(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)> _onCraftCapUnlocked = new();
        private readonly LevelInheritanceCraftCapTable _capTable = new();

        public int GetCraftCap(Guid familyBaseItemGuid)
        {
            return _capTable.GetCraftCap(familyBaseItemGuid);
        }

        public void UnlockCraftCap(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)
        {
            // 冪等で上がる方向だけ。レベルの範囲 1..ファミリー長 は MachineUpgradeGameActionValidator が起動時に保証する
            // Idempotent and only rising; MachineUpgradeGameActionValidator guarantees the 1..family-length range at boot
            if (!_capTable.TryRaise(familyBaseItemGuid, level)) return;
            _onCraftCapUnlocked.OnNext((familyBaseItemGuid, level));
        }

        public void ApplyUnlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevelAction(GameActionElement action)
        {
            if (action.GameActionType != GameActionElement.GameActionTypeConst.unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"[LevelInheritanceCraftCapDataStore] Unexpected action type: {action.GameActionType}");
                return;
            }

            var param = (UnlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevelGameActionParam)action.GameActionParam;
            foreach (var targetGuid in param.TargetItemGuids)
            {
                UnlockCraftCap(targetGuid, param.Level);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Inventory/Input/MachineInputCraftCapGate.cs`

```csharp
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory.Input
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     上限つき継承レシピの継承元スロットに、製作上限を超えるレベルを入れさせない判定
    ///     Keeps a capped inheritance recipe's source slot from taking a level above the craft cap
    /// </summary>
    internal class MachineInputCraftCapGate
    {
        private readonly ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup _craftCapLookup;

        public MachineInputCraftCapGate(ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup craftCapLookup)
        {
            _craftCapLookup = craftCapLookup;
        }

        // 継承元スロット以外・上限なしのレシピは常に通す。束縛（IsInputBoundTo）を通った後に呼ぶ
        // Any slot other than the source, and any uncapped recipe, always passes; called after the binding check (IsInputBoundTo)
        public bool IsWithinCraftCap(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int slotIndex, ItemId itemId)
        {
            if (!MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.TryGetShape(recipe, out var shape)) return true;
            if (!shape.HasCraftCap || slotIndex != shape.SourceInputIndex) return true;

            // 束縛を通った継承元スロットの品は継承元の変種なので、レベルは必ず引ける
            // An item that passed the source slot binding is a source variant, so its level always resolves
            var level = shape.ResolveSourceLevel(itemId);
            return level.HasValue && level.Value <= MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetMaxCraftableLevel(shape, _craftCapLookup);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        public MachineSlotPlacementCheck CheckPlacement(int localSlot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            if (itemStack.Id == ItemMaster.EmptyItemId) return MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed;
            if (_recipe == null) return MachineSlotPlacementCheck.RecipeNotSelected;
            return CheckItemPlacement(localSlot, itemStack.Id);
        }

        // レシピ選択済みのスロットへ素材を置けるか（束縛→製作上限の順）。挿入先の列挙と配置判定が共有する
        // Whether the item may go into the slot of the selected recipe (binding, then craft cap); shared by slot enumeration and placement checks
        private MachineSlotPlacementCheck CheckItemPlacement(int localSlot, ItemId itemId)
        {
            if (!MachineRecipeSlotBindingUtil.IsInputBoundTo(_recipe, localSlot, itemId)) return MachineSlotPlacementCheck.ItemNotBoundToSlot;
            return _craftCapGate.IsWithinCraftCap(_recipe, localSlot, itemId)
                ? MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed
                : MachineSlotPlacementCheck.LevelAboveCraftCap;
        }
```

### Task C11: 上位チップは下位の代わりに使える（機械の通常レシピと研究の消費）

要求アイテムが levelFamily の基準（Lv1）のとき、同じファミリーの上位の変種も受け付けて消費する。対象は継承しない機械レシピ（`levelInheritance: None`）の入力の照合と消費、研究の `consumeItems`。照合規則は `Core.Item.LevelFamilySubstituteUtil` の1か所に置き、機械の入力束縛・研究の充足と消費・クライアントの表示（C9 の Shift 宛先・C12 の研究の充足）が同じ規則を使う。機械レシピの入力 i への当てはめは `MachineRecipeSlotBindingUtil`（`GetAcceptedInputItemIds`・`ResolveInputAcceptedLevel`）の1か所で行う。

規則:
- 要求が levelFamily の基準なら、そのファミリーの全変種（Lv1..LvN）を受け付ける。基準でない要求（変種そのもの・ファミリーを持たないアイテム）はそのアイテムだけ
- 消費は下位から。研究は Lv1 を全部使ってから Lv2、Lv2 の次に Lv3…の順に減らし、同じレベルの中はスロット順。機械は入力スロットに入っている品をそのまま減らす（1スロット1アイテムIDなので、スロットの中でレベルは混ざらない）
- 混ざった所持の数え方: 研究の充足は受け付ける全変種の個数の合計で判定する（Lv1×1＋Lv2×1 は「2個」）。機械は1スロット1アイテムIDのまま、手動の挿入で別レベルを重ねようとすると重ならずに戻る。自動搬入（ブロックからの搬入）だけは、スロットの品と入ってくる品が同じ要求に充てられる別レベルなら、両方を低い方のレベルへ揃えて積む（混在ベルトで機械が止まらないため。揃えた分の上位は下位として使われる）
- 継承レシピの継承元スロットには適用しない。継承元スロットは C3・C7 の規則（入っていた変種のレベルを継承し、上限つきは製作上限で拒否し、レベルを混ぜない）のまま。自動搬入でも揃えない
- 製作上限（C7）とは無関係。製作上限は継承元スロットだけに効き、代替の受け付けには効かない
- 加工中ジョブをレシピ変更・選択解除で返却するときは、要求アイテム（基準＝Lv1）で返す（どの変種を消費したかは保存しない。セーブ形式は変えない）
- 対象外: 手持ちクラフト（`craftRecipes`）・ブロックの設置・接続ツールの素材・ベースキャンプの納品。これらは要求アイテムそのものだけを数える

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade.LevelInheritanceTestHelper;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     通常レシピの基準要求に上位の変種を充て、他ファミリーは弾き、自動搬入だけ低い方へ揃え、継承元スロットには効かないことを確かめる
    ///     Verifies a plain recipe's base requirement takes higher variants, rejects other families, aligns only automated inflow to the lower level, and leaves the inheritance source slot alone
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelFamilySubstituteMachineTest
    {
        private static readonly Guid Test2ItemGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000002");

        [Test]
        public void HigherLevelFulfilsBaseRequirementTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var recipe = Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteRecipeGuid);
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);

            // Lv1 を要求する素材へ Lv2 を入れて1回分回す
            // Put Lv2 into the input that requires Lv1 and run one craft
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 2)).Count);
            inventory.InsertItem(CreateTest1(1));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(TicksToComplete(recipe), processor);

            // Lv2 が消費され、製品が出る
            // The Lv2 is consumed and the product comes out
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, CountItem(inventory, InputSlotCount, InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount, MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(Test2ItemGuid)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void OtherFamilyIsRejectedTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, _) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteRecipeGuid));

            // 別ファミリーの Lv2 は手動でも自動搬入でも入らない
            // Another family's Lv2 enters neither by hand nor by automated inflow
            Assert.AreEqual(2, inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(2), 2)).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(2), 2), InsertItemContext.Empty).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ManualInsertDoesNotMixLevelsTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, _) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteRecipeGuid));

            // 手動の挿入では Lv1 の上へ Lv2 は重ならず、そのまま戻る
            // A manual insert never stacks Lv2 onto Lv1; it comes straight back
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), 1));
            var remainder = inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), remainder.Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, remainder.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), inventory.GetItem(0).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void AutomatedInflowAlignsToLowerLevelTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var recipe = Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteRecipeGuid);
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);

            // スロットの Lv2 へ自動搬入の Lv1 が来ると、両方 Lv1 に揃って積まれる
            // When automated inflow brings Lv1 onto the slot's Lv2, both align to Lv1 and stack
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), 1), InsertItemContext.Empty).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), inventory.GetItem(0).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);

            // 揃えた後もそのまま加工が始まる（詰まらない）
            // Processing still starts after the alignment (no jam)
            inventory.InsertItem(CreateTest1(1));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(TicksToComplete(recipe), processor);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);

            // 逆向き（スロットが Lv1、来るのが Lv3）も Lv1 に揃う
            // The reverse (slot Lv1, incoming Lv3) also aligns to Lv1
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 1), InsertItemContext.Empty).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), inventory.GetItem(0).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void InheritanceSourceSlotNeverAlignsTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, _) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid));

            // 継承元スロットは自動搬入でもレベルを揃えず、別レベルは戻る（継承レベルを書き換えない）
            // The inheritance source slot never aligns even for automated inflow; another level bounces (the inherited level is never rewritten)
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 1));
            var remainder = inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 1), InsertItemContext.Empty);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), remainder.Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, remainder.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), inventory.GetItem(0).Id);
        }

        [Test]
        public void RecipeChangeRefundsBaseLevelTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteRecipeGuid));
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 2));
            inventory.InsertItem(CreateTest1(1));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(2, processor);
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Processing, processor.CurrentState);

            // 加工中の返却は要求アイテム（基準）で戻る。どの変種を使ったかは保存しない
            // A mid-process refund returns the required item (the base); which variant was used is not saved
            var overflow = CreateOverflow(10);
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineRecipeSelectionResult.Success, processor.ClearSelectedRecipe(overflow));
            Assert.AreEqual(2, CountItem(overflow, 0, 10, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1)));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountItem(overflow, 0, 10, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2)));
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Game/Research/LevelFamilySubstituteResearchTest.cs`

```csharp
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Context;
using Game.PlayerIdentity;
using Game.PlayerInventory.Interface;
using Game.Research;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util.PlayerIdentity;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Game.Research
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     研究の基準要求に上位の変種を数え、消費は下位から行い、他ファミリーは数えないことを確かめる
    ///     Verifies research counts higher variants toward a base requirement, consumes the lowest level first, and ignores other families
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelFamilySubstituteResearchTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void HigherLevelSatisfiesBaseRequirementTest()
        {
            var (researchDataStore, inventory, playerId) = Setup();
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 3));

            Assert.AreEqual(ResearchNodeState.Researchable, researchDataStore.GetResearchNodeStates(playerId)[ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteResearchGuid]);
            Assert.IsTrue(researchDataStore.CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteResearchGuid, playerId));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, Count(inventory, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void LowerLevelIsConsumedFirstTest()
        {
            var (researchDataStore, inventory, playerId) = Setup();

            // Lv3 を先のスロットへ入れても、スロット順でなくレベル順に Lv1 から減る
            // Even with Lv3 in the earlier slots, consumption follows level order from Lv1, not slot order
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 5));
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), 2));
            Assert.IsTrue(researchDataStore.CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteResearchGuid, playerId));

            Assert.AreEqual(0, Count(inventory, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1)));
            Assert.AreEqual(4, Count(inventory, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ShortageCountsEveryLevelTest()
        {
            var (researchDataStore, inventory, playerId) = Setup();

            // Lv1×1＋Lv2×1 は合わせて2個で、3個には足りない
            // Lv1×1 plus Lv2×1 counts as two, which is short of three
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), 1));
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(ResearchNodeState.UnresearchableNotEnoughItem, researchDataStore.GetResearchNodeStates(playerId)[ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteResearchGuid]);
            Assert.IsFalse(researchDataStore.CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteResearchGuid, playerId));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, Count(inventory, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1)));

            // Lv3 を1個足すと3個になり研究できる
            // Adding one Lv3 makes three and the research becomes available
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(ResearchNodeState.Researchable, researchDataStore.GetResearchNodeStates(playerId)[ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteResearchGuid]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void OtherFamilyDoesNotCountTest()
        {
            var (researchDataStore, inventory, playerId) = Setup();
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(2), 3));

            Assert.AreEqual(ResearchNodeState.UnresearchableNotEnoughItem, researchDataStore.GetResearchNodeStates(playerId)[ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteResearchGuid]);
        }

        private static (IResearchDataStore researchDataStore, IOpenableInventory inventory, int playerId) Setup()
        {
            var (_, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var playerId = PlayerIdentityTestHelper.Register(serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<PlayerIdentityRegistry>(), "steam:1").PlayerId;
            var inventory = serviceProvider.GetService<IPlayerInventoryDataStore>().GetInventoryData(playerId).MainOpenableInventory;
            return (serviceProvider.GetService<IResearchDataStore>(), inventory, playerId);
        }

        private static IItemStack Create(ItemId itemId, int count)
        {
            return ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(itemId, count);
        }

        private static int Count(IOpenableInventory inventory, ItemId itemId)
        {
            var total = 0;
            foreach (var stack in inventory.InventoryItems)
            {
                if (stack.Id == itemId) total += stack.Count;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Item/LevelFamilySubstituteUtil.cs`（置き場は Core.Item。Core.Master はマスタの読み込みと検証だけを持ち、照合はアイテムの規則なので Core.Item に置く。Game.Block・Game.Research・Client.WebUiHost から参照でき、Core.Item は Game.Context 経由で Game.Block.Interface に依存するので Game.Block.Interface からは参照しない）

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master;

namespace Core.Item
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     上位レベルの品を下位の要求に充てる照合規則。機械の入力束縛・研究の充足と消費・クライアントの表示が共有する
    ///     The rule that lets a higher-level item serve a lower requirement, shared by machine input binding, research sufficiency and consumption, and the client display
    /// </summary>
    public static class LevelFamilySubstituteUtil
    {
        // 要求に充てられるアイテム（下位から順）。要求がファミリーの基準なら全変種、それ以外は要求そのものだけ
        // Items that can serve the requirement, lowest first; every variant when it is a family base, otherwise just the requirement itself
        public static IReadOnlyList<ItemId> GetAcceptedItemIds(ItemId requiredItemId)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariants(requiredItemId);
        }

        // 充てられるならそのレベル（1始まり）、充てられなければ null
        // The 1-based level when the item can serve the requirement, otherwise null
        public static int? ResolveAcceptedLevel(ItemId requiredItemId, ItemId itemId)
        {
            var accepted = GetAcceptedItemIds(requiredItemId);
            for (var i = 0; i < accepted.Count; i++)
            {
                if (accepted[i] == itemId) return i + 1;
            }
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

`MachineRecipeSlotBindingUtil.cs` 全体を置き換える（`internal` → `public`。C9 の Web UI の DTO が同じ受け付け集合を使うため。入力 i の要求アイテムの解決は `GetRequiredInputItemId` の1か所）:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item;
using Core.Master;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.RecipeSelection
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     選択レシピとスロット番号の対応（入力スロットi＝素材i、出力スロットj＝生産物jのレベルファミリー枠）を引く純関数
    ///     Pure lookups for the recipe-to-slot binding (input slot i = input i, output slot j = output j's level-family frame)
    /// </summary>
    public static class MachineRecipeSlotBindingUtil
    {
        // 入力 inputIndex に充てられるアイテム（下位から順）。要求がファミリーの基準なら全変種（継承元スロットも同じ規則。製作上限は別のゲートが見る）
        // Items that can serve input inputIndex, lowest first; every variant for a family-base requirement (the source slot follows the same rule; the craft cap is a separate gate)
        public static IReadOnlyList<ItemId> GetAcceptedInputItemIds(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int inputIndex)
        {
            return LevelFamilySubstituteUtil.GetAcceptedItemIds(GetRequiredInputItemId(recipe, inputIndex));
        }

        // 入力 inputIndex に itemId を充てたときのレベル（1始まり）。充てられなければ null
        // Level (1-based) when itemId serves input inputIndex; null when it cannot
        public static int? ResolveInputAcceptedLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int inputIndex, ItemId itemId)
        {
            return LevelFamilySubstituteUtil.ResolveAcceptedLevel(GetRequiredInputItemId(recipe, inputIndex), itemId);
        }

        // スロットslotIndexが素材itemIdの束縛先か
        // Whether slot slotIndex is bound to input itemId
        public static bool IsInputBoundTo(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int slotIndex, ItemId itemId)
        {
            if (slotIndex < 0 || recipe.InputItems.Length <= slotIndex) return false;
            return ResolveInputAcceptedLevel(recipe, slotIndex, itemId).HasValue;
        }

        // 入力タンクiが受け入れる液体か
        // Whether input tank i accepts the fluid
        public static bool IsInputFluidBoundTo(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int tankIndex, FluidId fluidId)
        {
            if (tankIndex < 0 || recipe.InputFluids.Length <= tankIndex) return false;
            return MasterHolder.FluidMaster.GetFluidId(recipe.InputFluids[tankIndex].FluidGuid) == fluidId;
        }

        // 出力 outputIndex のスロットへ入れられるアイテム（下位から順。生産物のレベルファミリーの全変種。C9 の DTO も使う）
        // Items the slot of output outputIndex accepts, lowest first: every variant of the product's level family (C9's DTO uses it too)
        public static IReadOnlyList<ItemId> GetAcceptedOutputItemIds(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int outputIndex)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariants(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.OutputItems[outputIndex].ItemGuid));
        }

        // 出力スロットごとの既定許可集合（生産物のレベルファミリーのみ）。レシピ未選択は空
        // Default allowed-item set per output slot (level family only); empty when unselected
        public static IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyCollection<ItemId>> BuildDefaultOutputBinding(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            if (recipe == null) return System.Array.Empty<IReadOnlyCollection<ItemId>>();

            var binding = new List<IReadOnlyCollection<ItemId>>(recipe.OutputItems.Length);
            for (var j = 0; j < recipe.OutputItems.Length; j++)
            {
                binding.Add(new HashSet<ItemId>(GetAcceptedOutputItemIds(recipe, j)));
            }
            return binding;
        }

        // 入力 inputIndex の要求アイテム（レシピに書いたまま）
        // Required item of input inputIndex, as written in the recipe
        private static ItemId GetRequiredInputItemId(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int inputIndex)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.InputItems[inputIndex].ItemGuid);
        }
    }
}
```

C3 の版の `IsInputBoundTo`（継承元スロットを `LevelInheritanceShape` で判定）は、継承元の要求がファミリーの基準なので同じ答えのままこの式に畳まれ、C3 で足した `using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;` は消える。

- [ ] **Step 5: 自動搬入だけ別レベルを低い方へ揃える**

`MachineInputSlotBinding.cs`（C7 の版）の using に `using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;` と `using Game.Context;` を足し、`CheckPlacement` の前に足す:

```csharp
        // 自動搬入で、スロットの品と入ってくる品が同じ要求に充てられる別レベルなら、両方を低い方のレベルへ揃える（1スロット1IDのまま混在ベルトで詰まらせない）
        // For automated inflow, align the slot's stack and the incoming stack to the lower level when both serve the same requirement (one id per slot without jamming on mixed belts)
        public (IItemStack slotStack, IItemStack incoming) AlignSubstituteVariant(int slotIndex, IItemStack slotStack, IItemStack incoming)
        {
            if (slotStack.Id == ItemMaster.EmptyItemId || slotStack.Id == incoming.Id) return (slotStack, incoming);

            // 継承元スロットは入っていたレベルを継承するので揃えない
            // The inheritance source slot inherits the level it holds, so it never aligns
            if (MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.TryGetShape(_recipe, out var shape) && shape.SourceInputIndex == slotIndex) return (slotStack, incoming);

            var slotLevel = MachineRecipeSlotBindingUtil.ResolveInputAcceptedLevel(_recipe, slotIndex, slotStack.Id);
            var incomingLevel = MachineRecipeSlotBindingUtil.ResolveInputAcceptedLevel(_recipe, slotIndex, incoming.Id);
            // silent-ok: 同じ要求に充てられない組は揃えずに返すだけ / 続く AddItem が積めず、呼び出し元が残余で検知する
            if (!slotLevel.HasValue || !incomingLevel.HasValue) return (slotStack, incoming);

            var lowerItemId = slotLevel.Value < incomingLevel.Value ? slotStack.Id : incoming.Id;
            var factory = ServerContext.ItemStackFactory;
            return (factory.Create(lowerItemId, slotStack.Count), factory.Create(lowerItemId, incoming.Count));
        }
```

```csharp
                    // 分割しても元スタックの受入条件を保つ
                    // Preserve the original stack's acceptance conditions when splitting
                    var acceptedCount = Math.Min(room, remaining.Count);
                    var portion = acceptedCount == remaining.Count ? remaining : remaining.SubItem(remaining.Count - acceptedCount);

                    // 自動搬入だけ別レベルの代替品を低い方へ揃えてから積む。手動の挿入は揃えずに弾く
                    // Only automated inflow aligns a different-level substitute to the lower level before stacking; manual inserts bounce instead
                    var slotStack = slots[slot];
                    if (capAtAutoInsertLimit) (slotStack, portion) = slotBinding.AlignSubstituteVariant(slot, slotStack, portion);
                    var result = slotStack.AddItem(portion);
                    var added = portion.Count - result.RemainderItemStack.Count;
                    if (added == 0) continue; // silent-ok: 属性不一致や満杯は正常な拒否 / 呼び出し元が残余で検知する

                    // 残りは元の品のまま返す（揃えたのは積んだ分だけ）
                    // The remainder keeps its original item; only the stacked part was aligned
                    slots[slot] = result.ProcessResultItemStack;
                    remaining = remaining.SubItem(added);
                    if (!touchedSlots.Contains(slot)) touchedSlots.Add(slot);
```

- [ ] **Step 6: 研究の充足と消費を util へ移す**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Research/ResearchConsumeItemsUtil.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ResearchModule;

namespace Game.Research
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     研究の消費素材の充足判定と消費。基準の要求には上位の変種も数え、消費は下位のレベルから行う
    ///     Research consume-item sufficiency and consumption; a base requirement also counts higher variants, and consumption starts at the lowest level
    /// </summary>
    internal static class ResearchConsumeItemsUtil
    {
        public static bool HasRequiredItems(ConsumeItemsElement[] consumeItems, IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> inventoryItems)
        {
            foreach (var consumeItem in consumeItems)
            {
                var requiredItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(consumeItem.ItemGuid);
                if (CountAccepted(requiredItemId, inventoryItems) < consumeItem.ItemCount) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        public static void Consume(ConsumeItemsElement[] consumeItems, IOpenableInventory inventory)
        {
            foreach (var consumeItem in consumeItems)
            {
                // 下位のレベルから順に、同じレベルの中はスロット順に減らす
                // Take from the lowest level upward, and in slot order within one level
                var remaining = consumeItem.ItemCount;
                var requiredItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(consumeItem.ItemGuid);
                foreach (var acceptedItemId in LevelFamilySubstituteUtil.GetAcceptedItemIds(requiredItemId))
                {
                    for (var slot = 0; slot < inventory.GetSlotSize() && 0 < remaining; slot++)
                    {
                        var stack = inventory.GetItem(slot);
                        if (stack.Id != acceptedItemId) continue;

                        var amount = Math.Min(stack.Count, remaining);
                        inventory.SetItem(slot, stack.SubItem(amount));
                        remaining -= amount;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private static int CountAccepted(ItemId requiredItemId, IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> inventoryItems)
        {
            var total = 0;
            foreach (var stack in inventoryItems)
            {
                if (LevelFamilySubstituteUtil.ResolveAcceptedLevel(requiredItemId, stack.Id).HasValue) total += stack.Count;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }
}
```

（`consumeItems` は `research.yml` で必須の配列なので null は来ない。旧コードの null・空配列ガードは移さない）

  - `HandshakeAcceptedMessagePack`: `[Key(7)] int ModuleSlotStackLevel`、`[Key(8)] LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack[] LevelInheritanceCraftCaps`（初期値 Lv1 の分は含まない）。コンストラクタは `(…, remainingPlacementCounts, int moduleSlotStackLevel, LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack[] levelInheritanceCraftCaps, int playerId)`
  - クライアント: `InitialHandshakeResponse.ModuleSlotStackLevel`・`.LevelInheritanceCraftCaps`
  - クライアント: `Client.Game.InGame.MachineUpgrade.ClientModuleSlotStackLimitDatastore : IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup`（`void Apply(int level)`）、`ClientLevelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore : ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup`（`void Apply(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)`）。VContainer に具象とインターフェースの両方で登録する

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Server/PacketTest/Event/MachineUpgradeEventPacketTest.cs`

```csharp
using System.Linq;
using Game.Map.Interface.Json;
using Game.Research;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using MessagePack;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Server.Event.EventReceive.MachineUpgrade;
using Server.Protocol;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Server.PacketTest.Event
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     スロット上限と製作上限の解放がイベントで配信され、初期ハンドシェイクにも同梱されることを検証する
    ///     Verifies slot-limit and craft-cap unlocks are broadcast as events and bundled into the initial handshake
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineUpgradeEventPacketTest
    {
        private const int PlayerId = 1;

        [Test]
        public void ModuleSlotStackLevelIsBroadcastTest()
        {
            var (_, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var sink = EventTestUtil.RegisterCaptureSink(serviceProvider, PlayerId);

            // スロット上限の研究でレベル1が配信される
            // The slot-limit research broadcasts level 1
            serviceProvider.GetService<IResearchDataStore>().CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.ModuleSlotStackResearchGuid, PlayerId);
            var events = sink.TakeAll().Where(e => e.Tag == ModuleSlotStackLevelEventPacket.EventTag).ToList();
            Assert.AreEqual(1, events.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<ModuleSlotStackLevelEventPacket.ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack>(events[0].Payload).Level);
        }

        [Test]
        public void LevelInheritanceCraftCapIsBroadcastTest()
        {
            var (_, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var sink = EventTestUtil.RegisterCaptureSink(serviceProvider, PlayerId);

            // 製作上限の研究で継承先の基準GUIDとレベル2が配信される
            // The craft-cap research broadcasts the target base GUID with level 2
            serviceProvider.GetService<IResearchDataStore>().CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CraftCapResearchGuid, PlayerId);
            var events = sink.TakeAll().Where(e => e.Tag == LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket.EventTag).ToList();
            Assert.AreEqual(1, events.Count);
            var data = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket.LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack>(events[0].Payload);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTargetBaseGuid, data.FamilyBaseItemGuid);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, data.Level);
        }

        [Test]
        public void MachineUpgradeStateIsIncludedInInitialHandshakeTest()
        {
            var (packetResponse, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            serviceProvider.GetService<IWorldSettingsDatastore>().Initialize(serviceProvider.GetService<MapInfoJson>());
            var researchDataStore = serviceProvider.GetService<IResearchDataStore>();
            researchDataStore.CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.ModuleSlotStackResearchGuid, PlayerId);
            researchDataStore.CompleteResearch(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CraftCapResearchGuid, PlayerId);

            var handshakeRequest = MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(new InitialHandshakeProtocol.RequestInitialHandshakeMessagePack("steam:1"));
            var response = packetResponse.GetPacketResponse(handshakeRequest, new PacketResponseContext(null))[0];
            var accepted = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<InitialHandshakeProtocol.ResponseInitialHandshakeMessagePack>(response).Accepted;

            // Key 7 にスロット上限のレベル、Key 8 に解放済みの製作上限だけが乗る
            // Key 7 carries the slot-limit level and Key 8 only the unlocked craft caps
            Assert.AreEqual(1, accepted.ModuleSlotStackLevel);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, accepted.LevelInheritanceCraftCaps.Length);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTargetBaseGuid, accepted.LevelInheritanceCraftCaps[0].FamilyBaseItemGuid);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, accepted.LevelInheritanceCraftCaps[0].Level);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using MessagePack;
using UniRx;

namespace Server.Event.EventReceive.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     モジュールスロットのスタック上限レベルの変化を全プレイヤーへ配信する
    ///     Broadcasts module-slot stack limit level changes to every player
    /// </summary>
    public class ModuleSlotStackLevelEventPacket : IBootInitializable
    {
        public const string EventTag = "va:event:moduleSlotStackLevel";

        private readonly EventProtocolProvider _eventProtocolProvider;
        private readonly IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup _stackLimitLookup;

        public ModuleSlotStackLevelEventPacket(EventProtocolProvider eventProtocolProvider, IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup stackLimitLookup)
        {
            _eventProtocolProvider = eventProtocolProvider;
            _stackLimitLookup = stackLimitLookup;
        }

        public void Load()
        {
            // 上限の変化を購読し、変化後のレベルを配信する
            // Subscribe to limit changes and broadcast the level after the change
            _stackLimitLookup.OnStackLimitChanged.Subscribe(_ =>
            {
                var payload = MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(new ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack(_stackLimitLookup.CurrentLevel));
                _eventProtocolProvider.AddBroadcastEvent(EventTag, payload);
            });
        }

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack
        {
            [Key(0)] public int Level { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack() { }

            public ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack(int level)
            {
                Level = level;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Event/EventReceive/MachineUpgrade/LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using MessagePack;
using UniRx;

namespace Server.Event.EventReceive.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承レシピの製作上限の解放を全プレイヤーへ配信する
    ///     Broadcasts craft-cap unlocks of inheritance recipes to every player
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket : IBootInitializable
    {
        public const string EventTag = "va:event:levelInheritanceCraftCapUnlock";

        private readonly EventProtocolProvider _eventProtocolProvider;
        private readonly ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup _craftCapLookup;

        public LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket(EventProtocolProvider eventProtocolProvider, ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup craftCapLookup)
        {
            _eventProtocolProvider = eventProtocolProvider;
            _craftCapLookup = craftCapLookup;
        }

        public void Load()
        {
            // 上限の解放を購読し、継承先の基準GUIDとレベルを配信する
            // Subscribe to cap unlocks and broadcast the target base GUID with its level
            _craftCapLookup.OnCraftCapUnlocked.Subscribe(data =>
            {
                var payload = MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(new LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack(data.familyBaseItemGuid, data.level));
                _eventProtocolProvider.AddBroadcastEvent(EventTag, payload);
            });
        }

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack
        {
            [Key(0)] public Guid FamilyBaseItemGuid { get; set; }
            [Key(1)] public int Level { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack() { }

            public LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)
            {
                FamilyBaseItemGuid = familyBaseItemGuid;
                Level = level;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Game/InGame/MachineUpgrade/ClientModuleSlotStackLimitDatastore.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using UniRx;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     サーバーのモジュールスロット上限のクライアント側ミラー。初期データと購読で更新する
    ///     Client-side mirror of the server's module-slot stack limit, updated from initial data and subscriptions
    /// </summary>
    public class ClientModuleSlotStackLimitDatastore : IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup
    {
        public int CurrentLevel { get; private set; }
        public int CurrentStackLimit => ModuleSlotStackLimitMasterUtil.GetStackLimit(CurrentLevel);
        public IObservable<int> OnStackLimitChanged => _onStackLimitChanged;

        private readonly Subject<int> _onStackLimitChanged = new();

        public void Apply(int level)
        {
            if (level == CurrentLevel) return;
            CurrentLevel = level;
            _onStackLimitChanged.OnNext(CurrentStackLimit);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Game/InGame/MachineUpgrade/ClientLevelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Upgrade;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using UniRx;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     サーバーの製作上限のクライアント側ミラー。初期データと購読で更新する
    ///     Client-side mirror of the server's craft caps, updated from initial data and subscriptions
    /// </summary>
    public class ClientLevelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore : ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup
    {
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<Guid, int> UnlockedCaps => _capTable.UnlockedCaps;
        public IObservable<(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)> OnCraftCapUnlocked => _onCraftCapUnlocked;

        private readonly Subject<(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)> _onCraftCapUnlocked = new();

        // 「未登録は初期値・上がるだけ」はサーバーと同じ表で持つ
        // "Absent means initial, only rises" lives in the same table as the server
        private readonly LevelInheritanceCraftCapTable _capTable = new();

        public int GetCraftCap(Guid familyBaseItemGuid)
        {
            return _capTable.GetCraftCap(familyBaseItemGuid);
        }

        public void Apply(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)
        {
            if (!_capTable.TryRaise(familyBaseItemGuid, level)) return;
            _onCraftCapUnlocked.OnNext((familyBaseItemGuid, level));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Client.Network.API;
using MessagePack;
using Server.Event.EventReceive.MachineUpgrade;
using VContainer.Unity;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     スロット上限と製作上限のイベントを購読してミラーへ反映する
    ///     Subscribes to the slot-limit and craft-cap events and applies them to the mirrors
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineUpgradeEventHandler : IInitializable
    {
        private readonly IVanillaApiEvent _vanillaApiEvent;
        private readonly ClientModuleSlotStackLimitDatastore _moduleSlotStackLimitDatastore;
        private readonly ClientLevelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore _levelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore;

        public MachineUpgradeEventHandler(IVanillaApiEvent vanillaApiEvent, ClientModuleSlotStackLimitDatastore moduleSlotStackLimitDatastore, ClientLevelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore levelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore)
        {
            _vanillaApiEvent = vanillaApiEvent;
            _moduleSlotStackLimitDatastore = moduleSlotStackLimitDatastore;
            _levelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore = levelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore;
        }

        public void Initialize()
        {
            _vanillaApiEvent.SubscribeEventResponse(ModuleSlotStackLevelEventPacket.EventTag, OnModuleSlotStackLevelChanged);
            _vanillaApiEvent.SubscribeEventResponse(LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket.EventTag, OnCraftCapUnlocked);
        }

        private void OnModuleSlotStackLevelChanged(byte[] payload)
        {
            var data = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<ModuleSlotStackLevelEventPacket.ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack>(payload);
            _moduleSlotStackLimitDatastore.Apply(data.Level);
        }

        private void OnCraftCapUnlocked(byte[] payload)
        {
            var data = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket.LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack>(payload);
            _levelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore.Apply(data.FamilyBaseItemGuid, data.Level);
        }
    }
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: C2 の `MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.TryGetShape`・`LevelInheritanceShape`、C7 の `MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetMaxCraftableLevel`、C11 の `MachineRecipeSlotBindingUtil.GetAcceptedInputItemIds`・テスト用レシピ `SubstituteRecipeGuid`、C8 の `ClientModuleSlotStackLimitDatastore : IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup`・`ClientLevelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore : ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup`（VContainer にインターフェースでも登録済み）
- Produces（webui の契約）:
  - topic `"machine_upgrade.current"`、payload `{ moduleSlotStackLimit: number }`（正の整数。`Topics.machineUpgrade`、型 `MachineUpgradeData`）
  - `MachineRecipe.levelInheritance: { kind: "none" | "inherit" | "inheritUpToUnlocked"; sourceInputIndex: number; sourceItemIds: number[]; targetOutputIndex: number; targetItemIds: number[]; maxCraftableLevel: number }`（必須。`kind` はマスタの `levelInheritance` を DTO ビルダーの網羅 switch 1か所で写した値。継承しないレシピは `-1`・空配列・`0`〈wire 専用の値。サーバー内部は番号の有無を `TryGetShape` で表し -1 を持たない。zod が形を閉じるので DTO の形は変えない〉。`maxCraftableLevel` は今受け付ける継承元の最高レベルで、サーバーのゲートと同じ `GetMaxCraftableLevel`。上限つきは研究済みの製作上限、上限なしは継承元ファミリーの長さ。製作上限の解放で `crafting.machine_recipes` が再配信される）。型 `MachineRecipeLevelInheritance`
  - `MachineDetailData.slotBindings[].acceptedItemIds: number[]`（必須。入力スロットはサーバーの束縛と同じ `MachineRecipeSlotBindingUtil.GetAcceptedInputItemIds` の結果で、要求が levelFamily の基準なら全変種を下位から（継承元も通常レシピの代替も同じ）、それ以外は `[itemId]`。出力スロットはサーバーの既定の出力束縛 `BuildDefaultOutputBinding` と同じ `MachineRecipeSlotBindingUtil.GetAcceptedOutputItemIds` の結果で、生産物のレベルファミリーの全変種を下位から（ファミリーを持たなければ `[itemId]`）。Web の Shift 宛先は入力帯だけを引くので、出力の集合は宛先を増やさない。製作上限では絞らない＝上限超えはサーバーが拒否し、既存の拒否通知が出る）
  - testid: `machine-module-stack-limit`（モジュール欄の上限）、`machine-recipe-{recipeGuid}-level-inheritance`（レシピ選択行のバッジ）、`machine-recipe-level-inheritance-{recipeGuid}`（レシピビューアのバッジ）
  - i18n キー: `ui.recipe.levelInheritance`・`ui.recipe.levelInheritanceCapped`（差し込み `{level}`）・`ui.blockInventory.moduleSlotStackLimit`（差し込み `{limit}`）
