`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Server/PacketTest/MachineInputStall/GetMachineInputStallProtocolTest.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using MessagePack;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Server.Protocol;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade.LevelInheritanceTestHelper;
using static Tests.Module.TestMod.ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds;
using static Tests.Util.BeltWorldTestUtil;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Server.PacketTest.MachineInputStall
{
    public class GetMachineInputStallProtocolTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void StalledMachineReturnsReasonAndWaitingItemTest()
        {
            var packet = CreatePacket();
            var (block, inventory, _) = PlaceMachine(Vector3Int.zero);
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(InheritRecipeGuid));
            inventory.SetItem(0, Create(Source(1), 1));

            // Lv1 入りのスロットへブロック搬入で Lv2 が断られると、理由と待っている品が返る
            // When a block inflow of Lv2 is refused by a slot holding Lv1, the reason and the waiting item come back
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(Source(2), 1), InsertItemContext.Empty);
            var view = ReadView<MachineInputStalledView>(Invoke(packet, block.BlockInstanceId));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineInputStallReasonKind.MixedLevel, view.Stall.Reason);
            Assert.AreEqual(Source(2).AsPrimitive(), view.Stall.WaitingItemId);
        }

        [Test]
        public void IdleMachineReturnsNotStalledTest()
        {
            var packet = CreatePacket();
            var (block, _, _) = PlaceMachine(Vector3Int.zero);

            // 何も届いていない機械は止まっていない
            // A machine nothing has arrived at is not stalled
            ReadView<MachineInputNotStalledView>(Invoke(packet, block.BlockInstanceId));
        }

        [Test]
        public void NonMachineBlockReturnsNotStalledWithWarningTest()
        {
            var packet = CreatePacket();
            var chest = Place(ForUnitTestModBlockId.ChestId, new Vector3Int(3, 0, 0), BlockDirection.North);

            // クライアントは機械にだけ問い合わせる。別種のブロックは食い違いとして警告し、止まっていない扱いで返す
            // The client only asks machines; any other block is a mismatch, warned about and answered as not stalled
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetMachineInputStall\] block .* has no MachineInputLevelStallComponent"));
            ReadView<MachineInputNotStalledView>(Invoke(packet, chest.BlockInstanceId));
        }

        [Test]
        public void UnknownBlockReturnsBlockNotFoundTest()
        {
            var packet = CreatePacket();

            // 存在しないブロックIDは BlockNotFound を返し、ビューを持たない
            // A missing block ID returns BlockNotFound, which has no view
            var response = Invoke(packet, new BlockInstanceId(999999));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineInputStallResponseKind.BlockNotFound, response.Kind);
            Assert.IsFalse(response.TryGetView(out _));
        }

        [Test]
        public void MalformedResponsesAreUnreadableWithWarningTest()
        {
            // 判別子が Stalled なのに中身が欠けた応答は、警告を出して読めない扱いにする
            // A Stalled response missing its details warns and is unreadable
            var missing = GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack.CreateStalled(MachineInputStallReasonKind.MixedLevel, 1);
            missing.Stall = null;
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetMachineInputStall\] Stalled response is unreadable"));
            Assert.IsFalse(missing.TryGetView(out _));

            // 未知の理由（版違いの wire）も wire を通して同じ扱い
            // An unknown reason (a mismatched wire) is treated the same through the wire
            var unknownReason = GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack.CreateStalled(MachineInputStallReasonKind.MixedLevel, 1);
            unknownReason.Stall.Reason = (MachineInputStallReasonKind)99;
            var received = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack>(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(unknownReason));
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetMachineInputStall\] Stalled response is unreadable"));
            Assert.IsFalse(received.TryGetView(out _));
        }

        private static PacketResponseCreator CreatePacket()
        {
            var (packet, _) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            return packet;
        }

        private static GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack Invoke(PacketResponseCreator packet, BlockInstanceId id)
        {
            var request = new GetMachineInputStallProtocol.RequestMachineInputStallMessagePack(id);
            var responseBytes = packet.GetPacketResponse(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(request), Tests.Util.PlayerIdentity.BoundPacketContext.Bind(1));
            return MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack>(responseBytes[0]);
        }

        // 応答を種別ごとのビューで読み、期待した型であることを確かめる
        // Read the response as its per-kind view and check it is the expected one
        private static TView ReadView<TView>(GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack response) where TView : MachineInputStallView
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(response.TryGetView(out var view), $"kind={response.Kind}");
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<TView>(view);
            return (TView)view;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Protocol/PacketResponse/MachineInputStall/MachineInputStallMessagePack.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using MessagePack;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    // 止まった機械の中身（理由と、届いて待っている品）
    // Details of a stalled machine (the reason and the item that arrived and waits)
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class MachineInputStallMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public MachineInputStallReasonKind Reason { get; set; }
        [Key(1)] public int WaitingItemId { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public MachineInputStallMessagePack() { }

        public MachineInputStallMessagePack(MachineInputStallReasonKind reason, int waitingItemId)
        {
            Reason = reason;
            WaitingItemId = waitingItemId;
        }
    }

    // wire の理由。サーバーの MachineInputLevelRefusalReason はプロトコルの switch 1か所でここへ写す
    // The wire reason; the server's MachineInputLevelRefusalReason maps onto it in a single switch in the protocol
    public enum MachineInputStallReasonKind
    {
        MixedLevel,
        AboveCraftCap,
    }

    // 応答の判別子
    // The response discriminator
    public enum MachineInputStallResponseKind
    {
        BlockNotFound,
        NotStalled,
        Stalled,
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Protocol/PacketResponse/MachineInputStall/MachineInputStallView.cs`:

```csharp
namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     止まった理由の応答を種別ごとの型で読む口。BlockNotFound はこの型に入らず、取得側（ポーラー）が扱う
    ///     Per-kind read view of the stall response; BlockNotFound is not part of it and is handled by the fetcher (poller)
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class MachineInputStallView
    {
        // 種別はこのファイルの型に閉じる
        // The kinds are closed to the types in this file
        private protected MachineInputStallView()
        {
        }
    }

    public sealed class MachineInputNotStalledView : MachineInputStallView
    {
        public static readonly MachineInputNotStalledView Instance = new();

        private MachineInputNotStalledView()
        {
        }
    }

    public sealed class MachineInputStalledView : MachineInputStallView
    {
        public MachineInputStallMessagePack Stall { get; }

        public MachineInputStalledView(MachineInputStallMessagePack stall)
        {
            Stall = stall;
        }
    }
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Protocol/PacketResponse/MachineInputStall/GetMachineInputStallProtocol.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory.Input;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using MessagePack;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    // 機械の搬入が継承元のレベルで止まっているか（理由と待っている品）を返すプロトコル
    // Protocol returning whether a machine's inflow is stalled on the inheritance source level (reason and waiting item)
    public class GetMachineInputStallProtocol : IPacketResponse
    {
        public const string ProtocolTag = "va:getMachineInputStall";

        public GetMachineInputStallProtocol(ServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
        }

        public ProtocolMessagePackBase GetResponse(byte[] payload, int requesterPlayerId)
        {
            var request = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<RequestMachineInputStallMessagePack>(payload);

            // 照会の間にブロックが壊れていれば BlockNotFound を返し、クライアントのポーラーが警告を出す
            // If the block was removed before the query, return BlockNotFound so the client's poller logs a warning
            var block = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(request.BlockInstanceId);
            if (block == null) return ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack.CreateBlockNotFound();

            // クライアントは機械にだけ問い合わせる。別種のブロックは食い違いとして警告する
            // The client only asks machines; any other block is a mismatch and gets a warning
            if (!block.TryGetComponent<MachineInputLevelStallComponent>(out var stallComponent))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[GetMachineInputStall] block {request.BlockInstanceId} has no MachineInputLevelStallComponent; returning NotStalled");
                return ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack.CreateNotStalled();
            }
            if (!stallComponent.TryGetStall(out var stall)) return ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack.CreateNotStalled();
            return ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack.CreateStalled(ToWireReason(stall.Reason), stall.WaitingItemId.AsPrimitive());
        }

        // サーバーの理由を wire の理由へ写す（クライアントは Game.Block の型を wire で受けない）
        // Map the server reason onto the wire reason, so the client never receives Game.Block types on the wire
        private static MachineInputStallReasonKind ToWireReason(MachineInputLevelRefusalReason reason)
        {
            return reason switch
            {
                MachineInputLevelRefusalReason.MixedLevel => MachineInputStallReasonKind.MixedLevel,
                MachineInputLevelRefusalReason.AboveCraftCap => MachineInputStallReasonKind.AboveCraftCap,
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(reason), reason, "未対応の停止理由 / Unsupported stall reason"),
            };
        }

        #region MessagePack

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class RequestMachineInputStallMessagePack : ProtocolMessagePackBase
        {
            [Key(2)] public BlockInstanceId BlockInstanceId { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public RequestMachineInputStallMessagePack() { }

            public RequestMachineInputStallMessagePack(BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId)
            {
                Tag = ProtocolTag;
                BlockInstanceId = blockInstanceId;
            }
        }

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack : ProtocolMessagePackBase
        {
            // wire は判別子と、Stalled のときだけ書かれる中身。組み立ては下の factory、読み出しは TryGetView だけ
            // The wire has a discriminator plus details written only when Stalled; build only via the factories below and read only via TryGetView
            [Key(2)] public MachineInputStallResponseKind Kind { get; set; }
            [Key(3)] public MachineInputStallMessagePack Stall { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack() { }

            private ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack(MachineInputStallResponseKind kind)
            {
                Tag = ProtocolTag;
                Kind = kind;
            }

            public static ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack CreateBlockNotFound()
            {
                return new ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack(MachineInputStallResponseKind.BlockNotFound);
            }

            public static ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack CreateNotStalled()
            {
                return new ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack(MachineInputStallResponseKind.NotStalled);
            }

            public static ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack CreateStalled(MachineInputStallReasonKind reason, int waitingItemId)
            {
                return new ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack(MachineInputStallResponseKind.Stalled) { Stall = new MachineInputStallMessagePack(reason, waitingItemId) };
            }

            // BlockNotFound と、中身の欠けた・理由の読めない Stalled は false。判別子の読み分けはここだけで行う
            // False for BlockNotFound and for a Stalled response with missing details or an unknown reason; the only place that branches on the discriminator
            public bool TryGetView(out MachineInputStallView view)
            {
                switch (Kind)
                {
                    case MachineInputStallResponseKind.NotStalled:
                        view = MachineInputNotStalledView.Instance;
                        return true;
                    case MachineInputStallResponseKind.Stalled:
                        if (Stall == null || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(MachineInputStallReasonKind), Stall.Reason)) return WarnUnreadable(out view);
                        view = new MachineInputStalledView(Stall);
                        return true;
                    case MachineInputStallResponseKind.BlockNotFound:
                        view = default;
                        return false;
                    default:
                        throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(Kind), Kind, "未対応の停止理由の応答種別 / Unsupported stall response kind");
                }

                #region Internal

                // 外部から届いた wire の食い違いなので例外にせず、警告を出して読めない応答として扱う（ポーラーは値を捨てて止める）
                // A mismatch in wire data from outside, so warn instead of throwing and treat it as unreadable (the poller drops the value and stops)
                bool WarnUnreadable(out MachineInputStallView unreadableView)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"[GetMachineInputStall] Stalled response is unreadable (missing details or unknown reason {Stall?.Reason}); treating it as unreadable");
                    unreadableView = default;
                    return false;
                }

                #endregion
            }
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using Client.WebUiHost.Common;
using Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics;
using Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics.BlockDetail.MachineInput;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Client.Tests.WebUi.BlockDetail
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     止まった理由の応答→ビュー→DTO の詰め替えと、WireFixtures との一致を固定する
    ///     Pins the stall response to view to DTO conversion and its equality with WireFixtures
    /// </summary>
    public class WireContractMachineInputStallTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void AboveCraftCapMatchesFixtureTest()
        {
            // 上限超えは理由と待っている品のIDだけを載せる
            // Above-cap carries only the reason and the waiting item ID
            var view = ReadView(GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack.CreateStalled(MachineInputStallReasonKind.AboveCraftCap, 12));
            AssertMatchesFixture(CreateMachineDto(MachineInputStallDetailDtoBuilder.Build(view)), "block_inventory_machine_input_stall.json");
        }

        [Test]
        public void MixedLevelMapsToWireNameTest()
        {
            // レベル違いは "mixedLevel" に写す
            // Mixed level maps to "mixedLevel"
            var dto = MachineInputStallDetailDtoBuilder.Build(ReadView(GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack.CreateStalled(MachineInputStallReasonKind.MixedLevel, 7)));
            Assert.AreEqual("mixedLevel", dto.Reason);
            Assert.AreEqual(7, dto.ItemId);
        }

        [Test]
        public void NotStalledBuildsNoSectionTest()
        {
            // 止まっていない機械では欄を出さない
            // No section for a machine that is not stalled
            Assert.IsNull(MachineInputStallDetailDtoBuilder.Build(ReadView(GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack.CreateNotStalled())));
        }

        [Test]
        public void BlockNotFoundHasNoViewTest()
        {
            // 消えたブロックはビューを持たず、ポーラーが消失として扱う
            // A vanished block has no view, and the poller treats it as vanished
            Assert.IsFalse(GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack.CreateBlockNotFound().TryGetView(out _));
        }

        private static MachineInputStallView ReadView(GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack response)
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(response.TryGetView(out var view), $"kind={response.Kind}");
            return view;
        }

        private static BlockInventoryDto CreateMachineDto(MachineInputStallDetailDto machineInputStall)
        {
            return new BlockInventoryDto
            {
                Open = true,
                Source = "block",
                BlockType = "GearMachine",
                Identifier = "(0, 0, 0)",
                BlockGuid = "a334d703-9442-4910-a8f8-b914df50df4e",
                ItemSlots = new List<BlockItemSlotDto>(),
                FluidSlots = new List<BlockFluidSlotDto>(),
                MachineInputStall = machineInputStall,
            };
        }

        private static void AssertMatchesFixture(object dto, string fixtureName)
        {
            var actual = JToken.Parse(WebUiJson.Serialize(dto));
            var path = Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "Scripts/Client.Tests/WebUi/WireFixtures", fixtureName);
            var expected = JToken.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(expected, actual), $"fixture mismatch: {fixtureName}\nexpected: {expected}\nactual: {actual}");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using Client.Game.InGame.BlockInfoPolling;
using Client.Game.InGame.Context;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;

namespace Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics.BlockDetail.MachineInput
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     止まった理由の照会の1回分の問い合わせと、BlockNotFound を除いた種別ごとの型への読み替え
    ///     One round of the stall query and its conversion into the per-kind view, excluding BlockNotFound
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineInputStallPollSource : IBlockInfoPollSource<GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack, MachineInputStallView>
    {
        // 電力網・部屋の照会と同じ1秒。止まった理由は表示中だけ要る
        // The same 1 second as the electric and room queries; the stall is needed only while displayed
        private static readonly TimeSpan PollInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);

        public static BlockInfoPoller<GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack, MachineInputStallView> CreatePoller()
        {
            return new BlockInfoPoller<GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack, MachineInputStallView>(new MachineInputStallPollSource(), "GetMachineInputStall", PollInterval);
        }

        public UniTask<GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack> Request(BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            return ClientContext.VanillaApi.Response.World.GetMachineInputStall(blockInstanceId, ct);
        }

        public bool TryGetSnapshot(GetMachineInputStallProtocol.ResponseMachineInputStallMessagePack response, out MachineInputStallView snapshot)
        {
            return response.TryGetView(out snapshot);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.WebUiHost/Game/Topics/BlockDetail/MachineInput/MachineInputStallDetailDtoBuilder.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;

namespace Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics.BlockDetail.MachineInput
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     止まった理由のビューから、webui に送る欄を組み立てる
    ///     Builds the webui section from the stall view
    /// </summary>
    public static class MachineInputStallDetailDtoBuilder
    {
        public static void Apply(BlockInventoryDto dto, BlockNetworkInfoCache cache)
        {
            // silent-ok: 未取得・消失・読めない応答の間は欄を出さない / 消失・読めない応答はポーラーが警告を1回出して問い合わせを止め（開き直すと再開）、未取得は次の1秒で欄が出る
            if (!cache.TryGetMachineInputStall(out var view)) return;
            dto.MachineInputStall = Build(view);
        }

        // webui へ送る理由の文字列はこの網羅 switch の1か所でだけ作る。止まっていなければ null（欄を出さない）
        // Reason strings for webui are made only in this exhaustive switch; null when not stalled (no section)
        public static MachineInputStallDetailDto Build(MachineInputStallView view)
        {
            return view switch
            {
                MachineInputStalledView stalled => new MachineInputStallDetailDto { Reason = ToWireReason(stalled.Stall.Reason), ItemId = stalled.Stall.WaitingItemId },
                MachineInputNotStalledView _ => null,
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(view), view.GetType().Name, "未対応の停止理由のビュー / Unsupported stall view"),
            };
        }

        private static string ToWireReason(MachineInputStallReasonKind reason)
        {
            return reason switch
            {
                MachineInputStallReasonKind.MixedLevel => "mixedLevel",
                MachineInputStallReasonKind.AboveCraftCap => "aboveCraftCap",
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(reason), reason, "未対応の停止理由 / Unsupported stall reason"),
            };
        }
    }
}
```

Client.Localization の再コンパイル印を CSV の内容に合わせる（A9 Step 4 と同じ計算。リポジトリルートで実行）:

```bash
python3 - <<'EOF'
import hashlib, os, re
root = "Localization"
items = []
for dirpath, _, files in os.walk(root):
    for name in files:
        path = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
        digest = "-".join("%02X" % b for b in hashlib.md5(open(path, "rb").read()).digest())
        items.append((os.path.relpath(path, root).replace("\\", "/"), digest))
source = "".join(rel + "\0" + digest + "\0" for rel, digest in sorted(items))
token = "-".join("%02X" % b for b in hashlib.md5(source.encode()).digest())
requester = "moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Localization/_CompileRequester.cs"
text = open(requester, encoding="utf-8").read()
text = re.sub(r'dummyText = "[^"]*"', 'dummyText = "%s"' % token, text)
open(requester, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)
print(token)
EOF
```

```ts
import type { MachineInputStallData } from "@/bridge";
import { L, type TranslationKey } from "@/shared/i18n";

// 止まった理由ごとの文言キー
// The message key for each stall reason
export function machineInputStallMessageKey(stall: MachineInputStallData): TranslationKey {
  switch (stall.reason) {
    case "mixedLevel":
      return L.ui.blockInventory.machineInputStallMixedLevel;
    case "aboveCraftCap":
      return L.ui.blockInventory.machineInputStallAboveCraftCap;
  }
}
```

```tsx
import type { BlockInventoryOpen } from "@/bridge";
import { useI18n, useItemDisplayName } from "@/shared/i18n";
import LackHighlightText from "../LackHighlightText";
import { machineInputStallMessageKey } from "./machineInputStallLogic";

// 搬入停止欄: レベルの違う品・製作上限を超える品が届いて止まっていることを、待っている品の名前つきで赤字で出す
// Inflow-stall section: in red, says an item of another level or above the craft cap arrived and stalled, naming the waiting item
export default function MachineInputStallSection({ data }: { data: BlockInventoryOpen }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const itemDisplayName = useItemDisplayName();
  if (!data.machineInputStall) return null;
  const stall = data.machineInputStall;
  return (
    <LackHighlightText insufficient={true} size="xs" testId="machine-input-stall">
      {t(machineInputStallMessageKey(stall), { itemName: itemDisplayName(stall.itemId) })}
    </LackHighlightText>
  );
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/EditModeInPlayingTest/BlockInventory/MachineInputLevelStallWebUiTopicTest.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections;
using Client.Game.InGame.Context;
using Client.Tests.EditModeInPlayingTest.Util;
using Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics;
using Core.Master;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Research;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using UnityEditor;
#endif
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;
using static Client.Tests.EditModeInPlayingTest.Util.EditModeInPlayingTestUtil;

namespace Client.Tests.EditModeInPlayingTest.BlockInventory
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ベルトで届いた製作上限超えの素材で止まった理由が、実ゲームの起動経路で Web UI の配信に載り、研究で消えることを確かめる
    ///     Verifies, through the real game boot, that the stall from an above-cap material arriving by belt reaches the Web UI topic and clears after research
    /// </summary>
    // shard割当はクラスと一緒に移動・改名される
    // The shard assignment travels with the class through moves and renames
    [Category("CiShardClientPlay2")]
    public class MachineInputLevelStallWebUiTopicTest
    {
        private const string MachineBlockName = "石の粉砕機";
        private const string BeltBlockName = "直進高速ベルトコンベア";
        private const string ChestBlockName = "量子チェスト";
        private static readonly Guid CrusherInheritRecipeGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000e0de0002");
        private static readonly Guid MachineUpgradeResearchGuid = Guid.Parse("e0de0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001");
        private static readonly Guid SourceLv2ItemGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-e0de-000000000012");

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator 製作上限を超える素材がベルトで届くと止まった理由が配信に載り研究で消える()
        {
            EnterPlayModeUtil();

            // yield return new EnterPlayMode　は必ず[UnityTest]関数の直下で呼び出すこと。そうでないとなぜかわからないがプレイモードに入らない
            // Always call yield return new EnterPlayMode directly under the [UnityTest] function. Otherwise, for unknown reasons, it will not enter PlayMode.
            yield return new EnterPlayMode(expectDomainReload: true);

            // EnterPlayMode時のテストフレームワーク内部エラーでテストが失敗するのを防ぐ
            // Prevent test failure from test framework internal errors during EnterPlayMode.
            LogAssert.ignoreFailingMessages = true;

            yield return Body().ToCoroutine();

            yield return new ExitPlayMode();

            // テスト終了後にデバッグオブジェクト無効化フラグをクリア
            // Clear debug objects disabled flag after test.
#if UNITY_EDITOR
            SessionState.SetBool("DebugObjectsBootstrap_Disabled", false);
#endif

            #region Internal

            async UniTask Body()
            {
                await LoadMainGame();

                // チェスト→ベルト→粉砕機を北向きに一列に置き、粉砕機を開いて上限つき継承レシピを選ぶ
                // Line chest -> belt -> crusher facing north, open the crusher and select the capped inheritance recipe
                var machinePos = new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0);
                var chest = PlaceBlock(ChestBlockName, new Vector3Int(0, 0, -2), BlockDirection.North);
                PlaceBlock(BeltBlockName, new Vector3Int(0, 0, -1), BlockDirection.North);
                var machine = PlaceBlock(MachineBlockName, machinePos, BlockDirection.North);
                var subInventoryState = await BlockSubInventoryOpener.Open(await WaitBlockGameObjectSpawn(machinePos));
                var select = await WebUiActionInvoker.ExecuteAsync("machine_recipe.select", new JObject { ["operation"] = "set", ["recipeGuid"] = CrusherInheritRecipeGuid.ToString() });
                Assert.IsTrue(select.Ok, $"select action failed: {select.Error}");

                // 製作上限 Lv1 の間に Lv2 の素材をチェストへ入れると、ベルトの先頭で止まり、理由が配信に載る
                // Putting a Lv2 material in the chest under the Lv1 craft cap stalls it at the belt head and the reason reaches the topic
                var sourceLv2 = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(SourceLv2ItemGuid);
                InsertItemToBlock(chest, sourceLv2, 1);
                var stall = await WaitUntilStallAppears();
                Assert.AreEqual("aboveCraftCap", stall["reason"].Value<string>());
                Assert.AreEqual(sourceLv2.AsPrimitive(), stall["itemId"].Value<int>());

                // 研究で製作上限を2へ上げると、待っていた Lv2 が入り、理由が配信から消える
                // Raising the craft cap to 2 by research lets the waiting Lv2 in and the reason leaves the topic
                var playerId = ClientContext.PlayerConnectionSetting.PlayerId;
                Assert.IsTrue(ServerContext.GetService<IResearchDataStore>().CompleteResearch(MachineUpgradeResearchGuid, playerId), "research did not complete");
                await WaitUntilStallCleared();
                Assert.AreEqual(sourceLv2, machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>().GetItem(0).Id, "the waiting Lv2 did not enter the source slot");

                BlockSubInventoryOpener.Close(subInventoryState);
            }

            // 開いているブロックの配信を JSON で読む
            // Read the open block's topic snapshot as JSON
            async UniTask<JObject> BlockInventorySnapshot()
            {
                var hub = Client.WebUiHost.Boot.WebUiHost.Hub;
                Assert.IsNotNull(hub, "WebUiHost hub is not running");
                var handler = hub.ResolveTopic(BlockInventoryTopic.TopicName);
                Assert.IsNotNull(handler, $"topic '{BlockInventoryTopic.TopicName}' is not registered by WebUiGameBinder");
                return JObject.Parse(await handler.GetSnapshotJsonAsync());
            }

            // ベルトの搬送と1秒ごとの問い合わせを待ち、止まった理由が配信に載るまで待つ
            // Wait for the belt transport and the 1 s query until the stall reaches the topic
            async UniTask<JObject> WaitUntilStallAppears()
            {
                var stall = (await BlockInventorySnapshot())["machineInputStall"] as JObject;
                for (var i = 0; i < 100 && stall == null; i++)
                {
                    await UniTask.Delay(100);
                    stall = (await BlockInventorySnapshot())["machineInputStall"] as JObject;
                }
                Assert.IsNotNull(stall, "machineInputStall never reached the block inventory topic");
                return stall;
            }

            // 止まった理由が配信から消えるまで待つ
            // Wait until the stall leaves the topic
            async UniTask WaitUntilStallCleared()
            {
                var stall = (await BlockInventorySnapshot())["machineInputStall"];
                for (var i = 0; i < 50 && stall != null; i++)
                {
                    await UniTask.Delay(100);
                    stall = (await BlockInventorySnapshot())["machineInputStall"];
                }
                Assert.IsNull(stall, "machineInputStall did not clear after the craft cap was raised");
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

unityプレイ録画テストはこのタスクに置かない。Part C 完了時点の出荷マスタには継承レシピが無く、止まる場面を作れないため。出荷マスタの画面での確認は、統合タスク（bd moorestech-xyuaf.2）の D9 chip-line の録画で行う（`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-23-tier9-s1-master-content-handoff.md` の RD14〈23行目〉と末尾の「S1 plan の予測レビュー（2026-10-24）からの持ち越し」節。手順と見る箇所は下の「統合タスクの録画項目」）。

**統合タスクの録画項目（D9 chip-line に足す1点）:**
- 文言の品名は、断られた品（後から届いたレベル）の名前になる。どのレベルが断られるかは、空の継承元スロットへ先に入ったレベルで決まる。そのため混ぜる順を固定する。
- まず Lv1 だけのチップのベルトを、モジュールの継承レシピの機械へつなぐ。Lv1 を継承元の要求数より少なく（例: 1個）だけ流し、継承元スロットに Lv1 が入って機械が待機中のままであることを確かめる。要求数以上を入れると、他の材料だけが欠けた状態になり、表示は出ない。
- 続けて同じベルトに Lv2 を流す。機械をF単押しで開き、`PlaytestDomQuery.Query("machine-input-stall", …)` が Found であることを確かめる。文言は断られた Lv2 の名前で「レベルの違う品（ICチップLv2）が届いて止まっています」になり、`data-insufficient="true"` が付く。この画面をスクショ `04-mixed-level-stall` に撮る。
- 続けてフィルター分岐器で Lv2 を別のベルトへ逃がし、Lv1 を要求数まで流す。3秒以内に `machine-input-stall` が Found=false になり、加工が始まってラインが回ることを確かめる。

## Part B: チップ生産の工程

### Task B1: 歩留まりの純計算と抽選

**Files:**

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.CleanRoomYield
{
    public class ChipYieldFormulaTest
    {
        // Part B の初期値。行はクラスA→Dの順（品質倍率・層失敗率・ダイ損失率）
        // Initial values from Part B, rows ordered class A to D (quality multiplier, layer fail rate, die loss rate)
        private static readonly (float qualityMultiplier, float layerFailRate, float dieLossRate)[] ClassRows =
        {
            (1.0f, 0.10f, 0.15f),
            (0.75f, 0.15f, 0.22f),
            (0.5f, 0.20f, 0.30f),
            (0.25f, 0.25f, 0.38f),
        };

        private static readonly float[][] GradeDieTables =
        {
            new[] { 1f },
            new[] { 0.7f, 0.3f },
            new[] { 0.55f, 0.3f, 0.15f },
            new[] { 0.45f, 0.3f, 0.17f, 0.08f },
            new[] { 0.4f, 0.28f, 0.18f, 0.09f, 0.05f },
        };

        private const double MaxPromotionChance = 0.9;
        private const double MaxReduction = 0.8;
        private const int LayerCount = 3;
        private const int DiesPerWafer = 300;
        private const int GradeCount = 5;
        private const int DieLevelCount = 5;

        [TestCase(0, 5, 1)]
        [TestCase(1, 5, 2)]
        [TestCase(4, 5, 5)]
        [TestCase(7, 5, 5)]
        [TestCase(2, 3, 3)]
        public void MaxWaferGradeIsHighestTierPlusOneTest(int highestTier, int gradeCount, int expected)
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(expected, ChipYieldFormula.MaxWaferGrade(highestTier, gradeCount));
        }

        [Test]
        public void PromotionChanceIsClampedProductTest()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(0.9, ChipYieldFormula.PromotionChance(1.0, 1.0, 0.9), 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.2, ChipYieldFormula.PromotionChance(0.4, 0.5, 0.9), 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.0, ChipYieldFormula.PromotionChance(0.0, 1.0, 0.9), 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ReducedRateClampsQualityReductionTest()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(0.07, ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate(0.10, 0.3, 0.8), 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.02, ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate(0.10, 2.0, 0.8), 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.10, ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate(0.10, 0.0, 0.8), 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void WorkedExampleExpectedDiesTest()
        {
            // クラスA・品質合計0.6・最高tier2: u=0.6、層失敗0.04、ダイ損失0.06、生存=0.96^3×300×0.94=249.4956
            // Class A, quality sum 0.6, top tier 2: u=0.6, layer fail 0.04, die loss 0.06, survivors 0.96^3x300x0.94=249.4956
            var expected = ExpectedDies(ClassRows[0], 0.6, 2);
            Assert.AreEqual(191.1136, expected[0], 1e-3);
            Assert.AreEqual(44.9092, expected[1], 1e-3);
            Assert.AreEqual(13.4728, expected[2], 1e-3);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.0, expected[3], 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.0, expected[4], 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void QualityGateNeverYieldsAboveTierPlusOneTest()
        {
            // 最高tier t の構成では Lv t+2 以上の期待値が0、Lv t+1 は正
            // With top tier t, every level from t+2 upward has zero expectation and level t+1 is positive
            for (var highestTier = 0; highestTier <= 3; highestTier++)
            {
                foreach (var classRow in ClassRows)
                {
                    var expected = ExpectedDies(classRow, 1.5, highestTier);
                    Assert.Greater(expected[highestTier], 0.0, $"tier {highestTier}");
                    for (var levelIndex = highestTier + 1; levelIndex < DieLevelCount; levelIndex++)
                    {
                        Assert.AreEqual(0.0, expected[levelIndex], 1e-12, $"tier {highestTier} level {levelIndex + 1}");
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void ClassImprovementNeverReducesGoodTotalOrUpperLevelsTest()
        {
            // クラスを上げても良品合計とLv2以上は減らない。Lv1は減ってよい
            // A better class never lowers the good total or the Lv2+ count; Lv1 may drop
            var moduleConfigs = new (double qualitySum, int highestTier)[] { (0.0, 0), (0.3, 1), (0.6, 2), (0.9, 4), (1.5, 4) };
            foreach (var (qualitySum, highestTier) in moduleConfigs)
            {
                for (var better = 0; better < ClassRows.Length - 1; better++)
                {
                    var betterDies = ExpectedDies(ClassRows[better], qualitySum, highestTier);
                    var worseDies = ExpectedDies(ClassRows[better + 1], qualitySum, highestTier);
                    Assert.GreaterOrEqual(Sum(betterDies, 0) + 1e-9, Sum(worseDies, 0), $"total sum {qualitySum} rows {better}/{better + 1}");
                    Assert.GreaterOrEqual(Sum(betterDies, 1) + 1e-9, Sum(worseDies, 1), $"Lv2+ sum {qualitySum} rows {better}/{better + 1}");
                }
            }
        }

        #region TestHelper

        // 本番の式（上限・昇格確率・割引率）を通し、閉形式で投入1枚あたりのレベル別良品ダイ期待値を出す
        // Run the production formulas (cap, promotion chance, reduced rates) and get the closed-form expected good dies per wafer by level
        private static double[] ExpectedDies((float qualityMultiplier, float layerFailRate, float dieLossRate) classRow, double qualitySum, int highestTier)
        {
            var maxGrade = ChipYieldFormula.MaxWaferGrade(highestTier, GradeCount);
            var chance = ChipYieldFormula.PromotionChance(qualitySum, classRow.qualityMultiplier, MaxPromotionChance);
            var layerFail = ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate(classRow.layerFailRate, qualitySum, MaxReduction);
            var dieLoss = ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate(classRow.dieLossRate, qualitySum, MaxReduction);

            // 全層成功×ダイ生存×グレード確率×グレード別ダイ表
            // All layers pass x die survival x grade probability x per-grade die table
            var expected = new double[DieLevelCount];
            var survivingDies = System.Math.Pow(1d - layerFail, LayerCount) * DiesPerWafer * (1d - dieLoss);
            var gradeProbabilities = WaferGradeProbabilities(chance, maxGrade);
            for (var gradeIndex = 0; gradeIndex < gradeProbabilities.Length; gradeIndex++)
            {
                var table = GradeDieTables[gradeIndex];
                for (var levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < table.Length; levelIndex++) expected[levelIndex] += gradeProbabilities[gradeIndex] * survivingDies * table[levelIndex];
            }
            return expected;
        }

        // グレードgの確率。上限未満は u^(g-1)(1-u)、上限は u^(max-1)（ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade の閉形式）
        // Probability of grade g: u^(g-1)(1-u) below the cap, u^(max-1) at the cap (the closed form of ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade)
        private static double[] WaferGradeProbabilities(double promotionChance, int maxGrade)
        {
            var probabilities = new double[maxGrade];
            var reach = 1d;
            for (var grade = 1; grade <= maxGrade; grade++)
            {
                probabilities[grade - 1] = grade == maxGrade ? reach : reach * (1d - promotionChance);
                reach *= promotionChance;
            }
            return probabilities;
        }

        private static double Sum(IReadOnlyList<double> values, int fromIndex)
        {
            var total = 0.0;
            for (var i = fromIndex; i < values.Count; i++) total += values[i];
            return total;
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.CleanRoomYield
{
    public class ChipYieldDrawTest
    {
        private static readonly float[] GradeThreeTable = { 0.55f, 0.3f, 0.15f };

        [Test]
        public void SameSeedReproducesEveryDrawTest()
        {
            // 同じシードからはグレード・層判定・ダイ振り分けまで同じ結果になる
            // The same seed reproduces the grade, the layer roll and the die split
            var first = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(123456789L);
            var second = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(123456789L);
            Assert.AreEqual(ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(0.6, 5, first), ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(0.6, 5, second));
            Assert.AreEqual(ChipYieldDraw.DrawLayerFailure(0.3, first), ChipYieldDraw.DrawLayerFailure(0.3, second));
            var firstDicing = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(300, 0.2, GradeThreeTable, first);
            var secondDicing = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(300, 0.2, GradeThreeTable, second);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(firstDicing.GoodDieCountsByLevel, secondDicing.GoodDieCountsByLevel);
            Assert.AreEqual(firstDicing.FailedDieCount, secondDicing.FailedDieCount);
        }

        [Test]
        public void WaferGradeStaysWithinCapTest()
        {
            // 昇格確率1でも上限で止まり、0なら常にG1
            // Even a certain promotion stops at the cap, and zero chance always yields G1
            for (var seed = 0L; seed < 200; seed++)
            {
                Assert.AreEqual(3, ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(1.0, 3, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(seed)));
                Assert.AreEqual(1, ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(0.0, 5, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(seed)));
                Assert.AreEqual(1, ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(0.9, 1, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(seed)));
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void WaferGradeFrequencyMatchesClosedFormTest()
        {
            // 20000回の頻度が閉形式 [0.4, 0.24, 0.36] に収まる（標準誤差は約0.0035）
            // 20000 draws land on the closed form [0.4, 0.24, 0.36] (standard error ~0.0035)
            const int drawCount = 20000;
            var counts = new int[3];
            var random = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(42L);
            for (var i = 0; i < drawCount; i++) counts[ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(0.6, 3, random) - 1]++;
            Assert.AreEqual(0.4, counts[0] / (double)drawCount, 0.02);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.24, counts[1] / (double)drawCount, 0.02);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.36, counts[2] / (double)drawCount, 0.02);
        }

        [Test]
        public void LayerFailureFrequencyMatchesRateTest()
        {
            const int drawCount = 20000;
            var failures = 0;
            var random = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(7L);
            for (var i = 0; i < drawCount; i++)
            {
                if (ChipYieldDraw.DrawLayerFailure(0.25, random)) failures++;
            }
            Assert.AreEqual(0.25, failures / (double)drawCount, 0.02);
            Assert.IsFalse(ChipYieldDraw.DrawLayerFailure(0.0, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(1L)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DicingConservesDieCountTest()
        {
            // 良品の各レベルと失敗の合計は常に1枚あたりのダイ数に一致する
            // Good dies across levels plus failed dies always equal the dies per wafer
            for (var seed = 0L; seed < 100; seed++)
            {
                var result = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(300, 0.3, GradeThreeTable, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(seed));
                Assert.AreEqual(3, result.GoodDieCountsByLevel.Count);
                var total = result.FailedDieCount;
                foreach (var count in result.GoodDieCountsByLevel) total += count;
                Assert.AreEqual(300, total);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void DicingMeanMatchesExpectationTest()
        {
            // 損失0.1・表[.55,.3,.15]: 良品の平均270、Lv3の平均40.5（2000枚の標準誤差は約0.12と0.13）
            // Loss 0.1 with table [.55,.3,.15]: good mean 270, Lv3 mean 40.5 (standard errors ~0.12 and ~0.13 over 2000 wafers)
            const int waferCount = 2000;
            var goodTotal = 0L;
            var levelThreeTotal = 0L;
            var random = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(2026L);
            for (var i = 0; i < waferCount; i++)
            {
                var result = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(300, 0.1, GradeThreeTable, random);
                foreach (var count in result.GoodDieCountsByLevel) goodTotal += count;
                levelThreeTotal += result.GoodDieCountsByLevel[2];
            }
            Assert.AreEqual(270.0, goodTotal / (double)waferCount, 1.0);
            Assert.AreEqual(40.5, levelThreeTotal / (double)waferCount, 1.0);
        }

        [Test]
        public void GradeOneTableYieldsOnlyLevelOneTest()
        {
            var result = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(300, 0.15, new[] { 1f }, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(9L));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, result.GoodDieCountsByLevel.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(300, result.GoodDieCountsByLevel[0] + result.FailedDieCount);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     清浄室の抽選に使う決定的な乱数列（SplitMix64）。同じシードからは同じ列が出る
    ///     Deterministic random sequence (SplitMix64) for clean-room draws; the same seed yields the same sequence
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomDrawRandom
    {
        private ulong _state;

        public CleanRoomDrawRandom(long seed)
        {
            _state = unchecked((ulong)seed);
        }

        // [0,1) の一様乱数を1つ進めて返す
        // Advance the sequence and return a uniform double in [0, 1)
        public double NextDouble()
        {
            unchecked
            {
                _state += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15UL;
                var z = _state;
                z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9UL;
                z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBUL;
                z ^= z >> 31;
                return (z >> 11) * (1.0 / (1UL << 53));
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     チップ歩留まりの確率式。抽選と機械UIの表示が CleanRoomRoleRates を通して同じ式を使う
    ///     Probability formulas for chip yield; the draws and the machine UI use them through CleanRoomRoleRates
    /// </summary>
    public static class ChipYieldFormula
    {
        // グレード上限＝装着品質モジュールの最高tier+1。品質モジュール無し（tier0）はG1だけ
        // Grade cap = highest equipped quality tier + 1; no quality module (tier 0) allows only G1
        public static int MaxWaferGrade(int highestQualityModuleTier, int gradeCount)
        {
            return Math.Clamp(highestQualityModuleTier + 1, 1, gradeCount);
        }

        // 1段の昇格確率 u = min(上限, 品質合計×クラス倍率)
        // Per-step promotion chance u = min(cap, quality sum x class multiplier)
        public static double PromotionChance(double qualityEffectSum, double classQualityMultiplier, double maxPromotionChance)
        {
            return Math.Clamp(qualityEffectSum * classQualityMultiplier, 0d, maxPromotionChance);
        }

        // クラス基準率を品質合計で割り引く。割引の上限は maxReduction
        // Discount a class base rate by the quality sum, capped at maxReduction
        public static double ReducedRate(double classBaseRate, double qualityEffectSum, double maxReduction)
        {
            return classBaseRate * (1d - Math.Clamp(qualityEffectSum, 0d, maxReduction));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ダイシング1枚分の抽選結果。良品はレベル順（添字0=Lv1）、損失分は失敗ダイ
    ///     Dicing result for one wafer; good dies by level (index 0 = Lv1), losses become failed dies
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct DicingDrawResult
    {
        public readonly IReadOnlyList<int> GoodDieCountsByLevel;
        public readonly int FailedDieCount;

        public DicingDrawResult(IReadOnlyList<int> goodDieCountsByLevel, int failedDieCount)
        {
            GoodDieCountsByLevel = goodDieCountsByLevel;
            FailedDieCount = failedDieCount;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ChipYieldFormula の確率で実際に引く。乱数は呼び出し側の決定的な列から取る
    ///     Draws with ChipYieldFormula's probabilities, pulling from the caller's deterministic sequence
    /// </summary>
    public static class ChipYieldDraw
    {
        // G1から始め、同じ確率で1段ずつ上げ、外れか上限で止める
        // Start at G1 and climb one step per success at the same chance, stopping on a miss or at the cap
        public static int DrawWaferGrade(double promotionChance, int maxGrade, CleanRoomDrawRandom random)
        {
            var grade = 1;
            while (grade < maxGrade && random.NextDouble() < promotionChance) grade++;
            return grade;
        }

        public static bool DrawLayerFailure(double layerFailRate, CleanRoomDrawRandom random)
        {
            return random.NextDouble() < layerFailRate;
        }

        // ダイごとに損失を判定し（損失数は二項分布）、残りをダイ表でレベルへ振り分ける
        // Roll loss per die (the loss count is binomial), then assign survivors a level from the die table
        public static DicingDrawResult DrawDicing(int diesPerWafer, double dieLossRate, IReadOnlyList<float> levelRates, CleanRoomDrawRandom random)
        {
            var goodCounts = new int[levelRates.Count];
            var failedCount = 0;
            for (var die = 0; die < diesPerWafer; die++)
            {
                if (random.NextDouble() < dieLossRate)
                {
                    failedCount++;
                    continue;
                }
                goodCounts[PickLevelIndex(levelRates, random.NextDouble())]++;
            }
            return new DicingDrawResult(goodCounts, failedCount);
        }

        // 累積比率で添字を選ぶ。丸め誤差で外れた分は最後のレベルへ寄せる
        // Pick an index by cumulative rate; rounding leftovers fall to the last level
        private static int PickLevelIndex(IReadOnlyList<float> levelRates, double roll)
        {
            var cumulative = 0d;
            for (var i = 0; i < levelRates.Count - 1; i++)
            {
                cumulative += levelRates[i];
                if (roll < cumulative) return i;
            }
            return levelRates.Count - 1;
        }
    }
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - C4: `WorldSaveAllInfo.CurrentVersion == 7` と `SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7`（3か所の登録配列の末尾がこれ）。`CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveJsonObject.InheritedLevel`（`int?`、キー `inheritedLevel`。継承しないレシピとジョブ無しは null）、`CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveState.Build` の初期化子の `InheritedLevel = processingState.InheritedLevel,` の行、C3 の `CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveState.Restore(Dictionary<string, object> componentStates, string saveKey, VanillaMachineInputInventory input, VanillaMachineOutputInventory output, VanillaMachineModuleInventory module, out ProcessState state, out MachineProcessingJob processingJob, out uint cycleCount, out MachineRecipeMasterElement selectedRecipe)`（ジョブ無しは `processingJob == null`）と、その中の `RestoreSlots(saveData);` の行。セーブのキー欠けは、C3 の `MachineProcessingJob` の ctor と同じく明示の `InvalidOperationException` でロードを止める（継承レシピのジョブの継承レベル欠け）
  - C1: 機械ブロックの必須キー `allowQualityModule`（bool。`IMachineParam.AllowQualityModule`）。C2: 機械レシピの必須キー `levelInheritance`（`"None"` / `"Inherit"` / `"InheritUpToUnlocked"`）。Step 1 は複製元のブロック・レシピからこの2キーを引き継ぎ、値だけを書き換える
  - 既存: `IFluidInventory.CreateFluidInventoryConnector(FluidInventoryConnects, BlockPositionInfo)`、`new VanillaMachineFluidInventoryComponent(VanillaMachineInputInventory, VanillaMachineOutputInventory, BlockConnectorComponent<IFluidInventory, DefaultContext<IFluidInventory>>)`、`VanillaMachineInputInventory.FluidInputSlot` / `VanillaMachineOutputInventory.FluidOutputSlot`（`IReadOnlyList<FluidContainer>`）、`FluidContainerSaveJsonObject`
- Produces:
  - テストブロック `ForUnitTestModBlockId.CleanRoomProcessMachineId`（GUID `2abd1843-a5cd-4394-8eb2-987dde59baac`。入力1・出力4・モジュール3・入力タンク1（容量100）・品質モジュール可）
  - テストアイテム `ForUnitTestItemId.TestGradedWaferG1` / `G2` / `G3`（levelFamily `efc72519-9444-432b-9236-2ef797e161b5`、基準は G1）
  - テストレシピ `ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDepositionRecipe`（`ddcacf5c-a34d-4cc9-95e9-0d0e9a0f44ba`: TestChipRawWafer×1 ＋ TestFluid1×10 → TestGradedWaferG1×1、`levelInheritance: "None"`）
  - テスト補助 `CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers`: `PlaceProcessMachine()`、`SelectRecipeAndLoad(IBlock, Guid, ItemId, int)`、`TopUpIpa(IBlock, double)`、`RunAndCollect(IBlock filter, IBlock machine, int targetOutputCount, int maxTicks) : Dictionary<ItemId, int>`、`CountOf(Dictionary<ItemId, int>, ItemId)`、`WaitForClassA(CleanRoomDatastore, IBlock filter, IBlock machine, int maxTicks) : bool`、定数 `InputSlot=0` / `FirstOutputSlot=1` / `OutputSlotCount=4` / `FirstModuleSlot=5`、`TestIpaFluidId`
  - `CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveJsonObject.InputFluidSlot` / `OutputFluidSlot`（`List<FluidContainerSaveJsonObject>`、キー `inputFluidSlot` / `outputFluidSlot`）
  - `WorldSaveAllInfo.CurrentVersion == 8`、`SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8`（`FromVersion == 7`）

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Game/SaveLoad/SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8Test.cs`

```csharp
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Game.SaveLoad.Migration.Steps;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.SaveLoad
{
    public class SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8Test
    {
        private const string ProcessorKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent";
        private const string WireKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.ElectricWire.ElectricWireConnectorComponent";
        private const string FailureLog = "版7から版8へ変換できません";

        [Test]
        public void 液体キーの無い清浄室機械へ空配列が足され他のキーは残るTest()
        {
            // 版7の清浄室機械の実際の形（継承しないレシピの継承レベルは null）
            // The actual version-7 clean-room machine shape (a non-inheritance recipe stores a null inherited level)
            var processor = JObject.Parse("{\"cycleCount\":3,\"state\":0,\"inputSlot\":[],\"inheritedLevel\":null}");
            var save = Save(new JObject { ["blockGuid"] = "m", ["state"] = new JObject { [ProcessorKey] = processor, [WireKey] = new JObject { ["wires"] = new JArray() } } });

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsTrue(result.IsConverted, result.FailureReason);
            var migrated = (JObject)result.Save["world"][0]["state"][ProcessorKey];
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(new JArray(), migrated["inputFluidSlot"]));
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(new JArray(), migrated["outputFluidSlot"]));
            Assert.AreEqual(3, migrated["cycleCount"].Value<int>());
            Assert.AreEqual(JTokenType.Null, migrated["inheritedLevel"].Type);
            Assert.IsNotNull(result.Save["world"][0]["state"][WireKey]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 清浄室機械でないブロックと既に液体キーを持つブロックは素通しされるTest()
        {
            var save = Save(
                JObject.Parse("{\"blockGuid\":\"x\",\"state\":{\"ChestComponent\":{\"items\":[]}}}"),
                JObject.Parse("{\"blockGuid\":\"y\"}"),
                JObject.Parse("{\"blockGuid\":\"z\",\"state\":null}"),
                new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [ProcessorKey] = JObject.Parse("{\"inputFluidSlot\":[{\"fluidGuid\":\"g\",\"amount\":5}],\"outputFluidSlot\":[]}") } });
            var original = save.DeepClone();

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsTrue(result.IsConverted, result.FailureReason);
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(original, result.Save));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 再実行しても変化せず版はステップが書き換えないTest()
        {
            var save = Save(new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [ProcessorKey] = new JObject() } });

            var first = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);
            Assert.IsTrue(first.IsConverted, first.FailureReason);
            var once = first.Save.DeepClone();
            var second = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(first.Save);

            Assert.IsTrue(second.IsConverted, second.FailureReason);
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(once, second.Save));
            Assert.AreEqual(7, second.Save["worldVersion"].Value<int>());
        }

        [Test]
        public void FromVersionは7であるTest()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(7, new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().FromVersion);
        }

        // 辿れない形は理由つきで拒否し、原本を変えない
        // Refuse unwalkable shapes with a reason and leave the original untouched
        [TestCase("{\"world\":{}}")]
        [TestCase("{}")]
        [TestCase("{\"world\":[1]}")]
        [TestCase("{\"world\":[{\"state\":[]}]}")]
        [TestCase("{\"world\":[{\"state\":{\"Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent\":[]}}]}")]
        [TestCase("{\"world\":[{\"state\":{\"Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent\":{\"inputFluidSlot\":\"broken\"}}}]}")]
        [TestCase("{\"world\":[{\"state\":{\"Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent\":{\"outputFluidSlot\":1}}}]}")]
        public void 辿れない構造は理由つきで拒否するTest(string json)
        {
            var save = JObject.Parse(json);
            save["worldVersion"] = 7;
            var original = save.DeepClone();
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(FailureLog));

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsFalse(result.IsConverted);
            Assert.IsNotEmpty(result.FailureReason);
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(original, save));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 後ろのブロックが壊れていても前のブロックを書き換えないTest()
        {
            var save = Save(
                new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [ProcessorKey] = new JObject() } },
                new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [ProcessorKey] = new JArray() } });
            var original = save.DeepClone();
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(FailureLog));

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsFalse(result.IsConverted);
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(original, save));
        }

        #region TestHelper

        private static JObject Save(params JObject[] blocks)
        {
            return new JObject { ["worldVersion"] = 7, ["world"] = new JArray(blocks) };
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/CleanRoom/Machine/CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Fluid;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    // 工程用テスト機械（入力1・出力4・モジュール3・入力タンク1）の共通操作
    // Shared operations for the process test machine (1 input, 4 outputs, 3 module slots, 1 input tank)
    internal static class CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers
    {
        internal const int InputSlot = 0;
        internal const int FirstOutputSlot = 1;
        internal const int OutputSlotCount = 4;
        internal const int FirstModuleSlot = 5;
        internal static readonly Vector3Int MachinePosition = new(2, 1, 1);

        internal static FluidId TestIpaFluidId => MasterHolder.FluidMaster.GetFluidId(Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000003"));

        internal static IBlock PlaceProcessMachine()
        {
            return CleanRoomHatchTest.PlaceBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.CleanRoomProcessMachineId, MachinePosition);
        }

        internal static void SelectRecipeAndLoad(IBlock machine, Guid recipeGuid, ItemId inputItemId, int count)
        {
            var recipe = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(recipeGuid);
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(machine, recipe);
            machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>().SetItem(InputSlot, inputItemId, count);
        }

        // 入力タンクへIPAを足す。容量を超えた分は戻り値として捨てる
        // Add IPA to the input tank; anything over capacity comes back as the discarded remainder
        internal static void TopUpIpa(IBlock machine, double amount)
        {
            machine.GetComponent<VanillaMachineFluidInventoryComponent>().AddLiquid(new FluidStack(amount, TestIpaFluidId), default);
        }

        // 部屋を回しながら毎tickIPAを補充し、出力を全部回収する。回収数が目標に届くか上限tickで止める
        // Run the room, top up IPA and drain every output each tick; stop at the target count or the tick cap
        internal static Dictionary<ItemId, int> RunAndCollect(IBlock filter, IBlock machine, int targetOutputCount, int maxTicks)
        {
            var collected = new Dictionary<ItemId, int>();
            var total = 0;
            IOpenableInventory inventory = machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
            for (var tick = 0; tick < maxTicks && total < targetOutputCount; tick++)
            {
                TopUpIpa(machine, 20);
                TickRoom(filter, machine);
                total += DrainOutputs();
            }
            return collected;

            #region Internal

            int DrainOutputs()
            {
                // 別グレードで出力スロットが詰まらないよう、毎tick空にする
                // Empty the output slots every tick so a different grade never blocks them
                var drained = 0;
                for (var slot = FirstOutputSlot; slot < FirstOutputSlot + OutputSlotCount; slot++)
                {
                    var stack = inventory.GetItem(slot);
                    if (stack.Count == 0) continue;
                    collected[stack.Id] = CountOf(collected, stack.Id) + stack.Count;
                    drained += stack.Count;
                    inventory.SetItem(slot, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty());
                }
                return drained;
            }

            #endregion
        }

        internal static int CountOf(Dictionary<ItemId, int> collected, ItemId itemId)
        {
            return collected.TryGetValue(itemId, out var count) ? count : 0;
        }

        // 機械が加工を始める前に部屋をクラスA（閾値行0）まで清浄化する
        // Purify the room to class A (threshold row 0) before the machine starts work
        internal static bool WaitForClassA(CleanRoomDatastore datastore, IBlock filter, IBlock machine, int maxTicks)
        {
            for (var tick = 0; tick < maxTicks; tick++)
            {
                if (datastore.TryGetCleanRoomAt(MachinePosition, out var room) && room.ThresholdIndex == 0) return true;
                TickRoom(filter, machine);
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Linq;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Fluid;
using Game.SaveLoad.Migration.Steps;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    public class CleanRoomMachineFluidTest
    {
        private static readonly string ProcessorSaveKey = typeof(CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent).FullName;

        [Test]
        public void ProcessMachineAcceptsIpaIntoBoundTankTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();

            // タンクを持つ清浄室機械には液体インベントリが組まれ、選択レシピのタンクへ入る
            // A clean-room machine with tanks gets a fluid inventory, and fluid lands in the selected recipe's tank
            Assert.IsTrue(machine.ComponentManager.ExistsComponent<VanillaMachineFluidInventoryComponent>());
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(machine, MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDepositionRecipe));
            var remainder = machine.GetComponent<VanillaMachineFluidInventoryComponent>().AddLiquid(new FluidStack(50, TestIpaFluidId), default);

            Assert.AreEqual(0, remainder.Amount, 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(50, ReadInputFluid(machine).Amount, 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void RecipeWaitsForIpaThenConsumesItTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDepositionRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestChipRawWafer, 1);
            IOpenableInventory inventory = machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();

            // IPAが無い間は部屋が整っても始まらず、ウェハは減らない
            // Without IPA the job never starts even in a ready room, and the wafer stays
            for (var i = 0; i < 800; i++) TickRoom(filter, machine);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, inventory.GetItem(InputSlot).Count);
            Assert.AreNotEqual(ProcessState.Processing, machine.GetComponent<CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent>().CurrentState);

            // 30入れると1回分の10だけ減り、G1が出る
            // Adding 30 consumes exactly one batch of 10 and yields G1
            TopUpIpa(machine, 30);
            for (var i = 0; i < 800 && inventory.GetItem(FirstOutputSlot).Count == 0; i++) TickRoom(filter, machine);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.TestGradedWaferG1, inventory.GetItem(FirstOutputSlot).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(20, ReadInputFluid(machine).Amount, 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void IpaSurvivesSaveLoadTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(machine, MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDepositionRecipe));
            TopUpIpa(machine, 40);

            var reloaded = Reload(machine, SaveLoadJsonTestHelper.ThroughJson(machine.GetSaveState()));

            var fluid = ReadInputFluid(reloaded);
            Assert.AreEqual(40, fluid.Amount, 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(TestIpaFluidId, fluid.FluidId);
        }

        [Test]
        public void VersionSevenStateLoadsAfterMigrationTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDepositionRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestChipRawWafer, 3);

            // 版7の形（液体キー無し）を作り、V7→V8 を通した状態から実ロードする
            // Rebuild the version-7 shape (no fluid keys), run V7->V8 and load the block from the result
            var states = SaveLoadJsonTestHelper.ThroughJson(machine.GetSaveState());
            var processorState = (JObject)states[ProcessorSaveKey];
            processorState.Remove("inputFluidSlot");
            processorState.Remove("outputFluidSlot");
            var save = new JObject { ["worldVersion"] = 7, ["world"] = new JArray(new JObject { ["state"] = JObject.FromObject(states) }) };

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);
            Assert.IsTrue(result.IsConverted, result.FailureReason);
            var migratedStates = ((JObject)result.Save["world"][0]["state"]).Properties().ToDictionary(property => property.Name, property => (object)property.Value);
            var reloaded = Reload(machine, migratedStates);

            IOpenableInventory inventory = reloaded.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
            Assert.AreEqual(3, inventory.GetItem(InputSlot).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, ReadInputFluid(reloaded).Amount, 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void MissingFluidKeyStopsLoadTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();

            // マイグレーションを通っていない液体キー欠けのセーブは、液体を黙って捨てずにロードを止める
            // A save missing a fluid key without the migration stops the load instead of silently dropping fluid
            var states = SaveLoadJsonTestHelper.ThroughJson(machine.GetSaveState());
            ((JObject)states[ProcessorSaveKey]).Remove("inputFluidSlot");

            var exception = Assert.Catch<System.Exception>(() => Reload(machine, states));
            StringAssert.Contains("inputFluidSlot=missing", exception.ToString());
        }

        #region TestHelper

        private static FluidContainerSaveJsonObject ReadInputFluid(IBlock machine)
        {
            var save = (CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveJsonObject)machine.GetComponent<CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent>().GetSaveState();
            return save.InputFluidSlot[0];
        }

        private static IBlock Reload(IBlock machine, System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, object> states)
        {
            var positionInfo = new BlockPositionInfo(new Vector3Int(30, 0, 30), BlockDirection.North, Vector3Int.one);
            var blockGuid = MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(ForUnitTestModBlockId.CleanRoomProcessMachineId).BlockGuid;
            return ServerContext.BlockFactory.Load(blockGuid, machine.BlockInstanceId, states, positionInfo);
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
```

```csharp
            void RestoreFluids(CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveJsonObject data)
            {
                // キーは版8の保存とマイグレーションで必ずある。欠けたセーブは液体を黙って捨てず、継承レベルの欠けと同じく明示の例外でロードを止める
                // Version-8 saves and the migration always write the keys; a save missing them stops the load with an explicit exception, like a missing inherited level, instead of silently dropping fluid
                if (data.InputFluidSlot == null || data.OutputFluidSlot == null)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"清浄室機械のセーブに液体タンクのキーがありません。 inputFluidSlot={(data.InputFluidSlot == null ? "missing" : "present")} outputFluidSlot={(data.OutputFluidSlot == null ? "missing" : "present")}");
                }

                if (input.FluidInputSlot.Count < data.InputFluidSlot.Count || output.FluidOutputSlot.Count < data.OutputFluidSlot.Count)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"清浄室機械のタンク数がセーブより少ないため、超過分の液体は消失します。 input={data.InputFluidSlot.Count}->{input.FluidInputSlot.Count} output={data.OutputFluidSlot.Count}->{output.FluidOutputSlot.Count}");
                }

                for (var i = 0; i < data.InputFluidSlot.Count && i < input.FluidInputSlot.Count; i++)
                {
                    input.FluidInputSlot[i].FluidId = data.InputFluidSlot[i].FluidId;
                    input.FluidInputSlot[i].Amount = data.InputFluidSlot[i].Amount;
                }

                for (var i = 0; i < data.OutputFluidSlot.Count && i < output.FluidOutputSlot.Count; i++)
                {
                    output.FluidOutputSlot[i].FluidId = data.OutputFluidSlot[i].FluidId;
                    output.FluidOutputSlot[i].Amount = data.OutputFluidSlot[i].Amount;
                }
            }
```

- [ ] **Step 9: マイグレーションを書き、版を上げて登録する**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.SaveLoad/Migration/Steps/SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8.cs`

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.SaveLoad.Migration.Steps
{
    // V7→V8移行: 清浄室機械のstateへ空の液体スロット配列を足す。版7以前の清浄室機械はタンクを持たなかった
    // V7->V8 migration: add empty fluid slot arrays to clean-room machine states; machines before version 8 had no tanks
    public sealed class SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8 : ISaveMigrationStep
    {
        // 清浄室機械ProcessorのSaveKey(typeof FullName)。ステップは現行の型を参照しないので文字列で持つ
        // The clean-room processor's SaveKey (typeof FullName); the step never references live types, so it is kept as a string
        private const string ProcessorSaveKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent";
        private const string InputFluidSlotKey = "inputFluidSlot";
        private const string OutputFluidSlotKey = "outputFluidSlot";

        public int FromVersion => 7;

        public SaveMigrationStepResult Migrate(JObject save)
        {
            if (!(save["world"] is JArray world)) return Fail($"セーブのworldが配列ではないため変換できません。 type={save["world"]?.Type}");

            // 先に全件を検査し、途中で拒否しても原本を書き換えない
            // Inspect every block first so a refusal never leaves the original half-rewritten
            var targets = new List<JObject>();
            foreach (var blockToken in world)
            {
                if (!(blockToken is JObject block)) return Fail($"world要素がオブジェクトではありません。 type={blockToken.Type}");
                var stateToken = block["state"];
                if (stateToken == null || stateToken.Type == JTokenType.Null) continue;
                if (!(stateToken is JObject state)) return Fail($"world要素のstateがオブジェクトではありません。 type={stateToken.Type}");

                // 清浄室機械以外はキーが無いので対象外
                // Blocks other than clean-room machines lack the key and are out of scope
                var processorToken = state[ProcessorSaveKey];
                if (processorToken == null) continue;
                if (!(processorToken is JObject processorState)) return Fail($"{ProcessorSaveKey} がオブジェクトではありません。 type={processorToken.Type}");
                if (!IsArrayOrAbsent(processorState[InputFluidSlotKey])) return Fail($"{InputFluidSlotKey} が配列ではありません。 type={processorState[InputFluidSlotKey].Type}");
                if (!IsArrayOrAbsent(processorState[OutputFluidSlotKey])) return Fail($"{OutputFluidSlotKey} が配列ではありません。 type={processorState[OutputFluidSlotKey].Type}");
                targets.Add(processorState);
            }

            // 欠けている液体キーだけ空配列で足す（再実行しても変わらない）
            // Add empty arrays only where a fluid key is missing (idempotent on rerun)
            var migratedCount = 0;
            foreach (var processorState in targets)
            {
                if (processorState[InputFluidSlotKey] != null && processorState[OutputFluidSlotKey] != null) continue;
                if (processorState[InputFluidSlotKey] == null) processorState[InputFluidSlotKey] = new JArray();
                if (processorState[OutputFluidSlotKey] == null) processorState[OutputFluidSlotKey] = new JArray();
                migratedCount++;
            }

            Debug.Log($"セーブを版7から版8へ変換しました。液体スロットを足した清浄室機械={migratedCount}台");
            return SaveMigrationStepResult.Converted(save);

            #region Internal

            bool IsArrayOrAbsent(JToken token)
            {
                return token == null || token is JArray;
            }

            SaveMigrationStepResult Fail(string failureReason)
            {
                // 直接実行した場合も拒否理由を残す
                // Preserve the refusal reason even when the step is called directly
                Debug.LogWarning($"セーブを版7から版8へ変換できません: {failureReason}");
                return SaveMigrationStepResult.Failed(failureReason);
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```
