  - `CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole(Guid machineRecipeGuid, out CleanRoomRecipeRole role) : bool`。「レシピGUID→役割」の解決はここ1か所で、抽選（`CleanRoomYieldDrawDecorator`）と B6 の表示が使う
  - namespace `Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles`:
    - `public abstract class CleanRoomRecipeRole`（ctor は `private protected`。種別は B3〜B5 の3型に閉じる）
    - `public sealed class WaferGradeRecipeRole : CleanRoomRecipeRole { WaferGradeDrawsElement Draw; int GradedOutputIndex; ItemId GradedWaferBaseItemId; int GradeCount; }`（`CleanRoomMaster.Initialize` が1回だけ解決する）
  - namespace `Game.Block.Interface.Component`:
    - `public readonly struct CleanRoomClassYield(float qualityMultiplier, float layerFailRate, float dieLossRate)`（フィールド `QualityMultiplier` / `LayerFailRate` / `DieLossRate`）
    - `public readonly struct CleanRoomEffect`: `static CleanRoomEffect Operable(CleanRoomClassYield classYield)`・`static CleanRoomEffect NotEnclosed()`・`static CleanRoomEffect ClassOut()`・`static CleanRoomEffect BeforeFirstPush()`（部屋の効果が届く前の値＝未密閉。デコレータと A7 の停止理由の状態がここから引く唯一の定義）、`CleanRoomOperability Operability`・`bool CanOperate`・`bool TryGetClassYield(out CleanRoomClassYield classYield)`（稼働できないときは false。false の理由〈未密閉・クラス不足〉は `Operability` を読む）。公開 ctor とクラス値の公開フィールドは無い
  - `internal static class CleanRoomRoleRates`（namespace `Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.OutputRewrite`）: `int MaxWaferGrade(WaferGradeRecipeRole role, MachineModuleEffect moduleEffect)`・`double PromotionChance(WaferGradeRecipeRole role, CleanRoomClassYield classYield, MachineModuleEffect moduleEffect)`。役割ごとの確率を `ChipYieldFormula` へ渡す唯一の口（B4・B5 が同じクラスへ足し、B6 の表示も使う）
  - `MachineOutputFactoryUtil.CreateRealizedOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, MachineModuleEffect effect, int? inheritedLevel, out int setCount)`（C3 の3引数版を置き換える。`setCount` は生産性の当否で決めた出力セット数〈1 か 2〉で、戻り値はレシピ出力1セットをこの数だけ並べたもの。`GameRandom` を引くのは従来どおり1回）
  - `IRealizedOutputDecorator.Decorate(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int? inheritedLevel, MachineModuleEffect moduleEffect, int setCount, List<IItemStack> realizedOutputs)`（`setCount` は工場が決めた値をそのまま受ける。書き換え器は割り算で逆算しない）
  - `public interface ICleanRoomEffectLookup { CleanRoomEffect CurrentEffect { get; } }`（namespace `Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine`。今の部屋の効果の読み口。書き換え〈`SetCleanRoomEffect`〉と抽選〈`Decorate`〉を持たない。消費者は同じ Game.Block の B6 の部品なので Game.Block に置く）
  - `CleanRoomYieldDrawDecorator`（internal、`IRealizedOutputDecorator` と `ICleanRoomEffectLookup` を実装）: `uint CycleCount { get; private set; }`・`CleanRoomEffect CurrentEffect { get; private set; }`（最後に押し込まれた部屋の効果。抽選・processor の停止判定・B6 の表示が読む唯一の持ち主）・`void SetCleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomEffect effect)`、`Decorate` は役割の型で振り分ける switch。B4・B5 は switch へ1行ずつ足す
  - `public ICleanRoomEffectLookup CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent.CleanRoomEffectLookup`（デコレータを読み口の型で出す。B6 のテンプレートが抽選の中身の部品へ渡す。デコレータの具象は processor の private フィールド `_yieldDrawDecorator` に閉じる）
  - `HaltedMachineProcessState(ProcessingMachineProcessState processingState, bool canOperate)`・`void SetCanOperate(bool canOperate)`（述語を受けない）
  - `CleanRoomYieldRollContext`（`ClassYield` / `ModuleEffect` / `IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> FactorySet`〈工場が作った1セット目。継承レシピは継承先が継承レベルの変種〉 / `SetCount`〈工場の値〉 / `Random`。継承レベルは持たない＝グレードを使う役割には `Decorate` が非 null の `int` を別に渡す）、`RecipeOutputSetBuilder.CopySet(IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> factorySet)` / `Repeat`。書き換え器はレシピから出力を組み直さず、工場の1セットの写しを書き換える（継承の変種の当て方は工場の1か所だけ）
  - `CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.Validate` / `RequireSingleOutput` / `RequireFamilyBase(string roleName, Guid machineRecipeGuid, Guid itemGuid, out int? variantCount)`、`CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateClassRows`。成膜の役割の検証（`CleanRoomWaferGradeDrawValidator`）はレシピが `levelInheritance: None` であることも求める（継承レシピだと工場が当てた変種をグレード抽選が上書きし、継承が黙って消える）
  - moorestech_master の cleanRoom.json: クラス値（Part B の初期値）と `waferGradeDraws: []`

**設計メモ:**
- 部屋の効果は「稼働できる（クラス行の3値 `CleanRoomClassYield` を持つ）」か「止まっている（未密閉・クラス不足。クラス値を持たない）」のどちらかで、`CleanRoomEffect` の static factory でしか作れない。クラス値は `TryGetClassYield` でしか読めず、稼働できないときに 0 を読む経路は無い。
- 今の部屋の効果を持つのは `CleanRoomYieldDrawDecorator.CurrentEffect` の1か所。processor は効果の写しを持たず、停止判定もこれを読む。`HaltedMachineProcessState` には述語を注入せず、processor が押し込みのたびに可否の値を `SetCanOperate` で渡す（layer map「汎用基盤コンポーネントへの状態伝達」: 判断は具体側、基盤には値をプッシュする）。停止ステートには可否（bool）の写しが1つあるが、書き手は processor の `SetCleanRoomEffect` 1つで、デコレータへの押し込みと同じ呼び出しの中で渡すので食い違わない。
- 効果を読むだけの相手（B6 の部品）には、デコレータを読み口 `ICleanRoomEffectLookup` の型で渡す。書き換え（`SetCleanRoomEffect`）と抽選カウンタを進める `Decorate` は具象にだけあり、processor の private フィールドに閉じる（layer map「可変DataStoreのアクセス面」の読み取りと変更の分離）。
- 「効果が届く前は未密閉」は `CleanRoomEffect.BeforeFirstPush()` の1か所で決め、デコレータの初期値と A7 の停止理由の状態の初期値はここから引く（どちらも Game.Block にあり Game.Block.Interface を参照できるので、型の側に置く）。
- 出力の1セットとセット数は工場（C3 の `MachineOutputFactoryUtil.CreateRealizedOutputs`）だけが決める。工場はセット数を `out` で返し、`MachineProcessContext` がそれを `Decorate` へ渡す。書き換え器はレシピから出力を組み直さず、工場が作った1セット目の写し（継承レシピは継承先が継承レベルの変種）の必要な所だけを書き換えて、工場のセット数だけ並べる。継承の変種を当てるのは工場の1か所だけで、書き換え器が上書きする所（成膜のグレード・ダイシングのレベル列）は書き換え器が全部書く。
- processor は 199 行から 194 行になる（using 1行減・`_haltedState` の生成1行増・読み口のプロパティ1行増・`Update` の停止判定の if/else を2行に畳んで6行減）。
- 「レシピGUID→役割」は `CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole` の1か所で引く。役割レコードは `Initialize` で、出力の添字・基準アイテムの ID・変種数を1回だけ解決して持つ。変種数は C2 の `LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.GetFamilyLength` で出す。起動時の検証は生のマスタで「ちょうど1つある」「基準アイテムである」を確かめ、実行時（書き換え器・確率の口）はレコードの値を読むだけで導き直さない。
- 抽選は processor が稼働できる間にしか起きない（停止中は `UpdateCurrentState` を呼ばない）。それでも抽選の時点でクラス値が無ければ、デコレータは例外で止める（黙って素通しすると、品質モジュールの効果が消えたことに誰も気づけない）。この例外は今の経路では届かない（判断記録で意図済み）。

```csharp
using Core.Master.Validator;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.CleanRoomYield
{
    public class CleanRoomYieldTableRulesTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void ContractClassRowsAreValidTest()
        {
            var rows = new (string, float, float, float)[] { ("A", 1.0f, 0.10f, 0.15f), ("B", 0.75f, 0.15f, 0.22f), ("C", 0.5f, 0.20f, 0.30f), ("D", 0.25f, 0.25f, 0.38f) };
            Assert.AreEqual("", CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateClassRows(rows));
        }

        [Test]
        public void WorseClassWithHigherMultiplierIsRejectedTest()
        {
            // 下のクラスが品質倍率で上回ると、クラスを上げて歩留まりが下がりうる
            // A worse class with a higher multiplier could let a better class yield less
            var rows = new (string, float, float, float)[] { ("A", 0.5f, 0.10f, 0.15f), ("B", 0.75f, 0.15f, 0.22f) };
            StringAssert.Contains("QualityMultiplier", CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateClassRows(rows));
        }

        [Test]
        public void WorseClassWithLowerFailRateIsRejectedTest()
        {
            var layerRows = new (string, float, float, float)[] { ("A", 1.0f, 0.20f, 0.15f), ("B", 0.75f, 0.15f, 0.22f) };
            StringAssert.Contains("LayerFailRate", CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateClassRows(layerRows));
            var dieRows = new (string, float, float, float)[] { ("A", 1.0f, 0.10f, 0.30f), ("B", 0.75f, 0.15f, 0.22f) };
            StringAssert.Contains("DieLossRate", CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateClassRows(dieRows));
        }

        [TestCase(-0.1f, 0.1f, 0.1f, "QualityMultiplier")]
        [TestCase(1.0f, 1.1f, 0.1f, "LayerFailRate")]
        [TestCase(1.0f, 0.1f, -0.1f, "DieLossRate")]
        public void OutOfRangeValueIsRejectedTest(float qualityMultiplier, float layerFailRate, float dieLossRate, string expectedKey)
        {
            var rows = new (string, float, float, float)[] { ("A", qualityMultiplier, layerFailRate, dieLossRate) };
            StringAssert.Contains(expectedKey, CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateClassRows(rows));
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/CleanRoom/Machine/CleanRoomWaferGradeDrawTest.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    public class CleanRoomWaferGradeDrawTest
    {
        // クラスAで品質tier1・効果1.0なら昇格確率は0.9。20枚でG2が1枚も出ない確率は0.1^20
        // Class A with a tier-1 module of effect 1.0 gives a 0.9 promotion chance; no G2 in 20 wafers has odds 0.1^20
        private const int WaferCount = 20;
        private const int TickCap = 4000;
        private static readonly Guid TestQualityModuleItemGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000005");

        [Test]
        public void NoQualityModuleYieldsOnlyGradeOneTest()
        {
            var datastore = CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            Assert.IsTrue(WaitForClassA(datastore, filter, machine, TickCap));

            // 品質モジュール無しは上限G1なので、クラスAでも全部G1になる
            // Without a quality module the cap is G1, so even class A yields only G1
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDepositionRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestChipRawWafer, WaferCount);
            var collected = RunAndCollect(filter, machine, WaferCount, TickCap);

            Assert.AreEqual(WaferCount, CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestGradedWaferG1));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, collected.Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void TierOneQualityModuleCapsAtGradeTwoTest()
        {
            var datastore = CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>().SetItem(FirstModuleSlot, MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(TestQualityModuleItemGuid), 1);
            Assert.IsTrue(WaitForClassA(datastore, filter, machine, TickCap));

            // tier1の品質モジュールでは上限G2。G3は出ず、G2は出る
            // A tier-1 quality module caps at G2: G3 never appears while G2 does
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDepositionRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestChipRawWafer, WaferCount);
            var collected = RunAndCollect(filter, machine, WaferCount, TickCap);

            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestGradedWaferG3));
            Assert.AreEqual(WaferCount, CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestGradedWaferG1) + CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestGradedWaferG2));
            Assert.Greater(CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestGradedWaferG2), 0);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SaveLoadPreservesCycleCounterTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDepositionRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestChipRawWafer, 2);
            RunAndCollect(filter, machine, 1, TickCap);

            // 成膜は役割レシピなので抽選のたびにカウンタが進む
            // Deposition is a role recipe, so every draw advances the counter
            var processor = machine.GetComponent<CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent>();
            Assert.GreaterOrEqual(((CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveJsonObject)processor.GetSaveState()).CycleCount, 1u);

            // blockInstanceIdとcycleCountが保存され、リロード後の状態が一致する
            // blockInstanceId and cycleCount persist, so the reloaded state matches
            var positionInfo = new BlockPositionInfo(new Vector3Int(30, 0, 30), BlockDirection.North, Vector3Int.one);
            var blockGuid = MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(ForUnitTestModBlockId.CleanRoomProcessMachineId).BlockGuid;
            var reloaded = ServerContext.BlockFactory.Load(blockGuid, machine.BlockInstanceId, SaveLoadJsonTestHelper.ThroughJson(machine.GetSaveState()), positionInfo);
            Assert.AreEqual(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(processor.GetSaveState()), JsonConvert.SerializeObject(reloaded.GetComponent<CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent>().GetSaveState()));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     清浄室工程（成膜・EUV・ダイシング）でレシピが担う役割。出力の添字やアイテムIDは索引のときに1回だけ解決して持つ
    ///     The role a recipe plays in the clean-room chip process (deposition, EUV, dicing); output indices and item ids are resolved once at indexing
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomRecipeRole
    {
        // 種別はこのディレクトリの役割の型に閉じる
        // The kinds are closed to the role types in this directory
        private protected CleanRoomRecipeRole()
        {
        }

        // 役割表が指す出力の添字。ちょうど1つあることは起動時の検証が索引より先に保証する
        // Index of the output a role table points at; boot validation guarantees exactly one before indexing
        private protected static int IndexOfOutput(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, Guid itemGuid)
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < recipe.OutputItems.Length; i++)
            {
                if (recipe.OutputItems[i].ItemGuid == itemGuid) return i;
            }
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"検証済みのはずの出力 {itemGuid} がレシピ {recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} にありません");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Core.Master.Validator.MachineUpgrade;

namespace Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles

    /// <summary>
    ///     成膜: グレード付きウェハの出力を、抽選したグレードの変種へ差し替える役割
    ///     Deposition: the role that swaps the graded-wafer output for the variant of the drawn grade
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class WaferGradeRecipeRole : CleanRoomRecipeRole
    {
        public WaferGradeDrawsElement Draw { get; }

        // グレード付きウェハの出力の添字・基準アイテム・グレード数（変種数）
        // Output index, base item and grade count (variant count) of the graded wafer
        public int GradedOutputIndex { get; }
        public ItemId GradedWaferBaseItemId { get; }
        public int GradeCount { get; }

        internal WaferGradeRecipeRole(WaferGradeDrawsElement draw)
        {

            GradedWaferBaseItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(draw.GradedWaferItemGuid);
            GradeCount = LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.GetFamilyLength(draw.GradedWaferItemGuid);
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;
using Core.Master.Validator;
using Mooresmaster.Loader.CleanRoomModule;
using Mooresmaster.Model.CleanRoomModule;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;

namespace Core.Master
{
    public class CleanRoomMaster : IMasterValidator
    {
        // 閾値行はJSON順（清浄度が良い順）で保持する
        // Threshold rows are kept in JSON order (best air class first)
        public IReadOnlyList<ThresholdsElement> Thresholds { get; }
        public Pollution Pollution { get; }
        public bool IsAvailable { get; }

        // 全閾値超過（クリーンルーム外相当）を表す番兵インデックス
        // Sentinel index meaning all thresholds are exceeded (out of clean-room class)
        public int OutThresholdIndex => Thresholds.Count;

        private readonly CleanRoomMasterElement _element;
        private Dictionary<string, int> _thresholdIndexByClassName;
        private Dictionary<Guid, CleanRoomRecipeRole> _roleByRecipeGuid;

        public CleanRoomMaster(JToken jToken)
        {
            var data = CleanRoomLoader.Load(jToken).Data;
            _element = data.Length == 0 ? null : data[0];
            Thresholds = _element?.Thresholds ?? Array.Empty<ThresholdsElement>();
            Pollution = _element?.Pollution;
            IsAvailable = Thresholds.Count > 0;
        }

        private CleanRoomMaster()
        {
            _element = null;
            Thresholds = Array.Empty<ThresholdsElement>();
            Pollution = null;
            IsAvailable = false;
        }

        // cleanRoom.json を持たないModのための空マスタ
        // Empty master for mods that ship no cleanRoom.json
        public static CleanRoomMaster CreateEmpty()
        {
            return new CleanRoomMaster();
        }

        public bool Validate(out string errorLogs)
        {
            return CleanRoomMasterUtil.Validate(_element, out errorLogs);
        }

        public void Initialize()
        {
            _thresholdIndexByClassName = new Dictionary<string, int>();
            _roleByRecipeGuid = new Dictionary<Guid, CleanRoomRecipeRole>();
            if (_element == null) return;

            // クラス名→行インデックスと、レシピGUID→役割レコードの索引を作る（重複は検証で止まっている）
            // Build className-to-row and recipeGuid-to-role lookups (duplicates were already rejected by validation)
            for (var i = 0; i < _element.Thresholds.Length; i++) _thresholdIndexByClassName.Add(_element.Thresholds[i].ClassName, i);
            foreach (var draw in _element.WaferGradeDraws) _roleByRecipeGuid.Add(draw.MachineRecipeGuid, new WaferGradeRecipeRole(draw));
        }

        // クラス名から閾値行インデックスを解決する（セーブ復元用、行順に依存しない）
        // Resolve a threshold row index by class name (for save restore, row-order independent)
        public bool TryGetThresholdIndexByClassName(string className, out int index)
        {
            return _thresholdIndexByClassName.TryGetValue(className, out index);
        }

        // レシピGUIDから清浄室工程の役割を引く唯一の口。役割の無いレシピは false
        // The single lookup from a recipe GUID to its clean-room process role; false for recipes without a role
        public bool TryGetRecipeRole(Guid machineRecipeGuid, out CleanRoomRecipeRole role)
        {
            return _roleByRecipeGuid.TryGetValue(machineRecipeGuid, out role);
        }
    }
}
```

`Initialize` は `MasterHolder` で機械レシピマスタ（87行）とアイテムマスタ（35行）の初期化の後に呼ばれ（`CleanRoomMaster` は94行）、自分の `Validate` を通った後にだけ走る（`InitializeMaster` が検証失敗で例外を投げる）。役割レコードの解決は検証済みの前提だけを使う。

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/CleanRoom/CleanRoomMasterUtil.cs` の全体を次にする（`Initialize` は `CleanRoomMaster` へ移したので消える）。

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Mooresmaster.Model.CleanRoomModule;

namespace Core.Master.Validator
{
    public static class CleanRoomMasterUtil
    {
        public static bool Validate(CleanRoomMasterElement element, out string errorLogs)
        {
            errorLogs = "";
            if (element == null) return true;

            // 閾値行と、チップ工程の役割表（1レシピ1役割）を検証する
            // Validate the threshold rows and the chip-process role tables (one role per recipe)
            errorLogs += ThresholdsValidation();
            var roleRecipeGuids = new HashSet<Guid>();
            errorLogs += CleanRoomWaferGradeDrawValidator.Validate(element.WaferGradeDraws, roleRecipeGuids);
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorLogs);

            #region Internal

            string ThresholdsValidation()
            {
                var logs = "";
                var classNames = new HashSet<string>();
                var yieldRows = new List<(string, float, float, float)>();
                for (var i = 0; i < element.Thresholds.Length; i++)
                {
                    var threshold = element.Thresholds[i];

                    // 濃度上限は前行より大きい（昇順）こと
                    // Concentration caps must be strictly ascending across rows
                    if (i > 0 && threshold.MaxConcentration <= element.Thresholds[i - 1].MaxConcentration)
                    {
                        logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] Thresholds[{i}] ClassName:{threshold.ClassName} MaxConcentration:{threshold.MaxConcentration} is not ascending.\n";
                    }

                    if (!classNames.Add(threshold.ClassName))
                    {
                        logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] Thresholds[{i}] has duplicated ClassName:{threshold.ClassName}\n";
                    }

                    yieldRows.Add((threshold.ClassName, threshold.QualityMultiplier, threshold.LayerFailRate, threshold.DieLossRate));
                }

                // クラスを上げて歩留まりが下がらないよう、値の範囲と行間の単調性を見る
                // Check value ranges and row-to-row monotonicity so a better class never yields less
                logs += CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateClassRows(yieldRows);
                return logs;
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/CleanRoom/CleanRoomYieldTableRules.cs`

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Core.Master.Validator
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     クラスを上げても良品とLv2以上が減らないことを支える、マスタ値の純粋な規則
    ///     Pure master-value rules that keep a better class from lowering the good total or the Lv2+ count
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomYieldTableRules
    {
        // 行は良いクラスから順。倍率は0以上で非増加、失敗率と損失率は[0,1]で非減少
        // Rows run best class first: multipliers are >= 0 and non-increasing, fail and loss rates are in [0,1] and non-decreasing
        public static string ValidateClassRows(IReadOnlyList<(string className, float qualityMultiplier, float layerFailRate, float dieLossRate)> rows)
        {
            var logs = "";
            for (var i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
            {
                var row = rows[i];
                if (row.qualityMultiplier < 0f) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] Thresholds[{i}] ClassName:{row.className} QualityMultiplier:{row.qualityMultiplier} must be >= 0\n";
                if (row.layerFailRate < 0f || 1f < row.layerFailRate) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] Thresholds[{i}] ClassName:{row.className} LayerFailRate:{row.layerFailRate} is out of [0,1]\n";
                if (row.dieLossRate < 0f || 1f < row.dieLossRate) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] Thresholds[{i}] ClassName:{row.className} DieLossRate:{row.dieLossRate} is out of [0,1]\n";
                if (i == 0) continue;

                var better = rows[i - 1];
                if (better.qualityMultiplier < row.qualityMultiplier) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] Thresholds[{i}] ClassName:{row.className} QualityMultiplier:{row.qualityMultiplier} exceeds the better class {better.className}:{better.qualityMultiplier}\n";
                if (row.layerFailRate < better.layerFailRate) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] Thresholds[{i}] ClassName:{row.className} LayerFailRate:{row.layerFailRate} is below the better class {better.className}:{better.layerFailRate}\n";
                if (row.dieLossRate < better.dieLossRate) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] Thresholds[{i}] ClassName:{row.className} DieLossRate:{row.dieLossRate} is below the better class {better.className}:{better.dieLossRate}\n";
            }
            return logs;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/CleanRoom/CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master.Validator.MachineUpgrade;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Core.Master.Validator
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     チップ工程の役割表（成膜・EUV・ダイシング）に共通する検証。生のマスタだけを読む
    ///     Validation shared by the chip-process role tables (deposition, EUV, dicing); reads the raw master only
    /// </summary>
    internal static class CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks
    {
        // レシピが実在し、清浄室機械のレシピで、他の役割に使われていないこと
        // The recipe must exist, belong to a clean-room machine, and not already carry another role
        public static string Validate(string roleName, Guid machineRecipeGuid, HashSet<Guid> roleRecipeGuids, out MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            recipe = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(machineRecipeGuid);
            if (recipe == null) return $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleName} has invalid MachineRecipeGuid:{machineRecipeGuid}\n";

            var logs = "";
            if (!(MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(recipe.BlockGuid).BlockParam is CleanRoomMachineBlockParam))
            {
                logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{machineRecipeGuid} is not a CleanRoomMachine recipe (BlockGuid:{recipe.BlockGuid})\n";
            }
            if (!roleRecipeGuids.Add(machineRecipeGuid))
            {
                logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{machineRecipeGuid} already has another clean-room role\n";
            }
            return logs;
        }

        // 出力に指定アイテムがちょうど1回あること（添字は役割レコードが索引のときに引く）
        // The item must appear exactly once among the outputs (the role record looks up the index at indexing)
        public static string RequireSingleOutput(string roleName, MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, Guid itemGuid)
        {
            var hitCount = 0;
            foreach (var output in recipe.OutputItems)
            {
                if (output.ItemGuid == itemGuid) hitCount++;
            }
            return hitCount == 1 ? "" : $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} must list ItemGuid:{itemGuid} exactly once in outputItems (found {hitCount})\n";
        }

        // レベルファミリーの基準アイテムであること。変種数（グレード数・レベル数）を返し、満たさなければ null
        // The item must be a level family's base; returns the variant count (grade or level count), or null when it is not
        public static string RequireFamilyBase(string roleName, Guid machineRecipeGuid, Guid itemGuid, out int? variantCount)
        {
            variantCount = null;
            if (MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemIdOrNull(itemGuid) == null) return $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{machineRecipeGuid} has invalid ItemGuid:{itemGuid}\n";
            if (!LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.IsLevelFamilyBase(itemGuid)) return $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{machineRecipeGuid} ItemGuid:{itemGuid} is not the base item of a level family\n";

            // ファミリーの長さの式は C2 の LevelInheritanceRecipeShape の1か所
            // The family-length formula lives only in C2's LevelInheritanceRecipeShape
            variantCount = LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.GetFamilyLength(itemGuid);
            return "";
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/CleanRoom/CleanRoomWaferGradeDrawValidator.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Mooresmaster.Model.CleanRoomModule;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Core.Master.Validator
{
    // 成膜（ウェハグレード抽選）の役割表を検証する
    // Validates the deposition (wafer grade draw) role table
    internal static class CleanRoomWaferGradeDrawValidator
    {
        private const string RoleName = "WaferGradeDraws";

        public static string Validate(WaferGradeDrawsElement[] draws, HashSet<Guid> roleRecipeGuids)
        {
            var logs = "";
            foreach (var draw in draws)
            {
                logs += CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.Validate(RoleName, draw.MachineRecipeGuid, roleRecipeGuids, out var recipe);
                if (recipe == null) continue;

                // 成膜は継承しないレシピに限る。継承レシピだと工場が当てた変種をグレード抽選が上書きし、継承が黙って消える
                // Deposition must be a non-inheritance recipe; otherwise the grade draw overwrites the variant the factory applied and the inheritance silently vanishes
                if (recipe.LevelInheritance != MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.None)
                {
                    logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {RoleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{draw.MachineRecipeGuid} must use levelInheritance None (found {recipe.LevelInheritance})\n";
                }

                // グレード付きウェハは出力に1回だけあり、グレードをレベルファミリーで持つ
                // The graded wafer appears once among the outputs and carries its grades as a level family
                logs += CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.RequireSingleOutput(RoleName, recipe, draw.GradedWaferItemGuid);
                logs += CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.RequireFamilyBase(RoleName, draw.MachineRecipeGuid, draw.GradedWaferItemGuid, out _);
                if (draw.MaxPromotionChance < 0f || 1f < draw.MaxPromotionChance)
                {
                    logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {RoleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{draw.MachineRecipeGuid} MaxPromotionChance:{draw.MaxPromotionChance} is out of [0,1]\n";
                }
            }
            return logs;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
    /// <summary>
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/Component/CleanRoom/CleanRoomEffect.cs`（A7 が書いた全文）を次の全文にする。A7 の `Operability`・`CanOperate` は残し、A7 の公開 ctor と `MaxChipLevel` / `DownBinRate` を消す。

```csharp
namespace Game.Block.Interface.Component
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     クリーンルームが内部の機械へ押し込む効果。稼働できる（クラス値あり）か、止まっている（理由だけ）かのどちらか
    ///     The effect a clean room pushes into interior machines: either operable (with class values) or halted (reason only)
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct CleanRoomEffect
    {
        // 密閉部屋内かつ閾値行がOutでないときだけ Operable。止まる理由も区別して持つ
        // Operable only inside a sealed room whose row is not Out; the halt reason is kept distinct
        public readonly CleanRoomOperability Operability;

        // Operable のときだけ書かれる。読むのは TryGetClassYield だけ
        // Written only when Operable; only TryGetClassYield reads it
        private readonly CleanRoomClassYield _classYield;

        public bool CanOperate => Operability == CleanRoomOperability.Operable;

        private CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability operability, CleanRoomClassYield classYield)
        {
            Operability = operability;
            _classYield = classYield;
        }

        // 稼働できる部屋: クラス行の3値を持つ
        // An operable room carries the three values of its class row
        public static CleanRoomEffect Operable(CleanRoomClassYield classYield)
        {
            return new CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability.Operable, classYield);
        }

        // 部屋が未検出・未密閉で止まっている
        // Halted because no sealed room was detected
        public static CleanRoomEffect NotEnclosed()
        {
            return new CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed, default);
        }

        // 部屋はあるがクラスが足りず止まっている
        // Halted because the room's class is insufficient
        public static CleanRoomEffect ClassOut()
        {
            return new CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability.ClassOut, default);
        }

        // 部屋の効果が届く前の値。抽選側のデコレータと停止理由の状態の初期値はここから引く
        // The value before any room effect arrives; the draw decorator and the halt-reason state take their defaults from here
        public static CleanRoomEffect BeforeFirstPush()
        {
            return NotEnclosed();
        }

        // 稼働できるときだけクラス値を返す。止まっているときは false で、止まった理由（未密閉・クラス不足）は Operability を読む
        // Returns the class values only while operable; false while halted, and the halt reason (not enclosed or class out) is read from Operability
        public bool TryGetClassYield(out CleanRoomClassYield classYield)
        {
            classYield = _classYield;
            return CanOperate;
        }
    }
}
```

`default(CleanRoomEffect)` は `Operability` が列挙の先頭 `NotEnclosed`（A7 の並び）になり、クラス値を返さない。0 のクラス値を読める形は無い。

A7 が書いた `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/CleanRoomOperabilityStateComponent.cs` の初期値の行とその2行コメント（`// 部屋の効果が届く前は、効果の既定値と同じく未密閉として扱う` から `public CleanRoomOperability Operability { get; private set; } = CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed;` まで）を次にする（初期値をデコレータと同じ1か所から引く）。

```csharp

        // The value before any room effect arrives is defined once by CleanRoomEffect.BeforeFirstPush (the draw decorator reads the same place)
```

```csharp
        // 素の出力1セットを、生産性の当選時は2セット並べる。セット数は差し替え口へ渡すため返す（品質は一般機械の出力を変えない）
        // Lay out one plain output set, or two when productivity rolls; the set count is returned for the rewrite hook (quality never changes general machine output)
        public static List<IItemStack> CreateRealizedOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, MachineModuleEffect effect, int? inheritedLevel, out int setCount)
        {
            setCount = GameRandom.NextDouble() < effect.ExtraOutputChance ? 2 : 1;
            var outputs = new List<IItemStack>(recipe.OutputItems.Length * setCount);
            for (var set = 0; set < setCount; set++) outputs.AddRange(CreatePlainOutputs(recipe, inheritedLevel));
            return outputs;
        }
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.OutputRewrite

    /// <summary>
    ///     1サイクルの抽選に要る入力（部屋クラスの値・モジュール効果・工場の1セットとセット数・乱数列）
    ///     Inputs for one cycle's draw (class values, module effect, the factory's set and set count, random sequence)
    /// </summary>
    internal readonly struct CleanRoomYieldRollContext
    {
        // 抽選は稼働できる部屋でだけ起きるので、クラス値は必ずある
        // Draws only happen in an operable room, so the class values always exist
        public readonly CleanRoomClassYield ClassYield;
        public readonly MachineModuleEffect ModuleEffect;

        // 工場が作った1セット目（継承レシピは継承先が継承レベルの変種）と、工場が決めたセット数
        // The factory's first set (an inheritance recipe's target is already the inherited level's variant) and the set count the factory decided
        public readonly IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> FactorySet;
        public readonly int SetCount;
        public readonly CleanRoomDrawRandom Random;

        public CleanRoomYieldRollContext(CleanRoomClassYield classYield, MachineModuleEffect moduleEffect, IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> factorySet, int setCount, CleanRoomDrawRandom random)
        {
            ClassYield = classYield;
            ModuleEffect = moduleEffect;
            FactorySet = factorySet;
            SetCount = setCount;
            Random = random;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/OutputRewrite/RecipeOutputSetBuilder.cs`

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Context;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.OutputRewrite
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     工場が作った出力1セットの並びのまま実現出力を組み直す。出力kはスロット(k % 出力数)へ積まれるので並びを崩さない
    ///     Rebuilds realized outputs in the order of the factory's output set; output k lands in slot (k % output count), so the order must hold
    /// </summary>
    internal static class RecipeOutputSetBuilder
    {
        // 工場の1セットをアイテムIDと個数の写しにする。書き換え器は写しの必要な所だけを書き換える
        // Copy the factory's set into item ids and counts; rewriters change only the entries they own
        public static (ItemId[] itemIds, int[] counts) CopySet(IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> factorySet)
        {
            var itemIds = new ItemId[factorySet.Count];
            var counts = new int[factorySet.Count];
            for (var i = 0; i < factorySet.Count; i++)
            {
                itemIds[i] = factorySet[i].Id;
                counts[i] = factorySet[i].Count;
            }
            return (itemIds, counts);
        }

        // 1セットを setCount 回並べる。個数0は空スタックになり、スロットへは何も積まれない
        // Repeat one set setCount times; a zero count becomes an empty stack that adds nothing to its slot
        public static List<IItemStack> Repeat(IReadOnlyList<ItemId> itemIds, IReadOnlyList<int> counts, int setCount)
        {
            var outputs = new List<IItemStack>(itemIds.Count * setCount);
            for (var set = 0; set < setCount; set++)
            {
                for (var i = 0; i < itemIds.Count; i++) outputs.Add(ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(itemIds[i], counts[i]));
            }
            return outputs;
        }
    }
}
```

役割表が指す出力の添字は、ここでは探さない（`CleanRoomMaster.Initialize` が役割レコードへ1回だけ解決している）。レシピから出力を組み直す口（旧 `CreatePlainSet`）は置かない。継承の変種を当てるのは工場（C3 の `ResolveOutputItemId`）の1か所だけで、書き換え器が上書きする所は書き換え器が全部書く。

```csharp
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.OutputRewrite

    /// <summary>
    ///     役割ごとに部屋クラスの値とモジュール効果を ChipYieldFormula へ渡す唯一の口。抽選（書き換え器）と機械UIの表示が共有する
    ///     The single place that feeds per-role class values and module effects into ChipYieldFormula; shared by the draws (rewriters) and the machine UI
    /// </summary>
    internal static class CleanRoomRoleRates
    {
        // 成膜のグレード上限＝装着品質モジュールの最高tier+1（グレード数で頭打ち）
        // Deposition grade cap = highest equipped quality tier + 1, capped by the grade count
        public static int MaxWaferGrade(WaferGradeRecipeRole role, MachineModuleEffect moduleEffect)
        {
            return ChipYieldFormula.MaxWaferGrade(moduleEffect.HighestQualityModuleTier, role.GradeCount);
        }

        // 成膜の1段の昇格確率＝品質合計×クラス倍率（上限maxPromotionChance）
        // Deposition per-step promotion chance = quality sum x class multiplier, capped by maxPromotionChance
        public static double PromotionChance(WaferGradeRecipeRole role, CleanRoomClassYield classYield, MachineModuleEffect moduleEffect)
        {
            return ChipYieldFormula.PromotionChance(moduleEffect.QualityShift, classYield.QualityMultiplier, role.Draw.MaxPromotionChance);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/OutputRewrite/WaferGradeOutputRewriter.cs`

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.OutputRewrite
{
    // 成膜: グレード付きウェハの出力だけを抽選したグレードの変種へ差し替える
    // Deposition: swap only the graded-wafer output for the variant of the drawn grade
    internal static class WaferGradeOutputRewriter
    {
        public static List<IItemStack> Rewrite(WaferGradeRecipeRole role, CleanRoomYieldRollContext context)
        {
            // 上限＝最高tier+1、昇格確率＝品質合計×クラス倍率（上限maxPromotionChance）で1回引く
            // Draw once with cap = top tier + 1 and chance = quality sum x class multiplier (capped by maxPromotionChance)
            var maxGrade = CleanRoomRoleRates.MaxWaferGrade(role, context.ModuleEffect);
            var chance = CleanRoomRoleRates.PromotionChance(role, context.ClassYield, context.ModuleEffect);
            var grade = ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(chance, maxGrade, context.Random);

            // 同じグレードを全セットへ並べる（別グレードが同じスロットで混ざらない）
            // Lay the same grade into every set so different grades never meet in one slot
            var (itemIds, counts) = RecipeOutputSetBuilder.CopySet(context.FactorySet);
            itemIds[role.GradedOutputIndex] = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariantItemId(role.GradedWaferBaseItemId, grade);
            return RecipeOutputSetBuilder.Repeat(itemIds, counts, context.SetCount);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/CleanRoomYieldDrawDecorator.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.OutputRewrite;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    // チップ工程の抽選を実現出力の確定直後に適用する。役割はcleanRoom.jsonの役割表で引き、役割の無いレシピは素通しする
    // Applies chip-process draws right after outputs are realized; roles come from cleanRoom.json, and recipes without a role pass through
    internal class CleanRoomYieldDrawDecorator : IRealizedOutputDecorator, ICleanRoomEffectLookup
    {
        // 抽選シードのブロック固有カウンタ。セーブへ持ち出すため公開する
        // Per-block counter feeding the draw seed; exposed because it is serialized
        public uint CycleCount { get; private set; }

        // 最後に押し込まれた部屋の効果。抽選・processor の停止判定・抽選の中身の表示（B6）がこれ1つを読む
        // The last pushed room effect; the draw, the processor's halt check and the draw-detail display (B6) all read this one value
        public CleanRoomEffect CurrentEffect { get; private set; }

        private readonly BlockInstanceId _blockInstanceId;

        public CleanRoomYieldDrawDecorator(BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, uint cycleCount)
        {
            _blockInstanceId = blockInstanceId;
            CycleCount = cycleCount;

            // 部屋の効果が届く前の値は CleanRoomEffect が1か所で決める（A7 の停止理由の状態も同じ口を読む）
            // CleanRoomEffect alone decides the value before any room effect arrives (A7's halt-reason state reads the same factory)
            CurrentEffect = CleanRoomEffect.BeforeFirstPush();
        }

        public void SetCleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomEffect effect)
        {
            CurrentEffect = effect;
        }

        public List<IItemStack> Decorate(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int? inheritedLevel, MachineModuleEffect moduleEffect, int setCount, List<IItemStack> realizedOutputs)
        {
            // 役割の無いレシピは抽選せずカウンタも進めない
            // A recipe with no role draws nothing and leaves the counter alone
            if (!MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole(recipe.MachineRecipeGuid, out var role)) return realizedOutputs;

            // 役割の型ごとに書き換え器へ渡す
            // Hand each role type to its rewriter
            var context = StartCycle();
            return role switch
            {
                WaferGradeRecipeRole waferGrade => WaferGradeOutputRewriter.Rewrite(waferGrade, context),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(role), role.GetType().Name, "未対応の清浄室工程の役割 / Unsupported clean-room recipe role"),
            };

            #region Internal

            CleanRoomYieldRollContext StartCycle()
            {
                // processor は稼働できない間は加工を始めないので、抽選のときは必ずクラス値がある。無ければ品質の効果が黙って消えるので止める
                // The processor never starts work while it cannot operate, so class values always exist here; without them the quality effect would vanish silently, so stop
                if (!CurrentEffect.TryGetClassYield(out var classYield))
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"稼働できない清浄室機械で抽選が起きました。 block={_blockInstanceId} recipe={recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} operability={CurrentEffect.Operability}");
                }

                // 抽選のたびにカウンタを進め、ブロック固有で再現可能なシードにする
                // Advance the counter on every draw to keep the seed per-block and reproducible
                CycleCount++;
                var random = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(((long)_blockInstanceId.AsPrimitive() << 20) ^ CycleCount);

                // 書き換え器は工場の1セット目の写しを書き換え、工場が決めたセット数だけ並べる（生産性の追加セットも同じ抽選結果）
                // Rewriters edit a copy of the factory's first set and repeat it by the factory's set count (the extra set shares the draw)
                var factorySet = realizedOutputs.GetRange(0, recipe.OutputItems.Length);
                return new CleanRoomYieldRollContext(classYield, moduleEffect, factorySet, setCount, random);
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/HaltedMachineProcessState.cs` の全体を次にする（`Func<bool>` の注入をやめ、可否の値を受け取る）。

```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    // 清浄室条件が満たされるまで加工状態を凍結する。可否は processor が部屋の効果から決めて押し込む
    // Freezes machine processing until clean-room conditions are satisfied; the processor decides operability from the room effect and pushes it
    internal class HaltedMachineProcessState : IMachineProcessState
    {
        private readonly ProcessingMachineProcessState _processingState;
        private bool _canOperate;

        public HaltedMachineProcessState(ProcessingMachineProcessState processingState, bool canOperate)
        {
            _processingState = processingState;
            _canOperate = canOperate;
        }

        public ProcessState State => ProcessState.Halted;
        public void OnEnter() { }
        public void OnExit() { }

        // 部屋の効果が押し込まれるたびに processor から届く
        // Delivered by the processor each time a room effect is pushed
        public void SetCanOperate(bool canOperate)
        {
            _canOperate = canOperate;
        }

        public ProcessState GetNextUpdate()
        {
            if (!_canOperate) return ProcessState.Halted;
            return _processingState.RecipeGuid != Guid.Empty ? ProcessState.Processing : ProcessState.Idle;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using NUnit.Framework;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    public class CleanRoomLayerExposureTest
    {
        // 層失敗率は最悪クラスでも0.25。20枚が全部失敗する確率は0.25^20
        // The layer fail rate is at most 0.25 even in the worst class; all 20 failing has odds 0.25^20
        private const int WaferCount = 20;
        private const int TickCap = 4000;

        [Test]
        public void ExposureKeepsInputGradeOrFailsTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();

            // G2のウェハは成功ならG2の次層ウェハ、失敗なら失敗パターンウェハになり、他のグレードには化けない
            // A G2 wafer becomes a G2 layered wafer on success or a failed pattern wafer, never another grade
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomLayerExposureRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestGradedWaferG2, WaferCount);
            var collected = RunAndCollect(filter, machine, WaferCount, TickCap);

            var layeredGradeTwo = CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestLayeredWaferG2);
            Assert.AreEqual(WaferCount, layeredGradeTwo + CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestFailedPatternWafer));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestLayeredWaferG1));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestLayeredWaferG3));
            Assert.Greater(layeredGradeTwo, 0);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        [Test]
        public void TryGetRecipeRoleResolvesLayerExposureTest()
        {
            var (_, _) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator()
                .Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));

            // 層露光レシピはEUVの役割として引け、次層ウェハと失敗品の出力の添字が索引時に解決済み
            // The layer-exposure recipe resolves as an EUV role with the layered and failed output indices already resolved at indexing
            var master = MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster;
            Assert.IsTrue(master.TryGetRecipeRole(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomLayerExposureRecipe, out var role));
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<LayerExposureRecipeRole>(role);
            var layerExposure = (LayerExposureRecipeRole)role;
            Assert.AreEqual(Guid.Parse("1bbb9ba9-403f-47ab-a601-ae74fe444acd"), layerExposure.Exposure.LayeredWaferItemGuid);
            Assert.AreEqual(Guid.Parse("4f0fa5e5-121e-4c92-a0cb-a9ef810921a8"), layerExposure.Exposure.FailedWaferItemGuid);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, layerExposure.LayeredOutputIndex);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, layerExposure.FailedOutputIndex);

            // 成膜レシピはEUVの役割にならない（1レシピ1役割）
            // The deposition recipe does not resolve as an EUV role (one role per recipe)
            Assert.IsTrue(master.TryGetRecipeRole(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDepositionRecipe, out var depositionRole));
            Assert.IsNotInstanceOf<LayerExposureRecipeRole>(depositionRole);
        }
```

```csharp
using Mooresmaster.Model.CleanRoomModule;

namespace Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     EUV: 層の成否を1回引き、成功なら入力と同じグレードの次層ウェハ、失敗なら失敗パターンウェハだけを出す役割
    ///     EUV: the role that rolls the layer once, yielding the next-layer wafer at the input's grade on success or only the failed pattern wafer on failure
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class LayerExposureRecipeRole : CleanRoomRecipeRole
    {
        public LayerExposuresElement Exposure { get; }

        // 次層ウェハ（継承先）と失敗パターンウェハの出力の添字
        // Output indices of the layered wafer (the inheritance target) and the failed pattern wafer
        public int LayeredOutputIndex { get; }
        public int FailedOutputIndex { get; }

        internal LayerExposureRecipeRole(LayerExposuresElement exposure)
        {
            var recipe = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(exposure.MachineRecipeGuid);
            Exposure = exposure;
            LayeredOutputIndex = IndexOfOutput(recipe, exposure.LayeredWaferItemGuid);
            FailedOutputIndex = IndexOfOutput(recipe, exposure.FailedWaferItemGuid);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp

        // グレードを入力から受け継ぐ役割（EUV・ダイシング）の共通検証。入力と出力のグレード数を返し、引けなければ null
        // Shared validation for roles that inherit the grade from the input (EUV, dicing); returns the input and output grade counts, or null when unresolved
        public static string ValidateGradeInheritingRole(string roleName, MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, Guid outputBaseItemGuid, out int? sourceGradeCount, out int? outputVariantCount)
        {
            var logs = RequireInheritance(roleName, recipe);
            logs += ResolveSourceGradeCount(roleName, recipe, out sourceGradeCount);
            logs += RequireFamilyBase(roleName, recipe.MachineRecipeGuid, outputBaseItemGuid, out outputVariantCount);
            return logs;
        }

        // レベル継承レシピでなければ、入力のグレードは常にG1として扱われてしまう
        // Unless the recipe is a level-inheritance recipe, the input grade would always be treated as G1
        private static string RequireInheritance(string roleName, MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            if (recipe.LevelInheritance == MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.Inherit) return "";
            return $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} must use levelInheritance Inherit (found {recipe.LevelInheritance})\n";
        }

        // グレードの出どころ（継承元の入力）はちょうど1つ。機械レシピの検証の順序に頼らず、ここでも確かめる
        // The grade source (the inheritance source input) must be exactly one; checked here too instead of relying on the machine-recipe validation order
        private static string ResolveSourceGradeCount(string roleName, MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, out int? gradeCount)
        {
            gradeCount = null;
            if (LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.FindSourceFamilyLength(recipe) is not int length) return $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} must have exactly one level-family base input to take the grade from (found {LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.CountFamilyBaseInputs(recipe)})\n";
            gradeCount = length;
            return "";
        }
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/CleanRoom/CleanRoomLayerExposureValidator.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Mooresmaster.Model.CleanRoomModule;

namespace Core.Master.Validator
{
    // EUV（層ごとの失敗判定）の役割表を検証する
    // Validates the EUV (per-layer failure roll) role table
    internal static class CleanRoomLayerExposureValidator
    {
        private const string RoleName = "LayerExposures";

        public static string Validate(LayerExposuresElement[] exposures, HashSet<Guid> roleRecipeGuids)
        {
            var logs = "";
            foreach (var exposure in exposures)
            {
                logs += CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.Validate(RoleName, exposure.MachineRecipeGuid, roleRecipeGuids, out var recipe);
                if (recipe == null) continue;

                // 入力のグレードを受け継ぎ、次層ウェハは同じグレード数のファミリーで持つ（両方引けたときだけ比べる）
                // Inherit the input grade and keep the layered wafer as a family with the same grade count (compared only when both resolve)
                logs += CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.ValidateGradeInheritingRole(RoleName, recipe, exposure.LayeredWaferItemGuid, out var inputGradeCount, out var layeredGradeCount);
                if (inputGradeCount is int inputCount && layeredGradeCount is int layeredCount && inputCount != layeredCount)
                {
                    logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {RoleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{exposure.MachineRecipeGuid} input grade count {inputCount} differs from layered wafer grade count {layeredCount}\n";
                }

                // 出力はちょうど [次層ウェハ ×c, 失敗パターンウェハ ×c]
                // Outputs are exactly [layered wafer xc, failed pattern wafer xc]
                logs += OutputLayoutValidation(recipe.OutputItems.Length == 2
                    && recipe.OutputItems[0].ItemGuid == exposure.LayeredWaferItemGuid
                    && recipe.OutputItems[1].ItemGuid == exposure.FailedWaferItemGuid
                    && recipe.OutputItems[0].Count == recipe.OutputItems[1].Count, exposure.MachineRecipeGuid);
                if (exposure.MaxFailReduction < 0f || 1f < exposure.MaxFailReduction)
                {
                    logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {RoleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{exposure.MachineRecipeGuid} MaxFailReduction:{exposure.MaxFailReduction} is out of [0,1]\n";
                }
            }
            return logs;

            #region Internal

            string OutputLayoutValidation(bool isValid, Guid machineRecipeGuid)
            {
                return isValid ? "" : $"[CleanRoomMaster] {RoleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{machineRecipeGuid} outputItems must be exactly [layered wafer, failed wafer] with equal counts\n";
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/OutputRewrite/LayerExposureOutputRewriter.cs`

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.OutputRewrite
{
    // EUV: 層の失敗を1回判定し、成功なら入力と同じグレードの次層ウェハ、失敗なら失敗パターンウェハだけを出す
    // EUV: roll the layer once; success yields the next-layer wafer at the input's grade, failure yields only the failed pattern wafer
    internal static class LayerExposureOutputRewriter
    {
        public static List<IItemStack> Rewrite(LayerExposureRecipeRole role, CleanRoomYieldRollContext context)
        {
            // 失敗率＝クラス別の層失敗率×(1−品質合計による低減)
            // Fail rate = class layer fail rate x (1 - quality-sum reduction)
            var failRate = CleanRoomRoleRates.LayerFailRate(role, context.ClassYield, context.ModuleEffect);
            var isFailed = ChipYieldDraw.DrawLayerFailure(failRate, context.Random);

            // 次層ウェハは工場が継承レベルの変種を当て済みなので、写しの成否で片方の個数を0にするだけ
            // The factory already set the layered wafer to the inherited level's variant, so just zero out one side of the copy by the outcome
            var (itemIds, counts) = RecipeOutputSetBuilder.CopySet(context.FactorySet);
            if (isFailed) counts[role.LayeredOutputIndex] = 0;
            else counts[role.FailedOutputIndex] = 0;
            return RecipeOutputSetBuilder.Repeat(itemIds, counts, context.SetCount);
        }
    }
}
```

**Interfaces:**

  - B1: `ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate`、`ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing`、`DicingDrawResult`
  - B3: `CleanRoomYieldRollContext`（`ClassYield`・`FactorySet`・`SetCount`）、`RecipeOutputSetBuilder.CopySet` / `Repeat`、`CleanRoomRoleRates`、`Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles.CleanRoomRecipeRole`、`CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole` と `Initialize` の役割索引、`CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.Validate`、`CleanRoomYieldDrawDecorator.Decorate`（`int? inheritedLevel` を受ける）の役割の型の switch と `#region Internal` の `StartCycle`
  - B4: `CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.ValidateGradeInheritingRole(string roleName, MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, Guid outputBaseItemGuid, out int? sourceGradeCount, out int? outputVariantCount)`、`ForUnitTestItemId.TestLayeredWaferG1..G3`
  - C2・C3: `Inherit` のレシピの継承元入力の受け入れと `int? inheritedLevel`（B4 の Consumes と同じ名前）。役割の検証が `Inherit` を必須にしているので、ダイシングの抽選では継承レベルは必ず値を持つ。無条件の `.Value` は書かず、`Decorate` の振り分けで `is not int gradeLevel` なら block と recipe を添えた `InvalidOperationException` で止め、書き換え器には非 null の `int` を渡す。C3 の工場は継承先の出力（ダイの基準＝出力[0]）を投入グレードの変種に当てるので、ダイシングの書き換え器はレベル列のアイテムIDを全部書き直す。`LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.GetFamilyLength(Guid) : int`（public）。C1: 品質モジュールの許可は `allowQualityModule` だけで決まる
  - C3: `MachineOutputFactoryUtil.CreateRealizedOutputs` は生産性の `ExtraOutputChance`（1以下にクランプ）で追加1セットを足す。テストの生産性モジュール `TestProductivityModule`（itemGuid `00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000002`、effectValue 1.0）は追加セットを必ず出す
- Produces:
  - `CleanRoomRoleRates.DieLossRate(DicingRecipeRole role, CleanRoomClassYield classYield, MachineModuleEffect moduleEffect) : double`
  - スキーマ: `dicings[] { machineRecipeGuid, dieItemGuid, failedDieItemGuid, diesPerWafer(integer), maxLossReduction, gradeDieTables[] { levelRates: number[] } }`（必須の配列。`gradeDieTables` は G1 から順。number 配列の生成型は `float[]` の想定＝integer 配列 `stackCounts` が `int[]` になる前例と同じ）
  - `Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles.DicingRecipeRole`（`DicingsElement Dicing`・`ItemId DieBaseItemId`＝ダイのレベルファミリーの基準・`int DieLevelCount`＝ダイのレベルファミリーの変種数〈`GetFamilyLength`〉。出力は `[ダイLv1..LvN, 失敗ダイ]` の順なので失敗ダイの出力の添字も `DieLevelCount`）。`CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole` がダイシングのレシピでこれを返す
  - `CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateDieTables(string roleLabel, IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyList<float>> gradeDieTables, int dieLevelCount) : string`
  - `CleanRoomDicingValidator.MaxOutputSetsPerCycle = 2`（生産性で最大1セット増えるぶん）
  - レシピの出力の約束（統合タスク（旧 Part D） 向け）: ダイシングの役割レシピの出力はちょうど `[ダイLv1(基準), ダイLv2, …, ダイLvN, 失敗ダイ]` の順で、どれも個数 `diesPerWafer`。これらのアイテムのスタック表の最小値は `diesPerWafer × 2` 以上。機械の出力スロット数は N+1 以上
  - テストアイテム `ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv1..Lv3`（levelFamily `d6418319-2867-422d-92f5-d5a7bd3aa4a0`、スタック表 Stack1000000）・`TestFailedDie`、テストレシピ `ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDicingRecipe`（`aadd680b-334c-4294-a6d7-37ea2f8a7527`）

**出力の扱い（設計）:**
- レベルごとに専用の出力を並べるので、ダイ Lvk は常に出力スロット k、失敗ダイは最後のスロットに入り、別レベルが同じスロットで混ざらない
- 加工を始める前（待機ステート）に、抽選済みの全出力が入り切るかを判定する。入らなければ加工を始めず、入力も IPA も減らさない（既存の `CanStoreOutputs` の前例どおり）。払い出し（ベルト・手で取り出し）でスロットが空けば始まる
- 加工中に出力先が埋まる経路は無い（出力スロットへ入れるのは機械だけ）。万一完了時に入らなければ、既存の出力詰まり状態で保持し、捨てない
- 1サイクルの最大出力はダイ1種あたり `diesPerWafer × 2`（生産性の追加セット）。スタック表の最小値がこれ未満だと `ItemStackFactory.Create` が例外を投げるので、起動時の検証で止める

```csharp
        [Test]
        public void ContractDieTablesAreValidTest()
        {
            var tables = new[]
            {
                new[] { 1f },
                new[] { 0.7f, 0.3f },
                new[] { 0.55f, 0.3f, 0.15f },
                new[] { 0.45f, 0.3f, 0.17f, 0.08f },
                new[] { 0.4f, 0.28f, 0.18f, 0.09f, 0.05f },
            };
            Assert.AreEqual("", CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateDieTables("Dicings", tables, 5));
        }

        [Test]
        public void TableAboveItsGradeIsRejectedTest()
        {
            // G1の表がLv2を持つと、品質モジュール無しでもLv2が出てしまう（品質ゲート破り）
            // A G1 table holding Lv2 would leak Lv2 without any quality module (breaking the quality gate)
            var tables = new[] { new[] { 0.5f, 0.5f } };
            StringAssert.Contains("GradeDieTables[0]", CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateDieTables("Dicings", tables, 3));
        }

        [Test]
        public void TableNotSummingToOneIsRejectedTest()
        {
            var tables = new[] { new[] { 1f }, new[] { 0.7f, 0.2f } };
            StringAssert.Contains("sum", CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateDieTables("Dicings", tables, 3));
        }

        [Test]
        public void NegativeRateIsRejectedTest()
        {
            var tables = new[] { new[] { 1f }, new[] { 1.1f, -0.1f } };
            StringAssert.Contains("negative", CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateDieTables("Dicings", tables, 3));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ShrinkingUpperTailIsRejectedTest()
        {
            // G3のLv2以上(0.2)がG2(0.3)を下回ると、グレードが上がってLv2以上が減りうる
            // G3's Lv2+ share (0.2) below G2's (0.3) would let a higher grade lower the Lv2+ count
            var tables = new[] { new[] { 1f }, new[] { 0.7f, 0.3f }, new[] { 0.8f, 0.1f, 0.1f } };
            StringAssert.Contains("tail", CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateDieTables("Dicings", tables, 3));
        }
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    public class CleanRoomDicingTest
    {
        private const int DiesPerWafer = 300;
        private const int TickCap = 4000;
        private const int FailedDieSlot = FirstOutputSlot + 3;
        private const int FailedDieMaxStack = 1000000;
        private static readonly Guid TestProductivityModuleItemGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000002");

        [Test]
        public void GradeThreeWaferSplitsAcrossThreeLevelsTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();

            // G3ウェハ2枚は600個に切られ、Lv1〜Lv3と失敗ダイに分かれる（Lv3が0個の確率は約0.87^255）
            // Two G3 wafers become 600 dies split into Lv1-Lv3 and failed dies (no Lv3 has odds ~0.87^255)
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDicingRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestLayeredWaferG3, 2);
            var collected = RunAndCollect(filter, machine, DiesPerWafer * 2, TickCap);

            var levelOne = CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv1);
            var levelTwo = CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv2);
            var levelThree = CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv3);
            Assert.AreEqual(DiesPerWafer * 2, levelOne + levelTwo + levelThree + CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestFailedDie));
            Assert.Greater(levelOne, 0);
            Assert.Greater(levelThree, 0);
        }

        [Test]
        public void GradeOneWaferYieldsOnlyLevelOneTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();

            // G1の表は[1]なので、良品は全部Lv1（品質ゲート）
            // G1's table is [1], so every good die is Lv1 (the quality gate)
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDicingRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestLayeredWaferG1, 2);
            var collected = RunAndCollect(filter, machine, DiesPerWafer * 2, TickCap);

            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv2));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv3));
            Assert.AreEqual(DiesPerWafer * 2, CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv1) + CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestFailedDie));
        }

        [Test]
        public void FullOutputSlotHoldsJobWithoutLossTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            IOpenableInventory inventory = machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();

            // 失敗ダイのスロットを満杯にすると、抽選済みの失敗ダイ（損失0個の確率は0.9^300未満）が入らず加工が始まらない
            // With the failed-die slot full, the drawn failed dies (zero losses has odds below 0.9^300) cannot fit and the job never starts
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDicingRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestLayeredWaferG1, 1);
            inventory.SetItem(FailedDieSlot, ForUnitTestItemId.TestFailedDie, FailedDieMaxStack);
            for (var i = 0; i < 600; i++)
            {
                TopUpIpa(machine, 20);
                TickRoom(filter, machine);
            }
            Assert.AreEqual(1, inventory.GetItem(InputSlot).Count);
            Assert.AreNotEqual(ProcessState.Processing, machine.GetComponent<CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent>().CurrentState);

            // スロットを空けると始まり、300個が欠けずに出る
            // Freeing the slot lets the job start, and all 300 dies come out
            inventory.SetItem(FailedDieSlot, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty());
            var collected = RunAndCollect(filter, machine, DiesPerWafer, TickCap);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.GetItem(InputSlot).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(DiesPerWafer, CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv1) + CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestFailedDie));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ProductivityExtraSetSharesTheDrawAndFitsTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            IOpenableInventory inventory = machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
            inventory.SetItem(FirstModuleSlot, MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(TestProductivityModuleItemGuid), 1);

            // 生産性効果1.0は追加1セットを必ず出す。G3ウェハ1枚から同じ抽選の2セット（計600個）が出て、各スロットに収まる
            // A productivity effect of 1.0 always adds one set: one G3 wafer yields two copies of one draw (600 dies) that fit their slots
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDicingRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestLayeredWaferG3, 1);
            var collected = RunAndCollect(filter, machine, DiesPerWafer * 2, TickCap);

            var counts = new[]
            {
                CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv1),
                CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv2),
                CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestDieLv3),
                CountOf(collected, ForUnitTestItemId.TestFailedDie),
            };
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.GetItem(InputSlot).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(DiesPerWafer * 2, counts.Sum());

            // 追加セットは同じ抽選結果を並べるので、どの出力も2の倍数になる
            // The extra set repeats the same draw, so every output is a multiple of two
            foreach (var count in counts) Assert.AreEqual(0, count % 2, $"counts={string.Join(",", counts)}");
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/CleanRoom/CleanRoomYieldTableRules.cs` の `ValidateClassRows` の後ろへ足す。

```csharp

        // 浮動小数の和の許容誤差
        // Tolerance for floating-point sums
        private const float RateTolerance = 1e-4f;

        // 各表は長さ1〜min(グレード, ダイのレベル数)・非負・和1。上位の裾（Lvk以上の割合）はグレードとともに減らない
        // Each table has length 1..min(grade, die level count), is non-negative and sums to 1; the upper tail (share at Lvk+) never shrinks as the grade rises
        public static string ValidateDieTables(string roleLabel, IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyList<float>> gradeDieTables, int dieLevelCount)
        {
            var logs = "";
            for (var gradeIndex = 0; gradeIndex < gradeDieTables.Count; gradeIndex++)
            {
                var rates = gradeDieTables[gradeIndex];
                var maxLength = gradeIndex + 1 < dieLevelCount ? gradeIndex + 1 : dieLevelCount;
                if (rates.Count < 1 || maxLength < rates.Count) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleLabel} GradeDieTables[{gradeIndex}] has {rates.Count} levels; allowed 1..{maxLength}\n";

                var sum = 0f;
                foreach (var rate in rates)
                {
                    if (rate < 0f) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleLabel} GradeDieTables[{gradeIndex}] has a negative rate {rate}\n";
                    sum += rate;
                }
                if (RateTolerance < System.Math.Abs(sum - 1f)) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleLabel} GradeDieTables[{gradeIndex}] rates sum to {sum}, not 1\n";
                if (gradeIndex == 0) continue;

                // Lvk以上の割合を1つ下のグレードと比べる
                // Compare the share at Lvk and above with the grade just below
                for (var level = 1; level < dieLevelCount; level++)
                {
                    var tail = TailFrom(rates, level);
                    var lowerTail = TailFrom(gradeDieTables[gradeIndex - 1], level);
                    if (tail + RateTolerance < lowerTail) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {roleLabel} GradeDieTables[{gradeIndex}] tail from Lv{level + 1} ({tail}) is below the lower grade ({lowerTail})\n";
                }
            }
            return logs;
        }

        private static float TailFrom(IReadOnlyList<float> rates, int fromLevelIndex)
        {
            var tail = 0f;
            for (var i = fromLevelIndex; i < rates.Count; i++) tail += rates[i];
            return tail;
        }
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Mooresmaster.Model.CleanRoomModule;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Core.Master.Validator
{
    // ダイシング（損失とレベル別の切り分け）の役割表を検証する
    // Validates the dicing (loss and per-level split) role table
    internal static class CleanRoomDicingValidator
    {
        // 1サイクルの出力セット数の上限。生産性は最大1セット追加する（ExtraOutputChanceは1でクランプ）
        // Maximum output sets per cycle; productivity adds at most one extra set (ExtraOutputChance is clamped to 1)
        public const int MaxOutputSetsPerCycle = 2;

        private const string RoleName = "Dicings";

        public static string Validate(DicingsElement[] dicings, HashSet<Guid> roleRecipeGuids)
        {
            var logs = "";
            foreach (var dicing in dicings)
            {
                logs += CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.Validate(RoleName, dicing.MachineRecipeGuid, roleRecipeGuids, out var recipe);
                if (recipe == null) continue;

                // 入力ウェハのグレードを受け継ぎ、グレード数ぶんの表を持つ（グレード数が引けたときだけ比べる）
                // Inherit the input wafer's grade and hold one table per grade (compared only when the grade count resolves)
                logs += CleanRoomRoleRecipeChecks.ValidateGradeInheritingRole(RoleName, recipe, dicing.DieItemGuid, out var gradeCount, out var dieLevelCount);
                if (gradeCount is int waferGradeCount && dicing.GradeDieTables.Length != waferGradeCount) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {RoleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{dicing.MachineRecipeGuid} has {dicing.GradeDieTables.Length} grade tables for {waferGradeCount} wafer grades\n";
                if (dicing.DiesPerWafer < 1) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {RoleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{dicing.MachineRecipeGuid} DiesPerWafer:{dicing.DiesPerWafer} must be >= 1\n";
                if (dicing.MaxLossReduction < 0f || 1f < dicing.MaxLossReduction) logs += $"[CleanRoomMaster] {RoleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{dicing.MachineRecipeGuid} MaxLossReduction:{dicing.MaxLossReduction} is out of [0,1]\n";

                // ダイのレベル数が引けたときだけ表の形と出力の並びを見る（引けない理由は上でログ済み）
                // Check the table shape and output layout only when the die level count resolves (the reason it did not is already logged above)
                if (dieLevelCount is not int levelCount) continue;
                var tables = new List<IReadOnlyList<float>>();
                foreach (var table in dicing.GradeDieTables) tables.Add(table.LevelRates);
                logs += CleanRoomYieldTableRules.ValidateDieTables($"{RoleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{dicing.MachineRecipeGuid}", tables, levelCount);
                logs += OutputLayoutValidation(recipe, dicing, levelCount);
            }
            return logs;
        }

        // 出力はちょうど [ダイLv1..LvN, 失敗ダイ]、個数はどれもdiesPerWafer、スタック表は最小でも2セット分を1スロットに積める
        // Outputs are exactly [die Lv1..LvN, failed die], each counting diesPerWafer, and every stack table fits two sets in one slot
        private static string OutputLayoutValidation(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, DicingsElement dicing, int dieLevelCount)
        {
            var expectedGuids = new List<Guid>();
            foreach (var variantId in MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariants(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(dicing.DieItemGuid))) expectedGuids.Add(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemGuid(variantId));
            expectedGuids.Add(dicing.FailedDieItemGuid);

            var prefix = $"[CleanRoomMaster] {RoleName} MachineRecipeGuid:{dicing.MachineRecipeGuid}";
            if (recipe.OutputItems.Length != dieLevelCount + 1) return $"{prefix} outputItems must list {dieLevelCount} die levels then the failed die (found {recipe.OutputItems.Length})\n";

            var logs = "";
            for (var i = 0; i < expectedGuids.Count; i++)
            {
                var output = recipe.OutputItems[i];
                if (output.ItemGuid != expectedGuids[i]) logs += $"{prefix} outputItems[{i}] must be ItemGuid:{expectedGuids[i]} (found {output.ItemGuid})\n";
                if (output.Count != dicing.DiesPerWafer) logs += $"{prefix} outputItems[{i}] Count:{output.Count} must equal DiesPerWafer:{dicing.DiesPerWafer}\n";
                var minStack = MinStackCount(output.ItemGuid);
                if (minStack < dicing.DiesPerWafer * MaxOutputSetsPerCycle) logs += $"{prefix} outputItems[{i}] ItemGuid:{output.ItemGuid} min stack {minStack} is below {dicing.DiesPerWafer * MaxOutputSetsPerCycle} (DiesPerWafer x {MaxOutputSetsPerCycle})\n";
            }
            return logs;
        }

        private static int MinStackCount(Guid itemGuid)
        {
            var stackCounts = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetStackLevelTable(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemMaster(itemGuid).StackLevelTableGuid).StackCounts;
            var min = int.MaxValue;
            foreach (var count in stackCounts) min = Math.Min(min, count);
            return min;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Core.Master.Validator.MachineUpgrade;
using Mooresmaster.Model.CleanRoomModule;

namespace Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ダイシング: 1枚を diesPerWafer 個に切り、損失を失敗ダイへ、残りをグレードのダイ表でレベル別の出力へ振り分ける役割
    ///     Dicing: the role that cuts one wafer into diesPerWafer dies, sends losses to failed dies and splits survivors by level with the grade's die table
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class DicingRecipeRole : CleanRoomRecipeRole
    {
        public DicingsElement Dicing { get; }

        // ダイのレベルファミリーの基準。書き換え器はここから各レベルの変種を引く
        // Base item of the die level family; the rewriter derives each level's variant from it
        public ItemId DieBaseItemId { get; }

        // ダイのレベル数。出力は [ダイLv1..LvN, 失敗ダイ] の順（起動時の検証が保証）なので、失敗ダイの出力の添字もこの値
        // Die level count; outputs run [die Lv1..LvN, failed die] (guaranteed by boot validation), so this is also the failed die's output index
        public int DieLevelCount { get; }

        internal DicingRecipeRole(DicingsElement dicing)
        {
            Dicing = dicing;
            DieBaseItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(dicing.DieItemGuid);
            DieLevelCount = LevelInheritanceRecipeShape.GetFamilyLength(dicing.DieItemGuid);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/OutputRewrite/DicingOutputRewriter.cs`

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.OutputRewrite
{
    // ダイシング: 1枚を diesPerWafer 個に切り、損失を失敗ダイへ、残りをグレードのダイ表でレベル別に振り分ける
    // Dicing: cut one wafer into diesPerWafer dies, send losses to failed dies and split survivors by level with the grade's die table
    internal static class DicingOutputRewriter
    {
        public static List<IItemStack> Rewrite(DicingRecipeRole role, int gradeLevel, CleanRoomYieldRollContext context)
        {
            // グレードは入力ウェハから受け継いだレベル。役割の検証が Inherit と「表の数＝グレード数」を保証するので丸めない
            // The grade is the level inherited from the input wafer; validation guarantees Inherit and one table per grade, so no clamping
            var dicing = role.Dicing;
            var lossRate = CleanRoomRoleRates.DieLossRate(role, context.ClassYield, context.ModuleEffect);
            var result = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(dicing.DiesPerWafer, lossRate, dicing.GradeDieTables[gradeLevel - 1].LevelRates, context.Random);

            // 出力は [ダイLv1..LvN, 失敗ダイ]。工場が継承先（Lv1 の枠）を投入グレードの変種にしているので、レベル列のIDは全部書き直す
            // Outputs are [die Lv1..LvN, failed die]; the factory set the inheritance target (the Lv1 slot) to the input grade's variant, so rewrite every level id
            var (itemIds, counts) = RecipeOutputSetBuilder.CopySet(context.FactorySet);
            for (var levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < role.DieLevelCount; levelIndex++)
            {
                itemIds[levelIndex] = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariantItemId(role.DieBaseItemId, levelIndex + 1);
                counts[levelIndex] = levelIndex < result.GoodDieCountsByLevel.Count ? result.GoodDieCountsByLevel[levelIndex] : 0;
            }
            counts[role.DieLevelCount] = result.FailedDieCount;
            return RecipeOutputSetBuilder.Repeat(itemIds, counts, context.SetCount);
        }
    }
}
```

  - wire: `cleanRoomYield`（`{ role: "waferGrade", maxGrade, promotionChance }` | `{ role: "layerExposure", layerFailRate }` | `{ role: "dicing", dieLossRate }`）。役割の無いレシピ・未選択・稼働できない機械では省く
  - testid: `clean-room-yield-section`、行 `clean-room-yield-max-grade` / `clean-room-yield-promotion-chance`（成膜）・`clean-room-yield-layer-fail-rate`（EUV）・`clean-room-yield-die-loss-rate`（ダイシング）

**設計メモ:**
- 表示値は抽選と同じ入力と同じ口から出す。`CleanRoomYieldPreviewComponent` は抽選と同じ3つ（選択レシピ・`ICleanRoomEffectLookup.CurrentEffect`〈中身はデコレータ〉・`MachineModuleEffectComponent.AggregateCurrent()`）を読み、`CleanRoomYieldPreview.Compute` は `CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole` と `CleanRoomRoleRates` を呼ぶだけで式を書き直さない。部屋の効果の持ち主はデコレータ1つで、`CleanRoomMachineComponent` に写しを足さない。
- 部品は template が「レシピ選択（processor）・`MachineModuleEffectComponent`・効果の読み口（`processor.CleanRoomEffectLookup`）」を ctor で渡して作る。部品は効果を書き換えられず、抽選カウンタも進められない。選択レシピは `TryGetSelectedRecipe` で受け、未選択を `Guid.Empty` との比較で判定しない。プロトコルは `TryGetComponent<CleanRoomYieldPreviewComponent>` → `GetPreview()` の結果を詰め替えるだけで、機械の中の組み立て（processor・デコレータ・マスタの役割表）を知らない。
- 表示の値はポーリングした時点の値で、抽選に使うのは入力がそろって加工を始める時点の値。その間に部屋クラス・モジュール・レシピが変わると両者はずれる。これは許容し、表示は「次の抽選がいまの状態のまま行われたら使う値」を意味する（1秒ごとに追随する）。
- 結果は役割ごとの型（判別共用体）で、役割に要らない値を持たない。サーバー側に種別の列挙を持たず、種別の列挙はプロトコルの `CleanRoomYieldResponseKind` 1つだけ。wire は判別子と役割ごとの入れ子（その役割の入れ子だけ非 null）で、組み立ては factory、読み出しは `TryGetView` に閉じる（A6 と同じ形）。webui へ送る役割名の文字列は `CleanRoomYieldDetailDtoBuilder.Build` の網羅 switch 1か所でだけ作る。
- webui ホストの DTO `CleanRoomYieldDetailDto` は平らな nullable フィールドのまま。JSON の形は TS の zod `discriminatedUnion` が閉じ、A8 の `CleanRoomDetailDto` と同じ書き方にそろえる。
- プロトコルは A6 の `va:getCleanRoomInfo` と別にする。部屋の照会は清浄機・壁・ハッチからも引かれる「ブロックから見た部屋」で、A10 のツールチップも使う。抽選の中身は室内機械のレシピとモジュールに依存する別の問いであり、A の応答形と fixture を変えずに済む。
- 稼働できない機械（未密閉・クラス不足）では欄を出さない。止まっている部屋の効果はクラス値を持たない形なので数字を作れず、停止理由は A9 の部屋欄が出している。
- 取得は「開いている間だけ1秒ごと」。A8 の汎用 `BlockInfoPoller` を使い、ループは書かない。`Track` のブロック切替・`Clear` で止まり、通信失敗は前回値を保って警告、ブロック消失と読めない応答は値を捨てて警告を1回出し、次の `Start` まで問い合わせを止める（どちらもポーラーが出す）。
